name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate_of_ordered_zeros
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate_of_ordered_zeros (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : sineInterpolant θ c a ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t = 0) :
    deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant θ c)) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hne : sineInterpolant θ c a ≠ sineInterpolant θ c (root i) := by
    rwa [hroot i]
  have hP := cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne θ c a (root i) hne
  obtain ⟨point, hinj, hpoint, hpointZero⟩ :=
    exists_sineInterpolant_cyclic_deriv_roots (by omega) θ c root hmono hbound hroot
  exact second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_at_critical θ c hP
    point hinj hpoint hpointZero t ht hz

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) t = 0) :
    deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros angles hsize cut hcut
  have ha : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) (angles.angle cut) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [gapInterpolant_at_node, gapCoefficient_at_cut]
    norm_num
  exact sineInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate_of_ordered_zeros hsize _ _
    root hmono hbound hroot _ ha t ht hz

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) t = 0) :
    deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient)) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros angles hsize
  have ha : sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
      (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [wrapInterpolant_at_last]
    norm_num
  exact sineInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate_of_ordered_zeros hsize _ _
    root hmono hbound hroot _ ha t ht hz

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_comm
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_comm (θ a b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian θ a b t = -sineWronskian θ b a t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineWronskian
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_phase_before_last
statement:
lemma physicalGapCut_phase_before_last (hn : 0 < n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i < j) (hj : j.val + 1 < n) :
    cyclicCrossGapPhase (physicalGapCut hn i) (physicalGapCut hn j) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.val + 1 < n := by have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega
  rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn i hi, physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn j hj]
  unfold cyclicCrossGapPhase crossGapPhase gapPhaseSign
  simp only [if_neg (by omega : i.val + 1 ≠ 0),
    if_neg (by omega : j.val + 1 ≠ 0), mul_one]
  rw [show (j.val + 1) - (i.val + 1) = j.val - i.val from by
    have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega]
  have he : i.val + j.val = (j.val - i.val) + 2 * i.val := by
    have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega
  rw [he, pow_add, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_phase_at_last
statement:
lemma physicalGapCut_phase_at_last (hn : 0 < n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i < j) (hj : j.val + 1 = n) :
    cyclicCrossGapPhase (physicalGapCut hn j) (physicalGapCut hn i) =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.val + 1 < n := by have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega
  rw [physicalGapCut_of_last hn j hj, physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn i hi]
  unfold cyclicCrossGapPhase crossGapPhase gapPhaseSign
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero, if_true,
    if_neg (by omega : i.val + 1 ≠ 0), mul_one]
  rw [← pow_add]
  have he : (i.val + 1) + (n - 1) = i.val + j.val + 1 := by omega
  rw [he, pow_succ]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedGap_sineWronskian_neg
statement:
theorem orderedGap_sineWronskian_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (t : ℝ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      sineWronskian angles.angle (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut hn i))
        (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut hn j)) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < n
  · have hi : i.val + 1 < n := by have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega
    have hcuts : physicalGapCut hn i < physicalGapCut hn j := by
      rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn i hi, physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn j hj]
      change i.val + 1 < j.val + 1
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_right hij 1
    have h := cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg angles
      (physicalGapCut hn i) (physicalGapCut hn j) hcuts t
    rw [physicalGapCut_phase_before_last hn i j hij hj] at h
    exact h
  · have hjlast : j.val + 1 = n := by have h := j.isLt; omega
    have hi : i.val + 1 < n := by have h := (show i.val < j.val from hij); omega
    have hcuts : physicalGapCut hn j < physicalGapCut hn i := by
      rw [physicalGapCut_of_last hn j hjlast, physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn i hi]
      change 0 < i.val + 1
      omega
    have h := cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg angles
      (physicalGapCut hn j) (physicalGapCut hn i) hcuts t
    rw [physicalGapCut_phase_at_last hn i j hij hjlast, sineWronskian_comm] at h
    simpa only [neg_mul_neg] using h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos
statement:
theorem orderedPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) (orderedPeak angles hsize j)
proof:
:= by
  have hcritical := (orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero angles hsize j).deriv
  have h := orderedGap_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij (orderedPeak angles hsize j)
  unfold sineWronskian at h
  change (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
    (orderedGapInterpolant angles i (orderedPeak angles hsize j) *
      deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles j) (orderedPeak angles hsize j) -
        deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) (orderedPeak angles hsize j) *
          orderedGapInterpolant angles j (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) < 0 at h
  rw [hcritical, mul_zero, zero_sub] at h
  have hv : 0 < orderedGapInterpolant angles j (orderedPeak angles hsize j) :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (one_lt_orderedHeight angles hsize j)
  by_contra hpos
  have hnpos := le_of_not_gt hpos
  have hp := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnpos hv.le
  have he : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      -(deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) (orderedPeak angles hsize j) *
        orderedGapInterpolant angles j (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) =
      -(((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) *
          orderedGapInterpolant angles j (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) := by ring
  rw [he] at h
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg
statement:
theorem orderedPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles j) (orderedPeak angles hsize i) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcritical := (orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero angles hsize i).deriv
  have h := orderedGap_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij (orderedPeak angles hsize i)
  unfold sineWronskian at h
  change (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
    (orderedGapInterpolant angles i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) *
      deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles j) (orderedPeak angles hsize i) -
        deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) (orderedPeak angles hsize i) *
          orderedGapInterpolant angles j (orderedPeak angles hsize i)) < 0 at h
  rw [hcritical, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h
  have hv : 0 < orderedGapInterpolant angles i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (one_lt_orderedHeight angles hsize i)
  by_contra hneg
  have hp := mul_nonneg hv.le (le_of_not_gt hneg)
  have he : orderedGapInterpolant angles i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) *
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles j) (orderedPeak angles hsize i)) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        (orderedGapInterpolant angles i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) *
          deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles j) (orderedPeak angles hsize i)) := by ring
  rw [he] at hp
  exact (not_le_of_gt h) hp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.positive_on_right_of_zero_free
statement:
lemma positive_on_right_of_zero_free (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f t ≠ 0) (hb : 0 < f b)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo a b) : 0 < f t
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hpos
  have hnonpos : f t ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hpos
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc ht.2.le
    (hf.mono (by intro x hx; exact ⟨ht.1.le.trans hx.1, hx.2⟩))
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (f t) (f b) from ⟨hnonpos, hb.le⟩)
  have hub : u < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 (by
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at hfu
    exact hb.ne' hfu)
  exact hnozero u ⟨ht.1.trans_le hu.1, hub⟩ hfu

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_pos_of_zero_free_right
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_pos_of_zero_free_right (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (ha : f a = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt f d a) (hdne : d ≠ 0)
    (hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f t ≠ 0) (hb : 0 < f b) : 0 < d
proof:
:= by
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ h : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), h < b - a :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < b - a))
  have hdnonneg : 0 ≤ d := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hnear] with h hh hsmall
    change 0 < h at hh
    have hsample : 0 < f (a + h) :=
      positive_on_right_of_zero_free f hf hnozero hb ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    simp only [ha, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    exact (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hh) hsample).le
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hdnonneg hdne.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (ha : f a = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt f d a) (hdne : d ≠ 0)
    (hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b, f t ≠ 0) : 0 < d * f b
proof:
:= by
  have hbnz := hnozero b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hbnz with hbneg | hbpos
  · have hderivneg : 0 < -d :=
      hasDerivAt_pos_of_zero_free_right (fun t => -f t) hab hf.neg
        (by simp [ha]) hd.neg (neg_ne_zero.mpr hdne)
        (fun t ht => neg_ne_zero.mpr (hnozero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩)) (by linarith)
    have hprod := mul_pos hderivneg (neg_pos.mpr hbneg)
    simpa using hprod
  · exact mul_pos (hasDerivAt_pos_of_zero_free_right f hab hf ha hd hdne
      (fun t ht => hnozero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩) hbpos) hbpos

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_mul_sample_neg_of_zero_free_left
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_mul_sample_neg_of_zero_free_left (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hb : f b = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt f d b) (hdne : d ≠ 0)
    (hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a b, f t ≠ 0) : d * f a < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun t => f (-t)) (-d) (-b) := by
    have hd' : HasDerivAt f d (-(-b)) := by simpa only [neg_neg] using hd
    have h := hd'.comp (-b) (hasDerivAt_neg (-b))
    simpa only [neg_neg, Function.comp_def, mul_neg_one] using h
  have hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (fun t => f (-t)) (Set.Icc (-b) (-a)) :=
    hf.comp continuous_neg.continuousOn (by
      intro t ht
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2])
  have hp := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right (fun t => f (-t))
    (show -b < -a by linarith) hcontinuous (by simpa using hb) hcomp
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr hdne) (by
      intro t ht
      apply hnozero (-t)
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2])
  simp only [neg_neg, neg_mul] at hp
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.endpoint_derivatives_mul_neg_of_zero_free
statement:
lemma endpoint_derivatives_mul_neg_of_zero_free (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b da db : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : Continuous f) (ha : f a = 0) (hb : f b = 0)
    (hda : HasDerivAt f da a) (hdb : HasDerivAt f db b)
    (hdane : da ≠ 0) (hdbne : db ≠ 0)
    (hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f t ≠ 0) : da * db < 0
proof:
:= by
  let m : ℝ := (a + b) / 2
  have ham : a < m := by dsimp [m]; linarith
  have hmb : m < b := by dsimp [m]; linarith
  have hmne : f m ≠ 0 := hnozero m ⟨ham, hmb⟩
  have hleft := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right f ham hf.continuousOn
    ha hda hdane (fun t ht => hnozero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hmb⟩)
  have hright := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_neg_of_zero_free_left f hmb hf.continuousOn
    hb hdb hdbne (fun t ht => hnozero t ⟨ham.trans_le ht.1, ht.2⟩)
  have hprod : (da * f m) * (db * f m) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hleft hright
  have heq : (da * f m) * (db * f m) = (f m) ^ 2 * (da * db) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hprod
  have hsquare : 0 < (f m) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hmne
  by_contra hneg
  exact (not_le_of_gt hprod) (mul_nonneg hsquare.le (le_of_not_gt hneg))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sample_values_mul_neg_of_single_simple_root
statement:
lemma sample_values_mul_neg_of_single_simple_root (f : ℝ → ℝ) {a r b d : ℝ}
    (har : a < r) (hrb : r < b) (hf : Continuous f) (hr : f r = 0)
    (hd : HasDerivAt f d r) (hdne : d ≠ 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a r, f t ≠ 0)
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc r b, f t ≠ 0) : f a * f b < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hl := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_neg_of_zero_free_left f har hf.continuousOn
    hr hd hdne hleft
  have hr' := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right f hrb hf.continuousOn
    hr hd hdne hright
  have hprod : (d * f a) * (d * f b) < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hl hr'
  have heq : (d * f a) * (d * f b) = d ^ 2 * (f a * f b) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hprod
  by_contra hneg
  exact (not_le_of_gt hprod) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg d) (le_of_not_gt hneg))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.positive_residue_propagates_across_interlacing
statement:
lemma positive_residue_propagates_across_interlacing (D T : ℝ → ℝ)
    {a r b da dr db : ℝ} (har : a < r) (hrb : r < b)
    (hD : Continuous D) (hT : Continuous T) (hDa : D a = 0) (hDb : D b = 0)
    (hda : HasDerivAt D da a) (hdb : HasDerivAt D db b)
    (hdane : da ≠ 0) (hdbne : db ≠ 0)
    (hDnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, D t ≠ 0)
    (hTr : T r = 0) (hdr : HasDerivAt T dr r) (hdrne : dr ≠ 0)
    (hTleft : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a r, T t ≠ 0)
    (hTright : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc r b, T t ≠ 0)
    (hresidue : 0 < T a * da) : 0 < T b * db
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv := endpoint_derivatives_mul_neg_of_zero_free D (har.trans hrb) hD
    hDa hDb hda hdb hdane hdbne hDnozero
  have hsample := sample_values_mul_neg_of_single_simple_root T har hrb hT
    hTr hdr hdrne hTleft hTright
  have hp : 0 < (T a * T b) * (da * db) := mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hsample hderiv
  have heq : (T a * T b) * (da * db) = (T a * da) * (T b * db) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hp
  by_contra hpos
  exact (not_le_of_gt hp)
    (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hresidue.le (le_of_not_gt hpos))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.positive_residue_iff_across_interlacing
statement:
lemma positive_residue_iff_across_interlacing (D T : ℝ → ℝ)
    {a r b da dr db : ℝ} (har : a < r) (hrb : r < b)
    (hD : Continuous D) (hT : Continuous T) (hDa : D a = 0) (hDb : D b = 0)
    (hda : HasDerivAt D da a) (hdb : HasDerivAt D db b)
    (hdane : da ≠ 0) (hdbne : db ≠ 0)
    (hDnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, D t ≠ 0)
    (hTr : T r = 0) (hdr : HasDerivAt T dr r) (hdrne : dr ≠ 0)
    (hTleft : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico a r, T t ≠ 0)
    (hTright : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc r b, T t ≠ 0) :
    (0 < T a * da ↔ 0 < T b * db)
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv := endpoint_derivatives_mul_neg_of_zero_free D (har.trans hrb) hD
    hDa hDb hda hdb hdane hdbne hDnozero
  have hsample := sample_values_mul_neg_of_single_simple_root T har hrb hT
    hTr hdr hdrne hTleft hTright
  have hp : 0 < (T a * da) * (T b * db) := by
    have heq : (T a * T b) * (da * db) = (T a * da) * (T b * db) := by ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hsample hderiv
  constructor
  · intro hpos
    by_contra hnot
    exact (not_le_of_gt hp)
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hpos.le (le_of_not_gt hnot))
  · intro hpos
    by_contra hnot
    exact (not_le_of_gt hp)
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hnot) hpos.le)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finite_chain_positive_of_adjacent_iff
statement:
lemma finite_chain_positive_of_adjacent_iff {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ k l : Fin m, k.val + 1 = l.val → (0 < f k ↔ 0 < f l))
    (anchor : Fin m) (hanchor : 0 < f anchor) : ∀ k, 0 < f k
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt anchor.isLt
  let first : Fin m := ⟨0, hm⟩
  have hconst : ∀ v (hv : v < m), (0 < f ⟨v, hv⟩ ↔ 0 < f first) := by
    intro v
    induction v with
    | zero => intro hv; rfl
    | succ v ih =>
      intro hv
      have hv' : v < m := by omega
      exact (hstep ⟨v, hv'⟩ ⟨v + 1, hv⟩ rfl).symm.trans (ih hv')
  have hfirst : 0 < f first := (hconst anchor.val anchor.isLt).mp hanchor
  intro k
  exact (hconst k.val k.isLt).mpr hfirst

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_deriv_mul_pos_of_next_sample
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_deriv_mul_pos_of_next_sample (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) (i : Fin (n - 1))
    (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hib : root i < b)
    (hnoother : ∀ j, root j ∉ Set.Ioc (root i) b) :
    0 < deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) * sineInterpolant θ c b
proof:
:= by
  apply hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right (sineInterpolant θ c) hib
    (continuous_sineInterpolant θ c).continuousOn (hroot i)
    ((differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c (root i)).hasDerivAt)
    (deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots θ c hP root hinj hbound hroot i)
  intro t ht hzero
  have htbound : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨(hbound i).1.trans ht.1.le, ht.2.trans_lt hb.2⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
    (sineInterpolant θ c) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) hP
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c)
    (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ c)
    (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top θ c) root hinj hbound hroot t htbound hzero
  exact hnoother j (by rwa [hj])

theorem angularParameterAmplification_eq_orderedHeightMaximum (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :

      Finset.univ.sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (d + 1))⟩
        (fun i => parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [angularParameterAmplification, angularAmplification_eq_gapHeightMaximum]
    apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro cut _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := physicalGapCut_surjective (Nat.succ_pos d) cut
    have h := Finset.le_sup' (fun i => parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simpa only [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain u.val u.property,
      orderedHeight, hi] using h
  · apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro i _
    exact parameterOrderedHeight_le_angularParameterAmplification hsize u i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_heightDifferenceMap_le_twice_amplification
statement:
theorem norm_heightDifferenceMap_le_twice_amplification (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :
    ‖heightDifferenceMap hsize u‖ ≤ 2 * angularParameterAmplification hsize u
proof:
:= by
  have hamp : 0 < angularParameterAmplification hsize u :=
    zero_lt_one.trans (one_lt_angularParameterAmplification hsize u)
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr
  intro i
  have hpos (j : Fin (d + 1)) : 0 < parameterOrderedHeight hsize j u.val := by
    rw [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain u.val u.property]
    exact zero_lt_one.trans (one_lt_orderedHeight _ hsize j)
  change ‖parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.succ u.val -
      parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.castSucc u.val‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.succ u.val‖ +
        ‖parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.castSucc u.val‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.succ u.val +
        parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.castSucc u.val := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hpos i.succ),
        abs_of_pos (hpos i.castSucc)]
    _ ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize u + angularParameterAmplification hsize u :=
      add_le_add (parameterOrderedHeight_le_angularParameterAmplification hsize u i.succ)
        (parameterOrderedHeight_le_angularParameterAmplification hsize u i.castSucc)
    _ = 2 * angularParameterAmplification hsize u := by ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isCompact_sublevel_angularParameterAmplification
statement:
theorem isCompact_sublevel_angularParameterAmplification (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (M : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {u : angularParameterDomain d | angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ M}
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCompact_preimage_heightDifferenceMap hsize
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Fin d → ℝ) (2 * M))).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_le (continuous_angularParameterAmplification hsize) continuous_const)
  intro u hu
  apply Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
  simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
    (norm_heightDifferenceMap_le_twice_amplification hsize u).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_minimum_angularParameterAmplification
statement:
theorem exists_minimum_angularParameterAmplification (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    ∃ u : angularParameterDomain d, ∀ v : angularParameterDomain d,
      angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize v
proof:
:= by
  let u₀ : angularParameterDomain d :=
    ⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩
  let M := angularParameterAmplification hsize u₀
  let S : Set (angularParameterDomain d) :=
    {u | angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ M}
  have hu₀ : u₀ ∈ S := by
    change angularParameterAmplification hsize u₀ ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize u₀
    exact le_refl _
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmin⟩ :=
    (isCompact_sublevel_angularParameterAmplification hsize M).exists_isMinOn
      ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ (continuous_angularParameterAmplification hsize).continuousOn
  refine ⟨u, fun v => ?_⟩
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S
  · exact hmin hv
  · have hv' : M < angularParameterAmplification hsize v := lt_of_not_ge hv
    exact (hmin hu₀).trans hv'.le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_distinct_root_count
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_distinct_root_count {m : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) (root : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig p P (root i) = 0) : m ≤ p
proof:
:=
  cayley_chart_distinct_root_count p (homogeneousTrig p P) P hP hdegree
    (fun t ht => (homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p P hdegree t ht).symm)
    (homogeneousTrig_pi p P).symm root hinj hbound hroot

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_root_mem_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) (root : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig p P (root i) = 0) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hz : homogeneousTrig p P t = 0) :
    ∃ i, root i = t
proof:
:=
  cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots p (homogeneousTrig p P) P hP hdegree
    (fun t ht => (homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p P hdegree t ht).symm)
    (homogeneousTrig_pi p P).symm root hinj hbound hroot t ht hz

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_chart_root
statement:
lemma deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_chart_root (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0)
    (hz : P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = 0)
    (hd : P.derivative.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) ≠ 0) :
    deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_homogeneousTrig p P hdegree,
    homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p (cayleyOperator p P)
      (cayleyOperator_natDegree_le p P hdegree) t ht,
    cayleyOperator_eval, hz, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
    (mul_ne_zero (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0) hd))
      (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) (root : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig p P (root i) = 0) (i : Fin p) :
    deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) (root i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heval (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0)
      (hz : homogeneousTrig p P t = 0) : P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = 0 := by
    rw [homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p P hdegree t ht] at hz
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
  by_cases hpole : ∃ j, root j = Real.pi
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hpole
    have hp : 0 < p := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt j.isLt
    have htop : P.coeff p = 0 := by
      rw [← homogeneousTrig_pi p P, ← hj]
      exact hroot j
    have hdeglt : P.natDegree < p := by
      by_contra h
      have heq := le_antisymm hdegree (not_lt.mp h)
      have hcoeff := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP
      rw [← Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, heq, htop] at hcoeff
      exact hcoeff rfl
    let rest := (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin p))
    have hcard : Fintype.card rest = p - 1 := by simp [rest]
    have hcos (k : rest) : Real.cos (root k.val / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      apply (cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (root k.val) (hbound k.val)).mpr
      intro h
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp k.property).1 (hinj (h.trans hj.symm))
    have htan : Function.Injective (fun k : rest => Real.tan (root k.val / 2)) := by
      intro k l h
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hinj
      exact tan_half_injOn_Ico ⟨hbound k.val, hcos k⟩ ⟨hbound l.val, hcos l⟩ h
    have hrootP (k : rest) : P.eval (Real.tan (root k.val / 2)) = 0 :=
      heval _ (hcos k) (hroot k.val)
    have hdegRest : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card rest := by rw [hcard]; omega
    have hsat := polynomial_distinct_root_count P hP _ htan hrootP
    have hdegreeEq : P.natDegree = p - 1 := by rw [hcard] at hsat; omega
    have hprevious : P.coeff (p - 1) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hdegreeEq, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
      exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP
    by_cases hi : root i = Real.pi
    · rw [hi, deriv_homogeneousTrig_pi p P hp hdegree]
      exact div_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hprevious) (by norm_num)
    · have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hi (by rw [h, hj])
      let k : rest := ⟨i, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩⟩
      exact deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_chart_root p P hdegree (root i)
        (hcos k) (hrootP k)
        (polynomial_derivative_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots P hP _ htan hdegRest hrootP k)
  · have hcos (j : Fin p) : Real.cos (root j / 2) ≠ 0 :=
      (cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (root j) (hbound j)).mpr
        (fun h => hpole ⟨j, h⟩)
    have htan : Function.Injective (fun j : Fin p => Real.tan (root j / 2)) := by
      intro j k h
      exact hinj (tan_half_injOn_Ico ⟨hbound j, hcos j⟩ ⟨hbound k, hcos k⟩ h)
    have hrootP (j : Fin p) : P.eval (Real.tan (root j / 2)) = 0 :=
      heval _ (hcos j) (hroot j)
    exact deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_chart_root p P hdegree (root i) (hcos i)
      (hrootP i) (polynomial_derivative_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots P hP _ htan
        (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hdegree) hrootP i)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) = sineInterpolant θ c
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.ext_on dense_cos_half_ne_zero
    (continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _) (continuous_sineInterpolant θ c)
  intro t ht
  rw [homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _ (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) t ht,
    cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ c t ht]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t =
      homogeneousTrig (n - 1) (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)) t / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial θ c]
  exact deriv_homogeneousTrig _ _ (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial θ c]
  exact deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots _ _ hP
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) root hinj hbound
    (by rwa [homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial θ c]) i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne
statement:
lemma cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : sineInterpolant θ c a ≠ sineInterpolant θ c b) :
    cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hab
  apply is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c)
  intro t
  rw [deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley, hzero]
  simp [homogeneousTrig]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count {m : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0) (root : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) = 0) : m ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply homogeneousTrig_distinct_root_count _ _ hP (derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le θ c)
    root hinj hbound
  intro i
  have h := hroot i
  rw [deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley] at h
  exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h).resolve_right (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_deriv_roots
statement:
lemma second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_deriv_roots
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0)
    (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) = 0) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant θ c)) (root i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrootH (j : Fin (n - 1)) : homogeneousTrig (n - 1)
      (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)) (root j) = 0 := by
    have h := hroot j
    rw [deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley] at h
    exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h).resolve_right (by norm_num)
  have hsimple := deriv_homogeneousTrig_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots _ _ hP
    (derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) root hinj hbound hrootH i
  have heq : deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) = fun t => homogeneousTrig (n - 1)
      (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)) t / 2 :=
    funext (deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley θ c)
  rw [heq, deriv_div_const]
  exact div_ne_zero hsimple (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_root_mem_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0)
    (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) = 0) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t = 0) :
    ∃ i, root i = t
proof:
:= by
  have hconvert (s : ℝ) (hs : deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) s = 0) : homogeneousTrig (n - 1)
      (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)) s = 0 := by
    rw [deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley] at hs
    exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hs).resolve_right (by norm_num)
  exact homogeneousTrig_root_mem_of_saturated_roots _ _ hP
    (derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) root hinj hbound
    (fun i => hconvert _ (hroot i)) t ht (hconvert t hz)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_at_critical
statement:
lemma second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_at_critical (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0)
    (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (root i) = 0) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t = 0) :
    deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant θ c)) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := deriv_sineInterpolant_root_mem_of_saturated_roots θ c hP
    root hinj hbound hroot t ht hz
  rw [← hi]
  exact second_deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_deriv_roots θ c hP
    root hinj hbound hroot i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_sineInterpolant_cyclic_deriv_roots
statement:
lemma exists_sineInterpolant_cyclic_deriv_roots (hn : 1 < n)
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) :
    ∃ point : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, Function.Injective point ∧
      (∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (point i) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_cyclic_deriv_roots (by omega) (2 * Real.pi) (by positivity)
    root hmono hbound _ (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c) hroot
  · intro t ht
    exact (sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff θ c t).mpr ht
  · intro t ht
    rw [deriv_sineInterpolant] at ht ⊢
    exact (sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff θ c t).mp ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) ≠ 0)
    (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) :
    ∃ critical : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, Function.Injective critical ∧
      (∀ i, critical i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (critical i) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, critical i ∈ cyclicRootArc (by omega) root (2 * Real.pi) i) ∧
      (∀ i t, t ∈ cyclicRootArc (by omega) root (2 * Real.pi) i →
        deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t = 0 → t = critical i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨point, hpoint, hzero, hinj, hbound', hzero'⟩ :=
    exists_cyclic_rolle_points hp (2 * Real.pi) (by positivity) root hmono hbound
      (sineInterpolant θ c) (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c) hroot
      (fun t ht => (sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff θ c t).mpr ht)
      (fun t ht => by
        rw [deriv_sineInterpolant] at ht ⊢
        exact (sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff θ c t).mp ht)
  let critical := fun i => cyclicRolleReduce (2 * Real.pi) (point i)
  refine ⟨critical, hinj, hbound', hzero', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact cyclicRolleReduce_mem_arc hp root _ hbound point hpoint i
  · intro i t ht hz
    have htbound : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      cyclicRootArc_mem_Ico hp root _ hbound ht
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := deriv_sineInterpolant_root_mem_of_saturated_roots θ c hP
      critical hinj hbound' hzero' t htbound hz
    have hji : j = i := cyclicRolleReduce_index_eq_of_mem_arc hp root _ hmono hbound
      point hpoint (by change critical j ∈ _; rwa [hj])
    rw [hji] at hj
    exact hj.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.fderiv_comp_inr_eq_smul_of_hasDeriv
statement:
lemma fderiv_comp_inr_eq_smul_of_hasDeriv {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : E × ℝ → ℝ} {u : E} {x c : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (u, x))
    (hx : HasDerivAt (fun y => f (u, y)) c x) :
    (fderiv ℝ f (u, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E ℝ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) c
proof:
:= by
  have hcurve : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (u, y))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E ℝ) x := by
    convert (hasFDerivAt_const (x := x) (c := u)).prodMk
      (hasFDerivAt_id x) using 1 <;> rfl
  have hcomp := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x hcurve
  exact hcomp.unique hx

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isInvertible_smulRight_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma isInvertible_smulRight_of_ne_zero (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) c).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsInvertible.of_inverse
    (g := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) c⁻¹)
  · ext
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    field_simp [hc]
  · ext
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
      one_apply_eq_self, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    field_simp [hc]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap (m : ℕ∞ω) (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (t : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (orderedCriticalMap hn k) (angles.angle, t)
proof:
:=
  contDiffAt_deriv_sineInterpolant_joint m angles.angle t
    (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut hn k)) angles.phaseNodes_injective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedCriticalMap_vertical
statement:
lemma orderedCriticalMap_vertical (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (k : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (orderedCriticalMap hn k) (angles.angle, t)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
        (deriv (deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles k)) t)
proof:
:= by
  apply fderiv_comp_inr_eq_smul_of_hasDeriv
    ((contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap 1 angles t k).differentiableAt (by norm_num))
  have hsection : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles k)) t := by
    exact (contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap 1 angles t k).comp t
      (contDiffAt_const.prodMk contDiffAt_id)
  exact (hsection.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedCriticalMap_vertical_isInvertible
statement:
lemma orderedCriticalMap_vertical_isInvertible (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    (fderiv ℝ (orderedCriticalMap hn k) (angles.angle, orderedPeak angles hsize k) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) ℝ).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedCriticalMap_vertical]
  exact isInvertible_smulRight_of_ne_zero _
    (ne_of_lt (orderedPeak_second_deriv_neg angles hsize k))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.localOrderedPeak_eq_at_base
statement:
lemma localOrderedPeak_eq_at_base (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (k : Fin n) : localOrderedPeak angles hsize k angles.angle = orderedPeak angles hsize k
proof:
:=
  ContDiffAt.implicitFunction_apply_self
    (contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap ∞ angles (orderedPeak angles hsize k) k)
    (by simp) (orderedCriticalMap_vertical_isInvertible angles hsize k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_localOrderedPeak
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_localOrderedPeak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (k : Fin n) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (localOrderedPeak angles hsize k) angles.angle
proof:
:=
  ContDiffAt.contDiffAt_implicitFunction
    (contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap ∞ angles (orderedPeak angles hsize k) k)
    (by simp) (orderedCriticalMap_vertical_isInvertible angles hsize k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localOrderedPeak_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localOrderedPeak_eq_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ᶠ θ in 𝓝 angles.angle, orderedCriticalMap hn k (θ, localOrderedPeak angles hsize k θ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := ContDiffAt.eventually_apply_implicitFunction
    (contDiffAt_orderedCriticalMap ∞ angles (orderedPeak angles hsize k) k) (by simp)
      (orderedCriticalMap_vertical_isInvertible angles hsize k)
  have hz : orderedCriticalMap hn k (angles.angle, orderedPeak angles hsize k) = 0 :=
    (orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero angles hsize k).deriv
  rwa [hz] at h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.localParameterPeak_eq_at_base
statement:
lemma localParameterPeak_eq_at_base (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    localParameterPeak angles hsize k angles.interiorParameters = orderedPeak angles hsize k
proof:
:= by
  rw [localParameterPeak, angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters, localOrderedPeak_eq_at_base]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_localParameterPeak
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_localParameterPeak (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (localParameterPeak angles hsize k) angles.interiorParameters
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (localOrderedPeak angles hsize k)
      (angularParameterAngles angles.interiorParameters) := by
    rw [angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters]
    exact contDiffAt_localOrderedPeak angles hsize k
  exact hbase.comp angles.interiorParameters (contDiff_angularParameterAngles ∞).contDiffAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localParameterPeak_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localParameterPeak_eq_zero
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 angles.interiorParameters,
      orderedCriticalMap (Nat.succ_pos d) k
        (angularParameterAngles u, localParameterPeak angles hsize k u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto angularParameterAngles (𝓝 angles.interiorParameters) (𝓝 angles.angle) := by
    simpa only [angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters] using
      (continuous_angularParameterAngles.continuousAt
        (x := angles.interiorParameters)).tendsto
  exact ht.eventually (eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localOrderedPeak_eq_zero angles hsize k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_angularParameterGapRight
statement:
lemma continuous_angularParameterGapRight (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    Continuous (angularParameterGapRight k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold angularParameterGapRight
  split_ifs
  · exact continuous_angularParameterAngle _
  · exact continuous_const

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterGapRight_ofParameters
statement:
lemma angularParameterGapRight_ofParameters (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    angularParameterGapRight k u = cyclicGapRight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) k
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_localParameterPeak_mem_gap
statement:
lemma eventually_localParameterPeak_mem_gap
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 angles.interiorParameters,
      localParameterPeak angles hsize k u ∈
        Set.Ioo (angularParameterAngles u k) (angularParameterGapRight k u)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont := (contDiffAt_localParameterPeak angles hsize k).continuousAt
  have hgap := orderedPeak_mem_node_gap angles hsize k
  have hleft : angularParameterAngles angles.interiorParameters k <
      localParameterPeak angles hsize k angles.interiorParameters := by
    rw [angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters, localParameterPeak_eq_at_base]
    exact hgap.1
  have hright : localParameterPeak angles hsize k angles.interiorParameters <
      angularParameterGapRight k angles.interiorParameters := by
    rw [localParameterPeak_eq_at_base]
    simpa only [angularParameterGapRight, cyclicGapRight,
      angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters] using hgap.2
  exact ((continuous_angularParameterAngle k).continuousAt.eventually_lt hcont hleft).and
    (hcont.eventually_lt (continuous_angularParameterGapRight k).continuousAt hright)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_localParameterPeak_eq_orderedPeak
statement:
lemma eventually_localParameterPeak_eq_orderedPeak
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 angles.interiorParameters, ∀ hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d,
      localParameterPeak angles hsize k u =
        orderedPeak (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_orderedCriticalMap_localParameterPeak_eq_zero angles hsize k,
    eventually_localParameterPeak_mem_gap angles hsize k] with u hcritical hgap
  intro hu
  apply eq_orderedPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k
  · simpa only [cyclicAnglesOfParameters_angle, ← angularParameterGapRight_ofParameters u hu k]
      using hgap
  · exact hcritical

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain
statement:
lemma parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedPeak hsize k u = orderedPeak (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterOrderedPeak, dif_pos hu]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain
statement:
lemma parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize k u = orderedHeight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterOrderedHeight, dif_pos hu]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterOrderedHeight_eq_value_at_peak
statement:
lemma parameterOrderedHeight_eq_value_at_peak (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize k u =
      sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles u)
        (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) k))
        (parameterOrderedPeak hsize k u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain u hu, parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain u hu]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_parameterOrderedPeak_eq_localParameterPeak
statement:
lemma eventually_parameterOrderedPeak_eq_localParameterPeak
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedPeak hsize k =ᶠ[𝓝 angles.interiorParameters]
      localParameterPeak angles hsize k
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(isOpen_angularParameterDomain d).eventually_mem
      angles.interiorParameters_mem_domain,
    eventually_localParameterPeak_eq_orderedPeak angles hsize k] with u hu heq
  rw [parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain u hu]
  exact (heq hu).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (parameterOrderedPeak hsize k) angles.interiorParameters
proof:
:=
  (contDiffAt_localParameterPeak angles hsize k).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (eventually_parameterOrderedPeak_eq_localParameterPeak angles hsize k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (parameterOrderedPeak hsize k) u
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_ofParameters] using
    contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_localParameterHeight
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_localParameterHeight
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (localParameterHeight angles hsize k) angles.interiorParameters
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun x : (Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        sineInterpolant x.1 (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) k)) x.2)
      (angularParameterAngles angles.interiorParameters,
        localParameterPeak angles hsize k angles.interiorParameters) := by
    rw [angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters, localParameterPeak_eq_at_base]
    exact contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint ∞ angles.angle (orderedPeak angles hsize k)
      (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) k)) angles.phaseNodes_injective
  have hcomp := hbase.comp angles.interiorParameters
    ((contDiff_angularParameterAngles ∞).contDiffAt.prodMk
      (contDiffAt_localParameterPeak angles hsize k))
  exact hcomp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_localParameterHeight_eq_orderedHeight
statement:
lemma eventually_localParameterHeight_eq_orderedHeight
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 angles.interiorParameters, ∀ hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d,
      localParameterHeight angles hsize k u =
        orderedHeight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_localParameterPeak_eq_orderedPeak angles hsize k] with u heq
  intro hu
  rw [localParameterHeight, heq hu]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_parameterOrderedHeight_eq_localParameterHeight
statement:
lemma eventually_parameterOrderedHeight_eq_localParameterHeight
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize k =ᶠ[𝓝 angles.interiorParameters]
      localParameterHeight angles hsize k
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(isOpen_angularParameterDomain d).eventually_mem
      angles.interiorParameters_mem_domain,
    eventually_localParameterHeight_eq_orderedHeight angles hsize k] with u hu heq
  rw [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain u hu]
  exact (heq hu).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_parameterOrderedHeight
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_parameterOrderedHeight
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (parameterOrderedHeight hsize k) angles.interiorParameters
proof:
:=
  (contDiffAt_localParameterHeight angles hsize k).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (eventually_parameterOrderedHeight_eq_localParameterHeight angles hsize k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (parameterOrderedHeight hsize k) u
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_ofParameters] using
    contDiffAt_parameterOrderedHeight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_of_next_lt
statement:
lemma physicalGapCut_of_next_lt (hn : 0 < n) (k : Fin n) (h : k.val + 1 < n) :
    physicalGapCut hn k = ⟨k.val + 1, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [physicalGapCut, dif_pos h]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_of_last
statement:
lemma physicalGapCut_of_last (hn : 0 < n) (k : Fin n) (h : k.val + 1 = n) :
    physicalGapCut hn k = ⟨0, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [physicalGapCut, h]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_injective
statement: lemma physicalGapCut_injective (hn : 0 < n) : Function.Injective (physicalGapCut hn)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l heq
  apply Fin.ext
  have hkn := k.isLt
  have hln := l.isLt
  by_cases hk : k.val + 1 < n
  · by_cases hl : l.val + 1 < n
    · rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn k hk, physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn l hl] at heq
      have hv : k.val + 1 = l.val + 1 := congrArg Fin.val heq
      omega
    · have hl' : l.val + 1 = n := by omega
      rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn k hk, physicalGapCut_of_last hn l hl'] at heq
      have hv : k.val + 1 = 0 := congrArg Fin.val heq
      omega
  · by_cases hl : l.val + 1 < n
    · have hk' : k.val + 1 = n := by omega
      rw [physicalGapCut_of_last hn k hk', physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn l hl] at heq
      have hv : 0 = l.val + 1 := congrArg Fin.val heq
      omega
    · omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.physicalGapCut_surjective
statement: lemma physicalGapCut_surjective (hn : 0 < n) : Function.Surjective (physicalGapCut hn)
proof:
:=
  Finite.surjective_of_injective (physicalGapCut_injective hn)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_physicalGapCut
statement:
lemma gapLeft_physicalGapCut (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (k : Fin n) :
    gapLeft angles (physicalGapCut hn k) = angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k.val + 1 < n
  · have hpred : gapPredecessor (⟨k.val + 1, hk⟩ : Fin n) = k := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [gapPredecessor]
    rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn k hk, gapLeft_of_pos angles _ (by simp), hpred]
  · have hlast : k = lastNodeIndex hn := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change k.val = n - 1
      have hkn := k.isLt
      omega
    have hkn : k.val + 1 = n := by have h := k.isLt; omega
    rw [physicalGapCut_of_last hn k hkn, gapLeft_zero, hlast]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapRight_physicalGapCut
statement:
lemma gapRight_physicalGapCut (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (k : Fin n) :
    gapRight angles (physicalGapCut hn k) = cyclicGapRight angles k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k.val + 1 < n
  · rw [physicalGapCut_of_next_lt hn k hk, gapRight_of_pos angles _ (by simp)]
    simp only [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hk]
  · have hkn : k.val + 1 = n := by have h := k.isLt; omega
    rw [physicalGapCut_of_last hn k hkn, gapRight_zero]
    simp only [cyclicGapRight, dif_neg hk]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_mem_node_gap
statement:
lemma orderedPeak_mem_node_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    orderedPeak angles hsize k ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle k) (cyclicGapRight angles k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k)
  rw [gapLeft_physicalGapCut, gapRight_physicalGapCut] at h
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGapRight_le_angle_of_lt
statement:
lemma cyclicGapRight_le_angle_of_lt (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {k l : Fin n}
    (hkl : k < l) : cyclicGapRight angles k ≤ angles.angle l
proof:
:= by
  have hk : k.val + 1 < n := by
    have hklval : k.val < l.val := hkl
    have hln := l.isLt
    omega
  rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hk]
  exact angles.strictMono.monotone (show (⟨k.val + 1, hk⟩ : Fin n) ≤ l from hkl)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_strictMono
statement:
lemma orderedPeak_strictMono (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    StrictMono (orderedPeak angles hsize)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl
  exact ((orderedPeak_mem_node_gap angles hsize k).2.trans_le
    (cyclicGapRight_le_angle_of_lt angles hkl)).trans
      (orderedPeak_mem_node_gap angles hsize l).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma orderedPeak_mem_Ioo (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    orderedPeak angles hsize k ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapPeak_mem_turn angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k)
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero
statement:
lemma orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (k : Fin n) : HasDerivAt (orderedGapInterpolant angles k) 0 (orderedPeak angles hsize k)
proof:
:=
  (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k)).hasDerivAt_zero

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedHeight_eq_value
statement:
lemma orderedHeight_eq_value (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    orderedHeight angles hsize k = orderedGapInterpolant angles k (orderedPeak angles hsize k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_lt_orderedHeight
statement:
lemma one_lt_orderedHeight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (k : Fin n) :
    1 < orderedHeight angles hsize k
proof:
:=
  one_lt_gapHeight angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeak_second_deriv_neg
statement:
lemma orderedPeak_second_deriv_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (k : Fin n) : deriv (deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles k)) (orderedPeak angles hsize k) < 0
proof:
:=
  gapPeak_second_deriv_neg angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapWidth_pos
statement:
lemma gapWidth_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    0 < gapWidth angles cut
proof: := sub_pos.mpr (gapLeft_lt_gapRight angles cut)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapWidth_le_two_pi
statement:
lemma gapWidth_le_two_pi (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapWidth angles cut ≤ 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have ha := gapLeft_nonneg angles cut
  have hb := gapRight_le_two_pi angles cut
  dsimp [gapWidth]
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapMidpoint_mem_gapInterval
statement:
lemma gapMidpoint_mem_gapInterval (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapMidpoint angles cut ∈ gapInterval angles cut
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapLeft_lt_gapRight angles cut
  change gapLeft angles cut < (gapLeft angles cut + gapRight angles cut) / 2 ∧
    (gapLeft angles cut + gapRight angles cut) / 2 < gapRight angles cut
  constructor <;> linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.node_angle_outside_gap
statement:
lemma node_angle_outside_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut k : Fin n) :
    angles.angle k ≤ gapLeft angles cut ∨ gapRight angles cut ≤ angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · left
    rw [gapLeft_of_zero angles cut hzero]
    exact angles.strictMono.monotone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt k.isLt)
  · have hc : 0 < cut.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    by_cases hk : k < cut
    · left
      rw [gapLeft_of_pos angles cut hc]
      apply angles.strictMono.monotone
      change k.val ≤ cut.val - 1
      have h := (show k.val < cut.val from hk)
      omega
    · right
      rw [gapRight_of_pos angles cut hc]
      exact angles.strictMono.monotone (le_of_not_gt hk)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapMidpoint_uniform_chord_lower_bound
statement:
theorem gapMidpoint_uniform_chord_lower_bound (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (cut : Fin n) (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) (hwidth : width ≤ gapWidth angles cut) :
    0 < 2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ∧ ∀ k,
      2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ≤
        ‖(Circle.exp (gapMidpoint angles cut) : ℂ) - phaseNodes angles.angle k‖
proof:
:= by
  have h (k : Fin n) := norm_phase_midpoint_sub_uniform_lower_bound width
    (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut) (angles.angle k) hw hwidth
    (gapLeft_nonneg angles cut) (gapLeft_lt_gapRight angles cut)
    (gapRight_le_two_pi angles cut) (angles.nonneg k) (angles.lt_two_pi k).le
    (node_angle_outside_gap angles cut k)
  exact ⟨(h ⟨0, hn⟩).1, fun k => (h k).2⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exp_gapLeft
statement:
lemma exp_gapLeft (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    Circle.exp (gapLeft angles cut) = Circle.exp (angles.angle (gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0 <;> simp [gapLeft, gapLeftNodeIndex, hzero]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exp_gapRight
statement:
lemma exp_gapRight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    Circle.exp (gapRight angles cut) = Circle.exp (angles.angle cut)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · have heq : cut = ⟨0, hn⟩ := Fin.ext hzero
    rw [gapRight_of_zero angles cut hzero, heq, angles.first_eq_zero]
    simp
  · rw [gapRight_of_pos angles cut (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero)]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeftNodeIndex_ne_cut
statement:
lemma gapLeftNodeIndex_ne_cut (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut ≠ cut
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val heq
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · simp only [gapLeftNodeIndex, if_pos hzero, lastNodeIndex, Fin.val_mk] at hv
    omega
  · simp only [gapLeftNodeIndex, if_neg hzero, gapPredecessor, Fin.val_mk] at hv
    have hpos := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub_leftNode_le_gapWidth
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub_leftNode_le_gapWidth (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut) :
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - phaseNodes angles.angle (gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut)‖ ≤
      gapWidth angles cut
proof:
:= by
  change ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp (angles.angle (gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut)) : ℂ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [← exp_gapLeft]
  have h := norm_phase_sub_le_abs_sub t (gapLeft angles cut)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.1.le)] at h
  exact h.trans (sub_le_sub_right ht.2.le _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub_rightNode_le_gapWidth
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub_rightNode_le_gapWidth (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut) :
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - phaseNodes angles.angle cut‖ ≤ gapWidth angles cut
proof:
:= by
  change ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp (angles.angle cut) : ℂ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [← exp_gapRight]
  have h := norm_phase_sub_le_abs_sub t (gapRight angles cut)
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr ht.2.le), neg_sub] at h
  exact h.trans (sub_le_sub_left ht.1.le _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterval_near_other_node
statement:
theorem gapInterval_near_other_node (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (cut : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut) (k : Fin n) :
    ∃ l, l ≠ k ∧ ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - phaseNodes angles.angle l‖ ≤ gapWidth angles cut
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k = gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut
  · subst k
    exact ⟨cut, (gapLeftNodeIndex_ne_cut hsize cut).symm,
      norm_phase_sub_rightNode_le_gapWidth angles cut ht⟩
  · exact ⟨gapLeftNodeIndex hn cut, (fun h => hk h.symm),
      norm_phase_sub_leftNode_le_gapWidth angles cut ht⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_wrapInterpolant_strict_peak
statement:
theorem exists_wrapInterpolant_strict_peak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ peak : ℝ,
      StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (2 * Real.pi) peak ∧
      1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient)) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  let first : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, hp⟩
  let last : Fin (n - 1) := lastNodeIndex hp
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hlocations, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize
  have hfirst_pos : 0 < root first := by
    have h := (hlocations first).1
    simpa only [first, Fin.val_mk, angles.first_eq_zero] using h
  have hlast_succ : last.val + 1 = n - 1 := by
    dsimp only [last, lastNodeIndex]
    omega
  have hlast_node :
      (⟨last.val + 1, by have := last.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin n) = lastNodeIndex hn := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hlast_succ
  have hlast_lt_node : root last < angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn) := by
    have h := (hlocations last).2
    rwa [hlast_node] at h
  have hfirst_le_last : root first ≤ root last :=
    hmono.monotone (show first ≤ last from Nat.zero_le last.val)
  have hlast_final : ¬last.val + 1 < n - 1 := by omega
  have hnode : f (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) = 1 := wrapInterpolant_at_last angles
  have hturn : f (2 * Real.pi) = 1 := wrapInterpolant_at_two_pi angles
  have hcont : Continuous f := continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f := differentiable_sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
  have hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle wrapCoefficient) ≠ 0 := by
    apply cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne angles.angle wrapCoefficient
      (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (root first)
    rw [wrapInterpolant_at_last, hroot first]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨critical, _hinj, _hcriticalBound, _hcriticalZero, _hcriticalArc, hcriticalUnique⟩ :=
    sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing hsize angles.angle wrapCoefficient hP
      root hmono hbound hroot
  obtain ⟨peak, hpeakGap, hpeakZero⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero
    (angles.lt_two_pi (lastNodeIndex hn)) hcont.continuousOn (hnode.trans hturn.symm)
    (fun t _ => (hdiff t).hasDerivAt)
  have hpeakArc : peak ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
    rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
    exact ⟨⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans hpeakGap.1.le, hpeakGap.2⟩,
      Or.inl (hlast_lt_node.trans hpeakGap.1)⟩
  have hcritical_peak : critical last = peak :=
    (hcriticalUnique last peak hpeakArc hpeakZero).symm
  have harc_unique (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last)
      (hz : deriv f t = 0) : t = peak :=
    (hcriticalUnique last t ht hz).trans hcritical_peak
  have houter_unique (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (root last) (root first + 2 * Real.pi))
      (hz : deriv f t = 0) : t = peak := by
    by_cases htturn : t < 2 * Real.pi
    · apply harc_unique t
      · rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
        exact ⟨⟨(hbound last).1.trans ht.1.le, htturn⟩, Or.inl ht.1⟩
      · exact hz
    · have hreduce_nonneg : 0 ≤ t - 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
      have hreduce_first : t - 2 * Real.pi < root first := by linarith [ht.2]
      have hreduceArc : t - 2 * Real.pi ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
        rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
        exact ⟨⟨hreduce_nonneg, hreduce_first.trans (hbound first).2⟩, Or.inr hreduce_first⟩
      have hreduceZero : deriv f (t - 2 * Real.pi) = 0 := by
        change deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) (t - 2 * Real.pi) = 0
        change deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) t = 0 at hz
        rw [deriv_sineInterpolant] at hz ⊢
        apply (sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff angles.angle wrapCoefficient
          (t - 2 * Real.pi)).mp
        simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hz
      have hreduce_eq := harc_unique _ hreduceArc hreduceZero
      have hfirst_lt_peak : root first < peak :=
        hfirst_le_last.trans_lt (hlast_lt_node.trans hpeakGap.1)
      rw [hreduce_eq] at hreduce_first
      exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hfirst_lt_peak.le) hreduce_first)
  have hnodeOuter : angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn) ∈
      Set.Ioo (root last) (root first + 2 * Real.pi) := by
    constructor
    · exact hlast_lt_node
    · have h := angles.lt_two_pi (lastNodeIndex hn)
      linarith
  have houterRoot : f (root first + 2 * Real.pi) = 0 :=
    (sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff angles.angle wrapCoefficient (root first)).mpr
      (hroot first)
  obtain ⟨houterPeak, _hpositive⟩ := strict_interval_peak_of_unique_critical
    (hnodeOuter.1.trans hnodeOuter.2) hcont.continuousOn hdiff.differentiableOn
    (hroot last) houterRoot houter_unique
    (show ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (root last) (root first + 2 * Real.pi), (0 : ℝ) < f x from
      ⟨_, hnodeOuter, by rw [hnode]; norm_num⟩)
  have hvalue : 1 < f peak := by
    have h := houterPeak.lt_of_ne (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hnodeOuter) (ne_of_lt hpeakGap.1)
    rwa [hnode] at h
  have hsubset : Set.Icc (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (2 * Real.pi) ⊆
      Set.Icc (root last) (root first + 2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro t ht
    constructor
    · exact hlast_lt_node.le.trans ht.1
    · have hfirst_nonneg := hfirst_pos.le
      linarith [ht.2]
  have hpeak : StrictIntervalPeak f (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (2 * Real.pi) peak := by
    refine ⟨hpeakGap, houterPeak.hasDerivAt_zero, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      exact houterPeak.isMaxOn (hsubset ht)
    · intro t ht
      exact houterPeak.eq_iff t (hsubset ht)
  have hpeakBound : peak ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans hpeakGap.1.le, hpeakGap.2⟩
  have hsecond := wrapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate angles hsize peak hpeakBound hpeakZero
  exact ⟨peak, hpeak, hvalue, hpeak.second_deriv_neg hcont.continuousOn hsecond⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomial_eq_finiteRootProduct_mul_C
statement:
lemma polynomial_eq_finiteRootProduct_mul_C {m : ℕ}
    (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (r : Fin m → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective r)
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ m) (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (r i) = 0) :
    ∃ scale : ℝ, scale ≠ 0 ∧ P = finiteRootProduct r * C scale
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : ℝ[X] := finiteRootProduct r
  have hMmonic : M.Monic := by
    change (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)), (X - C (r i))).Monic
    exact monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun i _hi => monic_X_sub_C (r i)
  have hMdegree : M.natDegree = m := by
    change (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)), (X - C (r i))).natDegree = m
    rw [natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hdvd : M ∣ P := by
    change (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (r i))) ∣ P
    apply Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
    · exact pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C hinj
    · intro i
      rw [Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot, Polynomial.IsRoot]
      exact hroot i
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdvd
  have hQne : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at hQ
    exact hP hQ
  have hQdegree : Q.natDegree = 0 := by
    have hproduct : (M * Q).natDegree ≤ m := by rw [← hQ]; exact hdegree
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul hMmonic.ne_zero hQne, hMdegree] at hproduct
    omega
  obtain ⟨scale, hscale⟩ := Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero.mp hQdegree
  refine ⟨scale, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hz
    apply hQne
    rw [← hscale, hz, Polynomial.C_0]
  · rw [← hscale] at hQ
    exact hQ

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomialWronskian_neg_of_saturated_root_residues
statement:
lemma polynomialWronskian_neg_of_saturated_root_residues {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P Q : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (r : Fin m → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective r)
    (hPdegree : P.natDegree ≤ m) (hQdegree : Q.natDegree ≤ m)
    (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (r i) = 0)
    (hresidue : ∀ i, 0 < Q.eval (r i) * P.derivative.eval (r i)) (x : ℝ) :
    polynomialWronskian P Q x < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨scale, hscale, hfactor⟩ :=
    polynomial_eq_finiteRootProduct_mul_C P hP r hinj hPdegree hroot
  rw [hfactor] at hresidue ⊢
  exact finite_markov_wronskian_neg hm r hinj scale hscale Q hQdegree hresidue x

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_residue_pos_on_chart
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_residue_pos_on_chart
    (θ d c : Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hcos : Real.cos (r / 2) ≠ 0)
    (hroot : sineInterpolant θ d r = 0)
    (hresidue : 0 < sineInterpolant θ c r * deriv (sineInterpolant θ d) r) :
    0 < (interpolantPolynomial θ c).eval (Real.tan (r / 2)) *
      (interpolantPolynomial θ d).derivative.eval (Real.tan (r / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hPeval : (interpolantPolynomial θ d).eval (Real.tan (r / 2)) = 0 := by
    have hz := (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ d r hcos).trans hroot
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hcos)
  have hW : sineWronskian θ d c r < 0 := by
    unfold sineWronskian
    rw [hroot, zero_mul, zero_sub]
    nlinarith
  have hpolyW := (sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_iff θ d c r hcos).mp hW
  unfold polynomialWronskian at hpolyW
  rw [hPeval, zero_mul, zero_sub] at hpolyW
  nlinarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_of_saturated_root_residues
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_of_saturated_root_residues
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (θ d c : Fin n → ℝ) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (htan : Function.Injective (fun i => Real.tan (root i / 2)))
    (hcos : ∀ i, Real.cos (root i / 2) ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ d (root i) = 0)
    (hresidue : ∀ i,
      0 < sineInterpolant θ c (root i) * deriv (sineInterpolant θ d) (root i))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) : sineWronskian θ d c t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  have hPeval : ∀ i,
      (interpolantPolynomial θ d).eval (Real.tan (root i / 2)) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hz := (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ d (root i) (hcos i)).trans
      (hroot i)
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (hcos i))
  have hpresidue : ∀ i,
      0 < (interpolantPolynomial θ c).eval (Real.tan (root i / 2)) *
        (interpolantPolynomial θ d).derivative.eval (Real.tan (root i / 2)) :=
    fun i => interpolantPolynomial_residue_pos_on_chart θ d c (root i)
      (hcos i) (hroot i) (hresidue i)
  have hP : interpolantPolynomial θ d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hpos := hpresidue ⟨0, hm⟩
    simp only [hz, Polynomial.derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero, mul_zero,
      lt_self_iff_false] at hpos
  apply sineWronskian_neg_of_polynomialWronskian_neg θ d c t ht
  exact polynomialWronskian_neg_of_saturated_root_residues hm
    (interpolantPolynomial θ d) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) hP
    (fun i => Real.tan (root i / 2)) htan
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ d) (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c)
    hPeval hpresidue (Real.tan (t / 2))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_neg_of_cyclic_root_residues
statement:
theorem sineWronskian_neg_of_cyclic_root_residues
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (θ d c : Fin n → ℝ) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ d (root i) = 0)
    (hresidue : ∀ i,
      0 < sineInterpolant θ c (root i) * deriv (sineInterpolant θ d) (root i))
    (t : ℝ) : sineWronskian θ d c t < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ht, hcos⟩ := exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero_roots_and_point root t
  rw [← sineWronskian_shift θ d c a t]
  apply sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_of_saturated_root_residues hn
    (shiftedAngles θ a) d c (fun i => root i + a)
    (shifted_tan_half_injective root hinj hbound a hcos) hcos
  · intro i
    rw [sineInterpolant_shift]
    exact hroot i
  · intro i
    rw [sineInterpolant_shift, deriv_sineInterpolant_shift]
    exact hresidue i
  · exact ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_gapMidpoint_le_gapHeight
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_gapMidpoint_le_gapHeight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp (gapMidpoint angles cut) : ℂ) ≤
      gapHeight angles hsize cut
proof:
:= by
  rw [lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval angles cut (gapMidpoint_mem_gapInterval angles cut)]
  exact (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize cut).isMaxOn
    (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (gapMidpoint_mem_gapInterval angles cut))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_width_comparison
statement:
theorem gapHeight_width_comparison (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (large small : Fin n) (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width)
    (hwidth : width ≤ gapWidth angles large) :
    2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1) * gapHeight angles hsize small ≤
      gapWidth angles small * gapHeight angles hsize large
proof:
:= by
  have hsep := gapMidpoint_uniform_chord_lower_bound angles large width hw hwidth
  have hnear := gapInterval_near_other_node angles hsize small
    (gapPeak_mem_gapInterval angles hsize small)
  have h := circle_lebesgue_comparison hsize angles.toNodeFamily.point
    angles.toNodeFamily.injective (Circle.exp (gapMidpoint angles large))
    (Circle.exp (gapPeak angles hsize small)) (2 * Real.sin (width / 4))
    (gapWidth angles small) hsep.1 (gapWidth_pos angles small) hsep.2 hnear
  have hsmall := (gapHeight_eq_lebesgueFunction angles hsize small).symm
  change lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle)
    (Circle.exp (gapPeak angles hsize small) : ℂ) = gapHeight angles hsize small at hsmall
  change 2 * ((2 * Real.sin (width / 4)) / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp (gapPeak angles hsize small) : ℂ) ≤
      gapWidth angles small * lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle)
        (Circle.exp (gapMidpoint angles large) : ℂ) at h
  rw [hsmall, show (2 * Real.sin (width / 4)) / 2 = Real.sin (width / 4) by ring] at h
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (lebesgueFunction_gapMidpoint_le_gapHeight angles hsize large)
    (gapWidth_pos angles small).le)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_difference_lower_bound
statement:
theorem gapHeight_difference_lower_bound (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (large small : Fin n) (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width)
    (hwidth : width ≤ gapWidth angles large)
    (hsmall : gapWidth angles small ≤ 2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1)) :
    (2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1)) / gapWidth angles small - 1 ≤
      gapHeight angles hsize large - gapHeight angles hsize small
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapHeight_width_comparison angles hsize large small width hw hwidth
  have hv := (one_lt_gapHeight angles hsize small).le
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hsmall)
  have hweighted : 2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1) - gapWidth angles small ≤
      gapWidth angles small *
        (gapHeight angles hsize large - gapHeight angles hsize small) := by
    nlinarith
  have hb := gapWidth_pos angles small
  have hdiv : (2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1) - gapWidth angles small) /
      gapWidth angles small ≤ gapHeight angles hsize large - gapHeight angles hsize small :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hb).mpr (by nlinarith [hweighted])
  have he : (2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1) - gapWidth angles small) /
      gapWidth angles small =
        (2 * Real.sin (width / 4) ^ (n - 1)) / gapWidth angles small - 1 := by
    rw [sub_div, div_self hb.ne']
  rwa [he] at hdiv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleNext_gt
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleNext_gt (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (i : Fin p) :
    root i < cyclicRolleNext hp root T i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicRolleNext
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hmono (show i < (⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ : Fin p) from Nat.lt_succ_self i.val)
  · have hfirst := (hbound ⟨0, hp⟩).1
    have hi := (hbound i).2
    linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleNext_le_first_add
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleNext_le_first_add (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (i : Fin p) :
    cyclicRolleNext hp root T i ≤ root ⟨0, hp⟩ + T
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicRolleNext
  split_ifs with h
  · have hn := (hbound ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩).2
    have hfirst := (hbound ⟨0, hp⟩).1
    linarith
  · exact le_rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleReduce_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleReduce_mem_Ico (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (point : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i))
    (i : Fin p) : cyclicRolleReduce T (point i) ∈ Set.Ico 0 T
proof:
:= by
  have hl := (hpoint i).1
  have hu := (hpoint i).2.trans_le (cyclicRolleNext_le_first_add hp root T hbound i)
  have hroot := hbound i
  have hfirst := hbound ⟨0, hp⟩
  unfold cyclicRolleReduce
  split_ifs with h
  · exact ⟨hroot.1.trans hl.le, h⟩
  · constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith [hfirst.2]
