name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleReduce_injective
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleReduce_injective (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T)
    (point : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i)) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => cyclicRolleReduce T (point i))
proof:
:= by
  have hne {i j : Fin p} (hij : i < j) :
      cyclicRolleReduce T (point i) ≠ cyclicRolleReduce T (point j) := by
    have hnext : i.val + 1 < p := (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij).trans_lt j.isLt
    have hnextj : (⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩ : Fin p) ≤ j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij
    have hi_upper : point i < root j := by
      have h := (hpoint i).2
      rw [cyclicRolleNext, dif_pos hnext] at h
      exact h.trans_le (hmono.monotone hnextj)
    have hiT : point i < T := hi_upper.trans (hbound j).2
    rw [cyclicRolleReduce, if_pos hiT]
    by_cases hjT : point j < T
    · rw [cyclicRolleReduce, if_pos hjT]
      exact ne_of_lt (hi_upper.trans (hpoint j).1)
    · rw [cyclicRolleReduce, if_neg hjT]
      have hj_upper := (hpoint j).2.trans_le
        (cyclicRolleNext_le_first_add hp root T hbound j)
      have hfirst_le : root ⟨0, hp⟩ ≤ root i :=
        hmono.monotone (show (⟨0, hp⟩ : Fin p) ≤ i from Nat.zero_le i.val)
      have hi_lower := (hpoint i).1
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  intro i j hij
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact False.elim (hne hlt hij)
  · exact heq
  · exact False.elim (hne hgt hij.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_cyclic_rolle_points
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_rolle_points (hp : 0 < p) (T : ℝ) (_hT : 0 < T)
    (root : Fin p → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0)
    (hshift : ∀ t, f t = 0 → f (t + T) = 0)
    (hdshift : ∀ t, deriv f (t + T) = 0 → deriv f t = 0) :
    ∃ point : Fin p → ℝ,
      (∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i)) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv f (point i) = 0) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => cyclicRolleReduce T (point i)) ∧
      (∀ i, cyclicRolleReduce T (point i) ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) ∧
      (∀ i, deriv f (cyclicRolleReduce T (point i)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnext_zero (i : Fin p) : f (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i) = 0 := by
    unfold cyclicRolleNext
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hroot _
    · exact hshift _ (hroot _)
  have hex (i : Fin p) :
      ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i), deriv f t = 0 := by
    exact exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero (cyclicRolleNext_gt hp root T hmono hbound i)
      hf.continuous.continuousOn ((hroot i).trans (hnext_zero i).symm)
      (fun t _ => (hf t).hasDerivAt)
  choose point hpoint hzero using hex
  refine ⟨point, hpoint, hzero,
    cyclicRolleReduce_injective hp root T hmono hbound point hpoint,
    cyclicRolleReduce_mem_Ico hp root T hbound point hpoint, ?_⟩
  intro i
  unfold cyclicRolleReduce
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hzero i
  · apply hdshift (point i - T)
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hzero i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_cyclic_deriv_roots
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_deriv_roots (hp : 0 < p) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (root : Fin p → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0)
    (hshift : ∀ t, f t = 0 → f (t + T) = 0)
    (hdshift : ∀ t, deriv f (t + T) = 0 → deriv f t = 0) :
    ∃ point : Fin p → ℝ, Function.Injective point ∧
      (∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) ∧ (∀ i, deriv f (point i) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨point, _, _, hinj, hbound', hzero⟩ :=
    exists_cyclic_rolle_points hp T hT root hmono hbound f hf hroot hshift hdshift
  exact ⟨fun i => cyclicRolleReduce T (point i), hinj, hbound', hzero⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.second_deriv_neg_of_localMax
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne.lt_or_gt with hneg | hpos
  · exact hneg
  · have hmin := isLocalMin_of_deriv_deriv_pos hpos hzero hcont
    have heq : f =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun _ => f t) := by
      filter_upwards [hmax, hmin] with x hxmax hxmin
      exact le_antisymm hxmax hxmin
    have hz : deriv (deriv f) t = 0 := by
      simpa only [deriv_const', deriv_const] using heq.deriv.deriv_eq
    exact False.elim (hne hz)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRootArc_mem_Ico
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicRootArc at ht
  split_ifs at ht with h
  · exact ⟨(hbound i).1.trans ht.1.le, ht.2.trans (hbound ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩).2⟩
  · exact ht.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRootArc_disjoint_of_lt
statement:
lemma cyclicRootArc_disjoint_of_lt (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) {i j : Fin p} (hij : i < j) :
    Disjoint (cyclicRootArc hp root T i) (cyclicRootArc hp root T j)
proof:
:= by
  have hnext : i.val + 1 < p := (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij).trans_lt j.isLt
  have hnextj : (⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩ : Fin p) ≤ j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij
  have hroot_next_le : root ⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩ ≤ root j := hmono.monotone hnextj
  have hfirst_le : root ⟨0, hp⟩ ≤ root i :=
    hmono.monotone (show (⟨0, hp⟩ : Fin p) ≤ i from Nat.zero_le i.val)
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro t hti htj
  rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_pos hnext] at hti
  unfold cyclicRootArc at htj
  split_ifs at htj with hjnext
  · have hi_upper := hti.2
    have hj_lower := htj.1
    linarith
  · rcases htj.2 with hj_lower | hj_upper
    · have hi_upper := hti.2
      linarith
    · have hi_lower := hti.1
      linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRootArc_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
lemma cyclicRootArc_pairwise_disjoint (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) :
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (cyclicRootArc hp root T i) (cyclicRootArc hp root T j))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · exact cyclicRootArc_disjoint_of_lt hp root T hmono hlt
  · exact (cyclicRootArc_disjoint_of_lt hp root T hmono hgt).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleReduce_mem_arc
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleReduce_mem_arc (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T) (point : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i))
    (i : Fin p) : cyclicRolleReduce T (point i) ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root T i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicRootArc
  split_ifs with hnext
  · have hi : point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (root ⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩) := by
      simpa only [cyclicRolleNext, dif_pos hnext] using hpoint i
    have hiT := hi.2.trans (hbound ⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩).2
    simpa only [cyclicRolleReduce, if_pos hiT] using hi
  · refine ⟨cyclicRolleReduce_mem_Ico hp root T hbound point hpoint i, ?_⟩
    unfold cyclicRolleReduce
    split_ifs with hiT
    · exact Or.inl (hpoint i).1
    · apply Or.inr
      have hi_upper := (hpoint i).2
      rw [cyclicRolleNext, dif_neg hnext] at hi_upper
      linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRolleReduce_index_eq_of_mem_arc
statement:
lemma cyclicRolleReduce_index_eq_of_mem_arc (hp : 0 < p) (root : Fin p → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 T)
    (point : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ i, point i ∈ Set.Ioo (root i) (cyclicRolleNext hp root T i))
    {i j : Fin p} (hmem : cyclicRolleReduce T (point j) ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root T i) :
    j = i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hd := cyclicRootArc_pairwise_disjoint hp root T hmono (Ne.symm hne)
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hmem (cyclicRolleReduce_mem_arc hp root T hbound point hpoint j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cross_exists_zero_between_opposite_values
statement:
private lemma cross_exists_zero_between_opposite_values (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hopposite : f b = -f a) (hne : f a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo a b ∧ f t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
  · have hright : 0 < f b := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hneg, hright⟩
  · have hright : f b < 0 := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo' hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hright, hpos⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_root_on_gap
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_root_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i < k) (hkj : k < j) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (gapPredecessor k)) (angles.angle k) ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < k.val := by have hval : i.val < k.val := hik; omega
  have hpred : (gapPredecessor k).val + 1 = k.val := by
    change k.val - 1 + 1 = k.val
    omega
  have hpk : gapPredecessor k < k := by
    change k.val - 1 < k.val
    omega
  have hip : i ≤ gapPredecessor k := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hik
  apply cross_exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (angles.strictMono hpk)
  · exact crossDifferenceInterpolant_consecutive_flip angles i j (gapPredecessor k) k
      (hik.trans hkj).le hpred hip hkj
  · exact (crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff angles i j
      (gapPredecessor k) (hik.trans hkj).le).mpr ⟨hip, hpk.trans hkj⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_root_at_index
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_root_at_index (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hki : k ≠ i) :
    ∃ t, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k t ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : i < k ∧ k < j
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hz⟩ := exists_crossDifference_root_on_gap angles i j k hk.1 hk.2
    exact ⟨t, by simpa [crossDifferenceRootLocation, hk] using ht, hz⟩
  · have houtside : k < i ∨ j ≤ k := by
      have hval : k.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hki (Fin.ext h)
      by_cases hki' : k < i
      · exact Or.inl hki'
      · right
        have hik : i < k := by change i.val < k.val; change ¬k.val < i.val at hki'; omega
        exact le_of_not_gt (fun hkj => hk ⟨hik, hkj⟩)
    exact ⟨angles.angle k, by simp [crossDifferenceRootLocation, hk],
      crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j k hij.le houtside⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_angle
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_angle (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k t) :
    t ≤ angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossDifferenceRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hk
  · exact ht.2.le
  · exact ht.le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootLocation_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootLocation_mem_Ico (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k t) :
    t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossDifferenceRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hk
  · exact ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans ht.1.le, ht.2.trans (angles.lt_two_pi k)⟩
  · rw [ht]
    exact ⟨angles.nonneg k, angles.lt_two_pi k⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_roots_on_erase
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_roots_on_erase (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : {k : Fin n // k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n))} → ℝ,
      StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k.val (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n))
  have hz (k : s) : ∃ t, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k.val t ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t = 0 :=
    exists_crossDifference_root_at_index angles i j k.val hij (Finset.mem_erase.mp k.property).1
  let root : s → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (hz k)
  have hloc (k : s) : crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k.val (root k) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hz k)).1
  refine ⟨root, ?_, hloc, fun k => crossDifferenceRootLocation_mem_Ico angles i j k.val
    (hloc k), fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hz k)).2⟩
  intro k l hkl
  have hkle : root k ≤ angles.angle k.val :=
    crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_angle angles i j k.val (hloc k)
  have hkl' : k.val < l.val := hkl
  have hl := hloc l
  unfold crossDifferenceRootLocation at hl
  split_ifs at hl with hlmiddle
  · have hkpred : k.val ≤ gapPredecessor l.val := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hkl'
    exact (hkle.trans (angles.strictMono.monotone hkpred)).trans_lt hl.1
  · rw [hl]
    exact hkle.trans_lt (angles.strictMono hkl')

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootIndex_strictMono
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootIndex_strictMono (i : Fin n) :
    StrictMono (crossDifferenceRootIndex i)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl
  exact ((Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp)).strictMono hkl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootIndex_ne_cut
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootIndex_ne_cut (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n - 1)) :
    crossDifferenceRootIndex i k ≠ i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_erase.mp
    (((Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp) k).property)).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_ordered_roots_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_ordered_roots_with_locations (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j (crossDifferenceRootIndex i k) (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_roots_on_erase angles i j hij
  let e := (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp :
    (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset (Fin n)).card = n - 1)
  refine ⟨fun k => root (e k), hmono.comp e.strictMono, ?_, fun k => hbound (e k),
    fun k => hroot (e k)⟩
  intro k
  exact hloc (e k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
lemma crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
    (fun k => ⟨angles.nonneg k, angles.lt_two_pi k⟩) (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) i
  exact (crossDifferenceCoefficient_ne_zero_iff i j i hij.le).mpr ⟨le_rfl, hij⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_saturated_roots_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_saturated_roots_with_locations (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j (crossDifferenceRootIndex i k) (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (root k) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t = 0 ↔
          ∃ k, root k = t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_ordered_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  have hP := crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero angles i j hij
  refine ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots angles.angle
      (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) hP root hmono.injective hbound hroot
  · intro t ht
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
        (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) hP
        (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _)
        (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
        (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hmono.injective hbound hroot t ht hz
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact hroot k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_of_zero
statement:
lemma gapLeft_of_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : cut.val = 0) : gapLeft angles cut = angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapLeft, hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapRight_of_zero
statement:
lemma gapRight_of_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : cut.val = 0) : gapRight angles cut = 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapRight, hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_of_zero
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_of_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : cut.val = 0) :
    gapInterpolant angles cut = sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapInterpolant, cyclicGapCoefficient, hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterval_of_zero
statement:
lemma gapInterval_of_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : cut.val = 0) : gapInterval angles cut = wrapGap angles
proof:
:= by
  rw [gapInterval, gapLeft_of_zero angles cut hcut, gapRight_of_zero angles cut hcut]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_of_pos
statement:
lemma gapLeft_of_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) : gapLeft angles cut = angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapLeft, Nat.ne_of_gt hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapRight_of_pos
statement:
lemma gapRight_of_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) : gapRight angles cut = angles.angle cut
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapRight, Nat.ne_of_gt hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_of_pos
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_of_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    gapInterpolant angles cut = sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapInterpolant, cyclicGapCoefficient, Nat.ne_of_gt hcut, ↓reduceIte]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterval_of_pos
statement:
lemma gapInterval_of_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) : gapInterval angles cut = ordinaryGap angles cut hcut
proof:
:= by
  rw [gapInterval, gapLeft_of_pos angles cut hcut, gapRight_of_pos angles cut hcut]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma gapLeft_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    gapLeft angles ⟨0, hn⟩ = angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)
proof:
:=
  gapLeft_of_zero angles _ rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapRight_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma gapRight_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    gapRight angles ⟨0, hn⟩ = 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:=
  gapRight_of_zero angles _ rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma gapInterpolant_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    gapInterpolant angles ⟨0, hn⟩ = sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient
proof:
:=
  gapInterpolant_of_zero angles _ rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterval_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma gapInterval_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    gapInterval angles ⟨0, hn⟩ = wrapGap angles
proof:
:=
  gapInterval_of_zero angles _ rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_lt_gapRight
statement:
lemma gapLeft_lt_gapRight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapLeft angles cut < gapRight angles cut
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · rw [gapLeft_of_zero angles cut hzero, gapRight_of_zero angles cut hzero]
    exact angles.lt_two_pi _
  · have hpos : 0 < cut.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    rw [gapLeft_of_pos angles cut hpos, gapRight_of_pos angles cut hpos]
    apply angles.strictMono
    change cut.val - 1 < cut.val
    omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapLeft_nonneg
statement:
lemma gapLeft_nonneg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ gapLeft angles cut
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapLeft
  split_ifs <;> exact angles.nonneg _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapRight_le_two_pi
statement:
lemma gapRight_le_two_pi (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapRight angles cut ≤ 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapRight
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact (angles.lt_two_pi _).le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterval_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma gapInterval_mem_Ioo (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut) : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(gapLeft_nonneg angles cut).trans_lt ht.1,
    ht.2.trans_le (gapRight_le_two_pi angles cut)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp t : ℂ) =
      gapInterpolant angles cut t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · rw [gapInterval_of_zero angles cut hzero] at ht
    rw [gapInterpolant_of_zero angles cut hzero]
    exact lebesgueFunction_on_wrapGap angles ht
  · have hpos : 0 < cut.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    rw [gapInterval_of_pos angles cut hpos] at ht
    rw [gapInterpolant_of_pos angles cut hpos]
    exact lebesgueFunction_on_gap angles cut hpos ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak
statement:
theorem exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    ∃ peak : ℝ,
      StrictIntervalPeak (gapInterpolant angles cut)
        (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut) peak ∧
      1 < gapInterpolant angles cut peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut)) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : cut.val = 0
  · rw [gapInterpolant_of_zero angles cut hzero,
      gapLeft_of_zero angles cut hzero, gapRight_of_zero angles cut hzero]
    exact exists_wrapInterpolant_strict_peak angles hsize
  · have hpos : 0 < cut.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    rw [gapInterpolant_of_pos angles cut hpos,
      gapLeft_of_pos angles cut hpos, gapRight_of_pos angles cut hpos]
    exact exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak angles hsize cut hpos

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.strictIntervalPeak_unique
statement:
private lemma strictIntervalPeak_unique {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b p q : ℝ}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPeak f a b p) (hq : StrictIntervalPeak f a b q) : q = p
proof:
:= by
  apply (hp.eq_iff q (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hq.mem_Ioo)).mp
  exact le_antisymm (hp.isMaxOn (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hq.mem_Ioo))
    (hq.isMaxOn (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp.mem_Ioo))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.existsUnique_gapInterpolant_strict_peak
statement:
theorem existsUnique_gapInterpolant_strict_peak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    ∃! peak : ℝ,
      StrictIntervalPeak (gapInterpolant angles cut)
        (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut) peak ∧
      1 < gapInterpolant angles cut peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut)) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨peak, hp⟩ := exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak angles hsize cut
  exact ⟨peak, hp, fun _ hq => strictIntervalPeak_unique hp.1 hq.1⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak
statement:
theorem gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    StrictIntervalPeak (gapInterpolant angles cut)
      (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut) (gapPeak angles hsize cut)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak angles hsize cut)).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem gapPeak_mem_Ioo (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapPeak angles hsize cut ∈ Set.Ioo (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut)
proof:
:=
  (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize cut).mem_Ioo

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_mem_gapInterval
statement:
theorem gapPeak_mem_gapInterval (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) : gapPeak angles hsize cut ∈ gapInterval angles cut
proof:
:=
  gapPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize cut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_mem_turn
statement:
theorem gapPeak_mem_turn (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapPeak angles hsize cut ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  gapInterval_mem_Ioo angles cut (gapPeak_mem_gapInterval angles hsize cut)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_unique
statement:
theorem gapPeak_unique (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (cut : Fin n) {peak : ℝ}
    (hpeak : StrictIntervalPeak (gapInterpolant angles cut)
      (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut) peak) : peak = gapPeak angles hsize cut
proof:
:=
  strictIntervalPeak_unique (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize cut) hpeak

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_lt_gapHeight
statement:
theorem one_lt_gapHeight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    1 < gapHeight angles hsize cut
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak angles hsize cut)).2.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_le_gapHeight
statement:
theorem gapInterpolant_le_gapHeight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (gapLeft angles cut) (gapRight angles cut)) :
    gapInterpolant angles cut t ≤ gapHeight angles hsize cut
proof:
:=
  (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize cut).isMaxOn ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_second_deriv_neg
statement:
theorem gapPeak_second_deriv_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    deriv (deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut)) (gapPeak angles hsize cut) < 0
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_gapInterpolant_strict_peak angles hsize cut)).2.2

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_eq_lebesgueFunction
statement:
theorem gapHeight_eq_lebesgueFunction (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapHeight angles hsize cut = lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle)
      (Circle.exp (gapPeak angles hsize cut) : ℂ)
proof:
:=
  (lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval angles cut
    (gapPeak_mem_gapInterval angles hsize cut)).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.toNodeFamily_coordinates
statement:
@[simp] theorem CyclicAngles.toNodeFamily_coordinates (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    angles.toNodeFamily.coordinates = phaseNodes angles.angle
proof: := rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_le_amplification
statement:
theorem gapHeight_le_amplification (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapHeight angles hsize cut ≤ amplification angles.toNodeFamily
proof:
:= by
  rw [gapHeight_eq_lebesgueFunction]
  simpa only [CyclicAngles.toNodeFamily_coordinates] using
    le_amplification angles.toNodeFamily (Circle.exp (gapPeak angles hsize cut))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_le_angularAmplification
statement:
theorem gapHeight_le_angularAmplification (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) :
    gapHeight angles hsize cut ≤ angularAmplification angles
proof:
:=
  gapHeight_le_amplification angles hsize cut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapIndexSign_consecutive_cuts
proof:
:= by
  have hkval : k.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hki (Fin.ext h)
  have hside : k < j ↔ k < i := by
    change k.val < j.val ↔ k.val < i.val
    omega
  simp only [gapIndexSign, hside]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_consecutive_cuts
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_consecutive_cuts (i j k : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    gapCoefficient j k = if k = i then gapCoefficient i k else -gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · rw [if_pos hki]
    unfold gapCoefficient
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    rw [gapIndexSign_consecutive_cuts hij]
    simpa [hki] using (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
  · rw [if_neg hki]
    let P : ℝ := ∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ.erase k).erase i,
      gapIndexSign i l * nodeIndexSign k l
    have hprod : (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ.erase k).erase i,
        gapIndexSign j l * nodeIndexSign k l) = P := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      rw [gapIndexSign_consecutive_cuts hij (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1]
    have hmem : i ∈ (Finset.univ.erase k : Finset (Fin n)) :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hki, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
    have hi : gapCoefficient i k = -nodeIndexSign k i * P := by
      unfold gapCoefficient
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase k)
        (fun l => gapIndexSign i l * nodeIndexSign k l) hmem]
      simp only [gapIndexSign, lt_self_iff_false, if_false]
      change (-1 * nodeIndexSign k i) * P = -nodeIndexSign k i * P
      ring
    have hj : gapCoefficient j k = nodeIndexSign k i * P := by
      unfold gapCoefficient
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase k)
        (fun l => gapIndexSign j l * nodeIndexSign k l) hmem, hprod]
      have hlt : i < j := by change i.val < j.val; omega
      simp [gapIndexSign, hlt]
    rw [hi, hj]
    ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_signed_consecutive_cuts
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_signed_consecutive_cuts (i j k : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    gapIndexSign j k * gapCoefficient j k =
      -(gapIndexSign i k * gapCoefficient i k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gapCoefficient_consecutive_cuts i j k hij]
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · rw [if_pos hki]
    have hlt : i < j := by change i.val < j.val; omega
    simp [hki, gapIndexSign, hlt]
  · rw [if_neg hki, gapIndexSign_consecutive_cuts hij hki]
    ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGapPhase_mul_self
statement:
lemma crossGapPhase_mul_self (i j : Fin n) :
    crossGapPhase i j * crossGapPhase i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossGapPhase
  rw [← mul_pow]
  norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGapPhase_ne_zero
statement: lemma crossGapPhase_ne_zero (i j : Fin n) : crossGapPhase i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossGapPhase
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_signed_between_cuts
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_signed_between_cuts (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    gapIndexSign j k * gapCoefficient j k =
      crossGapPhase i j * (gapIndexSign i k * gapCoefficient i k)
proof:
:= by
  have haux : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + d →
      gapIndexSign j k * gapCoefficient j k =
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ d * (gapIndexSign i k * gapCoefficient i k) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro j hj
      have hji : j = i := Fin.ext (by omega)
      simp [hji]
    | succ d ih =>
      intro j hj
      let l : Fin n := ⟨j.val - 1, (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans_lt j.isLt⟩
      have hl : l.val = i.val + d := by dsimp [l]; omega
      have hlj : l.val + 1 = j.val := by dsimp [l]; omega
      rw [gapCoefficient_signed_consecutive_cuts l j k hlj, ih l hl, pow_succ]
      ring
  simpa only [crossGapPhase] using haux (j.val - i.val) j (by
    have hval : i.val ≤ j.val := hij
    omega)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_between_cuts_outside
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_between_cuts_outside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) :
    gapCoefficient j k = crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapCoefficient_signed_between_cuts i j k hij
  rcases hk with hki | hjk
  · have hkj : k < j := hki.trans_le hij
    simpa [gapIndexSign, hki, hkj] using h
  · have hki : ¬k < i := not_lt.mpr (hij.trans hjk)
    have hkj : ¬k < j := not_lt.mpr hjk
    simp only [gapIndexSign, if_neg hki, if_neg hkj, neg_one_mul, mul_neg] at h
    exact neg_injective h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_between_cuts_inside
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_between_cuts_inside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) :
    gapCoefficient j k = -crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  have h := gapCoefficient_signed_between_cuts i j k hij
  have hki : ¬k < i := not_lt.mpr hik
  simpa [gapIndexSign, hki, hkj, neg_mul, mul_neg] using h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_between_cuts
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_between_cuts (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    gapCoefficient j k =
      if i ≤ k ∧ k < j then -crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k
      else crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    exact gapCoefficient_between_cuts_inside i j k hij hk.1 hk.2
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    apply gapCoefficient_between_cuts_outside i j k hij
    by_cases hki : k < i
    · exact Or.inl hki
    · exact Or.inr (le_of_not_gt (fun hkj => hk ⟨le_of_not_gt hki, hkj⟩))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) :
    crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k = 2 * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossDifferenceCoefficient
  rw [gapCoefficient_between_cuts_inside i j k hij hik hkj]
  calc
    gapCoefficient i k - crossGapPhase i j *
        (-crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k) =
      gapCoefficient i k +
        (crossGapPhase i j * crossGapPhase i j) * gapCoefficient i k := by ring
    _ = 2 * gapCoefficient i k := by rw [crossGapPhase_mul_self]; ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceCoefficient_outside
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceCoefficient_outside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) : crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossDifferenceCoefficient
  rw [gapCoefficient_between_cuts_outside i j k hij hk, ← mul_assoc,
    crossGapPhase_mul_self, one_mul, sub_self]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumCoefficient_inside
statement:
theorem crossSumCoefficient_inside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) : crossSumCoefficient i j k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossSumCoefficient
  rw [gapCoefficient_between_cuts_inside i j k hij hik hkj]
  calc
    gapCoefficient i k + crossGapPhase i j *
        (-crossGapPhase i j * gapCoefficient i k) =
      gapCoefficient i k -
        (crossGapPhase i j * crossGapPhase i j) * gapCoefficient i k := by ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [crossGapPhase_mul_self, one_mul, sub_self]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumCoefficient_outside
statement:
theorem crossSumCoefficient_outside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) :
    crossSumCoefficient i j k = 2 * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossSumCoefficient
  rw [gapCoefficient_between_cuts_outside i j k hij hk, ← mul_assoc,
    crossGapPhase_mul_self, one_mul]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_ne_zero
statement: lemma gapCoefficient_ne_zero (cut k : Fin n) : gapCoefficient cut k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := abs_gapCoefficient cut k
  rw [hzero, abs_zero] at h
  norm_num at h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceCoefficient_eq (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k =
      if i ≤ k ∧ k < j then 2 * gapCoefficient i k else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    exact crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside i j k hij hk.1 hk.2
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    apply crossDifferenceCoefficient_outside i j k hij
    by_cases hki : k < i
    · exact Or.inl hki
    · exact Or.inr (le_of_not_gt (fun hkj => hk ⟨le_of_not_gt hki, hkj⟩))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem crossSumCoefficient_eq (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    crossSumCoefficient i j k =
      if i ≤ k ∧ k < j then 0 else 2 * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    exact crossSumCoefficient_inside i j k hij hk.1 hk.2
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    apply crossSumCoefficient_outside i j k hij
    by_cases hki : k < i
    · exact Or.inl hki
    · exact Or.inr (le_of_not_gt (fun hkj => hk ⟨le_of_not_gt hki, hkj⟩))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceCoefficient_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceCoefficient_ne_zero_iff (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k ≠ 0 ↔ i ≤ k ∧ k < j
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceCoefficient_eq i j k hij]
  by_cases hk : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · simp [hk, gapCoefficient_ne_zero]
  · simp [hk]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumCoefficient_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem crossSumCoefficient_ne_zero_iff (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    crossSumCoefficient i j k ≠ 0 ↔ k < i ∨ j ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumCoefficient_eq i j k hij]
  by_cases hk : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · have houtside : ¬(k < i ∨ j ≤ k) := by
      change ¬(k.val < i.val ∨ j.val ≤ k.val)
      have hik : i.val ≤ k.val := hk.1
      have hkj : k.val < j.val := hk.2
      omega
    simp [hk, houtside]
  · have houtside : k < i ∨ j ≤ k := by
      by_cases hki : k < i
      · exact Or.inl hki
      · exact Or.inr (le_of_not_gt (fun hkj => hk ⟨le_of_not_gt hki, hkj⟩))
    simp [hk, houtside, gapCoefficient_ne_zero]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside
statement:
theorem abs_crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) : |crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k| = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside i j k hij hik hkj, abs_mul,
    abs_gapCoefficient, mul_one]
  norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_crossSumCoefficient_outside
statement:
theorem abs_crossSumCoefficient_outside (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) : |crossSumCoefficient i j k| = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumCoefficient_outside i j k hij hk, abs_mul,
    abs_gapCoefficient, mul_one]
  norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_identity
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceInterpolant_identity (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t =
      sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) t -
        crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant crossDifferenceCoefficient
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_identity
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_identity (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant θ (crossSumCoefficient i j) t =
      sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) t +
        crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant crossSumCoefficient
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (i j k : Fin n) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) =
      crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k
proof:
:=
  sineInterpolant_at_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
    (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_at_node
statement:
lemma crossSumInterpolant_at_node (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (i j k : Fin n) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) =
      crossSumCoefficient i j k
proof:
:=
  sineInterpolant_at_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
    (crossSumCoefficient i j) k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_inside
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_inside (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) =
      2 * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node,
    crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside i j k hij hik hkj]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_outside
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_outside (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node,
    crossDifferenceCoefficient_outside i j k hij hk]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_at_node_inside
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_at_node_inside (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) (hik : i ≤ k) (hkj : k < j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node, crossSumCoefficient_inside i j k hij hik hkj]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) =
      2 * gapCoefficient i k
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node, crossSumCoefficient_outside i j k hij hk]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) ≠ 0 ↔
      i ≤ k ∧ k < j
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node]
  exact crossDifferenceCoefficient_ne_zero_iff i j k hij

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k) ≠ 0 ↔
      k < i ∨ j ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node]
  exact crossSumCoefficient_ne_zero_iff i j k hij

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceCoefficient_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceCoefficient_consecutive_flip (i j k l : Fin n)
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hkl : k.val + 1 = l.val) (hik : i ≤ k) (hlj : l < j) :
    crossDifferenceCoefficient i j l = -crossDifferenceCoefficient i j k
proof:
:= by
  have hkl_lt : k < l := by change k.val < l.val; omega
  have hil : i ≤ l := hik.trans hkl_lt.le
  have hkj : k < j := hkl_lt.trans hlj
  have hli : l ≠ i := ne_of_gt (hik.trans_lt hkl_lt)
  rw [crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside i j l hij hil hlj,
    crossDifferenceCoefficient_inside i j k hij hik hkj,
    gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip i k l hkl hli]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumCoefficient_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem crossSumCoefficient_consecutive_flip (i j k l : Fin n)
    (hij : i < j) (hkl : k.val + 1 = l.val)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) (hl : l < i ∨ j ≤ l) :
    crossSumCoefficient i j l = -crossSumCoefficient i j k
proof:
:= by
  have hli : l ≠ i := by
    intro hli
    rcases hl with hl | hl
    · exact (lt_irrefl i) (hli ▸ hl)
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hij) (hli ▸ hl)
  rw [crossSumCoefficient_outside i j l hij.le hl,
    crossSumCoefficient_outside i j k hij.le hk,
    gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip i k l hkl hli]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceInterpolant_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem crossDifferenceInterpolant_consecutive_flip (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k l : Fin n) (hij : i ≤ j) (hkl : k.val + 1 = l.val)
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hlj : l < j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle l) =
      -sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node, crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node]
  exact crossDifferenceCoefficient_consecutive_flip i j k l hij hkl hik hlj

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_consecutive_flip (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k l : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hkl : k.val + 1 = l.val)
    (hk : k < i ∨ j ≤ k) (hl : l < i ∨ j ≤ l) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle l) =
      -sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (angles.angle k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node, crossSumInterpolant_at_node]
  exact crossSumCoefficient_consecutive_flip i j k l hij hkl hk hl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicPhase_mem_Ico
statement: lemma cyclicPhase_mem_Ico (z : Circle) : cyclicPhase z ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨harg_lower, harg_upper⟩ := Complex.arg_mem_Ioc (z : ℂ)
  unfold cyclicPhase
  split_ifs with h
  · constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  · constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exp_cyclicPhase
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_cyclicPhase (z : Circle) : Circle.exp (cyclicPhase z) = z
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicPhase
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Circle.exp_add, Circle.exp_arg, Circle.exp_two_pi, mul_one]
  · exact Circle.exp_arg z

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicPhase_one
statement: @[simp] lemma cyclicPhase_one : cyclicPhase (1 : Circle) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicPhase]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicPhase_injective
statement: lemma cyclicPhase_injective : Function.Injective cyclicPhase
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  calc
    z = Circle.exp (cyclicPhase z) := (exp_cyclicPhase z).symm
    _ = Circle.exp (cyclicPhase w) := congrArg Circle.exp h
    _ = w := exp_cyclicPhase w

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicPhase_exp
statement:
lemma cyclicPhase_exp {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    cyclicPhase (Circle.exp t) = t
proof:
:=
  Circle.exp_injOn_Ico (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (by simp)
    (cyclicPhase_mem_Ico _) ht (exp_cyclicPhase _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.range_cyclicPhase
statement: lemma range_cyclicPhase : Set.range cyclicPhase = Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact cyclicPhase_mem_Ico z
  · intro ht
    exact ⟨Circle.exp t, cyclicPhase_exp ht⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.anchoredNodes_first
statement:
@[simp] lemma anchoredNodes_first (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (anchoredNodes nodes hn).point ⟨0, hn⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [anchoredNodes, NodeFamily.rotate]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.phaseSet_card
statement: lemma NodeFamily.phaseSet_card (nodes : NodeFamily n) : nodes.phaseSet.card = n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [NodeFamily.phaseSet, Function.comp_def, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Finset.card_image_of_injective (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
      (cyclicPhase_injective.comp nodes.injective)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.phaseToSet_bijective
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.phaseToSet_bijective (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    Function.Bijective nodes.phaseToSet
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    exact nodes.injective (cyclicPhase_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp ht with ⟨i, hi, hit⟩
    exact ⟨i, Subtype.ext hit⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.sortedPhase_strictMono
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.sortedPhase_strictMono (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    StrictMono nodes.sortedPhase
proof:
:=
  (nodes.phaseSet.orderEmbOfFin nodes.phaseSet_card).strictMono

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.phase_sortedPermutation
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.phase_sortedPermutation (nodes : NodeFamily n) (i : Fin n) :
    cyclicPhase (nodes.point (nodes.sortedPermutation i)) = nodes.sortedPhase i
proof:
:= by
  have h := nodes.phaseSetEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (nodes.phaseSet.orderIsoOfFin nodes.phaseSet_card i)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.sortedPhase_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.sortedPhase_mem_Ico (nodes : NodeFamily n) (i : Fin n) :
    nodes.sortedPhase i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nodes.phase_sortedPermutation i]
  exact cyclicPhase_mem_Ico _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.exp_sortedPhase
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.exp_sortedPhase (nodes : NodeFamily n) (i : Fin n) :
    Circle.exp (nodes.sortedPhase i) = nodes.point (nodes.sortedPermutation i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nodes.phase_sortedPermutation i, exp_cyclicPhase]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sortedPhase_anchored_zero
statement:
lemma sortedPhase_anchored_zero (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPhase ⟨0, hn⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let rotated := anchoredNodes nodes hn
  change rotated.phaseSet.orderEmbOfFin rotated.phaseSet_card ⟨0, hn⟩ = 0
  rw [Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero rotated.phaseSet_card hn]
  apply (Finset.min'_eq_iff _ _ 0).mpr
  constructor
  · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    simp [rotated]
  · intro t ht
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp ht with ⟨i, hi, hit⟩
    rw [← hit]
    exact (cyclicPhase_mem_Ico _).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.nonneg
statement:
lemma CyclicAngles.nonneg {hn : 0 < n} (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ angles.angle i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← angles.first_eq_zero]
  exact angles.strictMono.monotone (show (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) ≤ i from Nat.zero_le i.val)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedAngles_recovers
statement:
lemma orderedAngles_recovers (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    nodes.point ((anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPermutation i) =
      nodes.point ⟨0, hn⟩ * Circle.exp ((orderedAngles nodes hn).angle i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (orderedAngles nodes hn).angle i = (anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPhase i from rfl,
    (anchoredNodes nodes hn).exp_sortedPhase]
  change nodes.point _ = nodes.point ⟨0, hn⟩ *
    ((nodes.point ⟨0, hn⟩)⁻¹ * nodes.point _)
  simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_orderedAngles
statement:
theorem exists_orderedAngles (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ rotation : Circle, ∃ permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∃ angles : CyclicAngles n hn,
      ∀ i, nodes.point (permutation i) = rotation * Circle.exp (angles.angle i)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨nodes.point ⟨0, hn⟩, (anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPermutation,
    orderedAngles nodes hn, orderedAngles_recovers nodes hn⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.ordinaryGap_critical_unique
statement:
lemma ordinaryGap_critical_unique (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (hy : y ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut)
    (hzx : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) x = 0)
    (hzy : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) y = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize cut hcut
  have hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1)
      (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) ≠ 0 := by
    apply cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      (angles.angle cut) (root ⟨0, hp⟩)
    rw [hroot, gapInterpolant_at_node, gapCoefficient_at_cut]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨critical, _, _, _, _, hcritical⟩ :=
    sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing hsize angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      hP root hmono hbound hroot
  by_cases hfirst : cut.val = 1
  · let first : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, hp⟩
    let last : Fin (n - 1) := lastNodeIndex hp
    have hfirstIndex : otherGapIndex cut first = cut := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [otherGapIndex, first, Fin.val_mk, hfirst, Nat.sub_self,
        Nat.not_lt_zero, if_false]
    have hfirstRoot : angles.angle cut < root first := by
      have h := (hloc first).1
      rwa [hfirstIndex] at h
    have hlast_final : ¬last.val + 1 < n - 1 := by
      dsimp only [last, lastNodeIndex]
      omega
    have hpredZero : angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) = 0 := by
      have hpred : gapPredecessor cut = ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp only [gapPredecessor, Fin.val_mk, hfirst, Nat.sub_self]
      rw [hpred, angles.first_eq_zero]
    have hmem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) :
        t ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
      rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
      have htpos : 0 < t := by simpa only [hpredZero] using ht.1
      exact ⟨⟨htpos.le, ht.2.trans (angles.lt_two_pi cut)⟩,
        Or.inr (ht.2.trans hfirstRoot)⟩
    exact (hcritical last x (hmem x hx) hzx).trans
      (hcritical last y (hmem y hy) hzy).symm
  · have hcut2 : 2 ≤ cut.val := by omega
    let i : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨cut.val - 2, by have := cut.isLt; omega⟩
    have hinext : i.val + 1 < n - 1 := by dsimp [i]; have := cut.isLt; omega
    let j : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, hinext⟩
    have hipivot : i.val < cut.val - 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
    have hival : (otherGapIndex cut i).val = i.val := by
      simp only [otherGapIndex, if_pos hipivot]
    have hrightIndex : (otherGapIndex cut i).val + 1 < n := by
      rw [hival]; dsimp [i]; have := cut.isLt; omega
    have hright : cyclicGapRight angles (otherGapIndex cut i) =
        angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) := by
      rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hrightIndex]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk, gapPredecessor]
      rw [hival]
      dsimp [i]
      omega
    have hjpivot : ¬j.val < cut.val - 1 := by dsimp [j, i]; omega
    have hjindex : otherGapIndex cut j = cut := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [otherGapIndex, Fin.val_mk, if_neg hjpivot]
      dsimp [j, i]
      omega
    have hleft : root i < angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) := by
      have h := (hloc i).2
      rwa [hright] at h
    have hrightRoot : angles.angle cut < root j := by
      have h := (hloc j).1
      rwa [hjindex] at h
    have hmem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) :
        t ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) i := by
      rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_pos hinext]
      exact ⟨hleft.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hrightRoot⟩
    exact (hcritical i x (hmem x hx) hzx).trans
      (hcritical i y (hmem y hy) hzy).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapGap_critical_unique
statement:
lemma wrapGap_critical_unique (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ wrapGap angles) (hy : y ∈ wrapGap angles)
    (hzx : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) x = 0)
    (hzy : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) y = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  let first : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, hp⟩
  let last : Fin (n - 1) := lastNodeIndex hp
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize
  have hlast_succ : last.val + 1 = n - 1 := by
    dsimp only [last, lastNodeIndex]
    omega
  have hlast_node :
      (⟨last.val + 1, by have := last.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin n) = lastNodeIndex hn := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hlast_succ
  have hlast_lt_node : root last < angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn) := by
    have h := (hloc last).2
    rwa [hlast_node] at h
  have hlast_final : ¬last.val + 1 < n - 1 := by omega
  have hP : cayleyOperator (n - 1)
      (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle wrapCoefficient) ≠ 0 := by
    apply cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne angles.angle wrapCoefficient
      (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (root first)
    rw [wrapInterpolant_at_last, hroot first]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨critical, _, _, _, _, hcritical⟩ :=
    sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing hsize angles.angle wrapCoefficient
      hP root hmono hbound hroot
  have hmem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) :
      t ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
    rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
    exact ⟨⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩,
      Or.inl (hlast_lt_node.trans ht.1)⟩
  exact (hcritical last x (hmem x hx) hzx).trans
    (hcritical last y (hmem y hy) hzy).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_critical_unique
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_critical_unique (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (cut : Fin n) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ gapInterval angles cut) (hy : y ∈ gapInterval angles cut)
    (hzx : deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut) x = 0)
    (hzy : deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut) y = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcut : cut.val = 0
  · rw [gapInterval_of_zero angles cut hcut] at hx hy
    rw [gapInterpolant_of_zero angles cut hcut] at hzx hzy
    exact wrapGap_critical_unique angles hsize hx hy hzx hzy
  · have hpos : 0 < cut.val := by omega
    rw [gapInterval_of_pos angles cut hpos] at hx hy
    rw [gapInterpolant_of_pos angles cut hpos] at hzx hzy
    exact ordinaryGap_critical_unique angles hsize cut hpos hx hy hzx hzy

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eq_gapPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_gapPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (cut : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut)
    (hz : deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut) t = 0) : t = gapPeak angles hsize cut
proof:
:=
  gapInterpolant_critical_unique angles hsize cut ht
    (gapPeak_mem_gapInterval angles hsize cut) hz
    (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize cut).hasDerivAt_zero.deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eq_orderedPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_orderedPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle k) (cyclicGapRight angles k))
    (hz : deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles k) t = 0) :
    t = orderedPeak angles hsize k
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_gapPeak_of_deriv_eq_zero angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn k) ?_ hz
  rw [gapInterval, gapLeft_physicalGapCut, gapRight_physicalGapCut]
  exact ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sum_gapLeft
statement:
lemma sum_gapLeft (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    (∑ cut, gapLeft angles cut) = ∑ k, angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  have heq := (physicalGapEquiv hn).sum_comp (gapLeft angles)
  calc
    (∑ cut, gapLeft angles cut) =
        ∑ k, gapLeft angles (physicalGapCut hn k) := heq.symm
    _ = ∑ k, angles.angle k := by simp only [gapLeft_physicalGapCut]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sum_gapRight
statement:
lemma sum_gapRight (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    (∑ cut, gapRight angles cut) = 2 * Real.pi + ∑ k, angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ d =>
    have hz : angles.angle 0 = 0 := angles.first_eq_zero
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hz]
    simp only [gapRight, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Nat.succ_ne_zero,
      if_true, if_false, zero_add]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sum_gapWidth
statement:
theorem sum_gapWidth (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    (∑ cut, gapWidth angles cut) = 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gapWidth, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_gapRight, sum_gapLeft, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapWidth_ge_average
statement:
theorem exists_gapWidth_ge_average (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    ∃ cut, 2 * Real.pi / (n : ℝ) ≤ gapWidth angles cut
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : 0 < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hsum : (∑ _cut : Fin n, 2 * Real.pi / (n : ℝ)) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨cut, _, hcut⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le huniv
    (show (∑ _cut : Fin n, 2 * Real.pi / (n : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ cut, gapWidth angles cut by
      rw [hsum, sum_gapWidth])
  exact ⟨cut, hcut⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapWidthSet_nonempty
statement: lemma gapWidthSet_nonempty (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) : (gapWidthSet angles).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨gapWidth angles ⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimumGapWidth_le
statement:
lemma minimumGapWidth_le (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) :
    minimumGapWidth angles ≤ gapWidth angles cut
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.min'_le
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨cut, Finset.mem_univ cut, rfl⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapWidth_eq_minimum
statement:
lemma exists_gapWidth_eq_minimum (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    ∃ cut, gapWidth angles cut = minimumGapWidth angles
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cut, _, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp
    (Finset.min'_mem (gapWidthSet angles) (gapWidthSet_nonempty angles))
  exact ⟨cut, heq⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimumGapWidth_pos
statement: lemma minimumGapWidth_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) : 0 < minimumGapWidth angles
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cut, heq⟩ := exists_gapWidth_eq_minimum angles
  rw [← heq]
  exact gapWidth_pos angles cut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimumGapWidth_le_average
statement:
lemma minimumGapWidth_le_average (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    minimumGapWidth angles ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : 0 < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hnreal).mpr
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun cut (_ : cut ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) =>
    minimumGapWidth_le angles cut)
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
    sum_gapWidth, mul_comm] using hsum

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_parameterGapWidth
statement: lemma continuous_parameterGapWidth (cut : Fin (d + 1)) : Continuous (parameterGapWidth cut)
proof:
:= by
  unfold parameterGapWidth
  split_ifs
  · exact continuous_const.sub (continuous_angularParameterAngle _)
  · exact (continuous_angularParameterAngle cut).sub (continuous_angularParameterAngle _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterGapWidth_of_mem_domain
statement:
lemma parameterGapWidth_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (cut : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterGapWidth cut u = gapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) cut
proof:
:= by
  unfold parameterGapWidth gapWidth gapRight gapLeft gapLeftNodeIndex
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sine_ratio
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sine_ratio (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j k : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((s - θ k) / 2) / Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))
      (Real.cos ((t - θ k) / 2) / 2 / Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hangle : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s - θ k) / 2) (1 / 2) t :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const (θ k)).div_const 2
  simpa only [mul_one_div] using
    hangle.sin.div_const (Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sineCardinal
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sineCardinal (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (sineCardinal θ j) (sineCardinalDerivative θ j t) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinal sineCardinalDerivative
  convert! (HasDerivAt.fun_finsetProd
      (u := Finset.univ.erase j)
      (fun k _ => hasDerivAt_sine_ratio θ j k t)) using 1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.differentiable_sineCardinal
statement:
lemma differentiable_sineCardinal (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    Differentiable ℝ (sineCardinal θ j)
proof:
:=
  fun t => (hasDerivAt_sineCardinal θ j t).differentiableAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineCardinal
statement:
lemma deriv_sineCardinal (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineCardinal θ j) t = sineCardinalDerivative θ j t
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_sineCardinal θ j t).deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinalDerivative_at_other
statement:
lemma sineCardinalDerivative_at_other (θ : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    sineCardinalDerivative θ j (θ i) =
      (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j).erase i,
        Real.sin ((θ i - θ l) / 2) / Real.sin ((θ j - θ l) / 2)) *
      ((1 : ℝ) / 2 / Real.sin ((θ j - θ i) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinalDerivative
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hki
    have himem : i ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j).erase k :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hki,
        Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩⟩
    have hzero : (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j).erase k,
        Real.sin ((θ i - θ l) / 2) / Real.sin ((θ j - θ l) / 2)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero himem
      simp
    rw [hzero, zero_mul]
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩)).elim

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineCardinal_at_other_ne_zero
statement:
lemma deriv_sineCardinal_at_other_ne_zero (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    deriv (sineCardinal θ j) (θ i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_sineCardinal, sineCardinalDerivative_at_other θ hij]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro l hl
    have hli := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
    have hlj := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).2).1
    exact div_ne_zero (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ (Ne.symm hli))
      (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ (Ne.symm hlj))
  · exact div_ne_zero (by norm_num) (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ (Ne.symm hij))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_relation_eq_zero_of_missing_coeff
statement:
theorem cyclic_relation_eq_zero_of_missing_coeff (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * q i x) = 0)
    (missing : Fin (d + 1)) (hmissing : a missing = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ha
  rcases cyclic_relation_coherent_sign hd V hcontinuous hrootBound q hq
      τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff a hrel ha with h | h
  · have := h missing
    simp [hmissing] at this
  · have := h missing
    simp [hmissing] at this

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_deleted_relation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cyclic_deleted_relation_eq_zero (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (c : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, c i * q (omitted.succAbove i) x) = 0) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := Fin.succAboveCases (α := fun _ => ℝ) omitted 0 c
  have harel (x : ℝ) : (∑ i, a i * q i x) = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => a i * q i x) omitted]
    simpa [a] using hrel x
  have hazero := cyclic_relation_eq_zero_of_missing_coeff hd V hcontinuous hrootBound
    q hq τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff a harel omitted (by simp [a])
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hazero (omitted.succAbove i)
  simpa [a] using hi

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_deleted_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem cyclic_deleted_linearIndependent (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : Fin d => q (omitted.succAbove i))
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
  intro c hc i
  have hrel (x : ℝ) : (∑ k, c k * q (omitted.succAbove k) x) = 0 := by
    have hx := congrFun hc x
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] using hx
  exact congrFun (cyclic_deleted_relation_eq_zero hd V hcontinuous hrootBound q hq
    τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted c hrel) i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_deleted_evaluation_relation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cyclic_deleted_evaluation_relation_eq_zero (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hxinj : Function.Injective x)
    (hxbound : ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (c : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hrel : ∀ j, (∑ i, c i * q (omitted.succAbove i) (x j)) = 0) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := ∑ i, c i • q (omitted.succAbove i)
  have hfmem : f ∈ V := V.sum_mem (fun i hi => V.smul_mem _ (hq _))
  have hfzero : f = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hfroot (j : Fin d) : f (x j) = 0 := by
      simpa only [f, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hrel j
    have hcount := hrootBound d f hfmem hne x hxinj hxbound hfroot
    omega
  have hfullrel (t : ℝ) : (∑ i, c i * q (omitted.succAbove i) t) = 0 := by
    have ht := congrFun hfzero t
    simpa only [f, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] using ht
  exact cyclic_deleted_relation_eq_zero hd V hcontinuous hrootBound q hq
    τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted c hfullrel

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hxinj : Function.Injective x)
    (hxbound : ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix q omitted x).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨c, hcne, hc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  have hrel (j : Fin d) : (∑ i, c i * q (omitted.succAbove i) (x j)) = 0 := by
    have hj := congrFun hc j
    simp only [cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply] at hj
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hj
  exact hcne (cyclic_deleted_evaluation_relation_eq_zero hd V hcontinuous hrootBound
    q hq τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted x hxinj hxbound c hrel)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_transpose
statement:
lemma cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_transpose (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ)
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix q omitted x).transpose =
      (cyclicEvaluationMatrix q x).submatrix omitted.succAbove id
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicEvaluationMatrix_deleted_row_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cyclicEvaluationMatrix_deleted_row_det_ne_zero (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hxinj : Function.Injective x)
    (hxbound : ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    ((cyclicEvaluationMatrix q x).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_transpose, Matrix.det_transpose]
  exact cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero hd V hcontinuous hrootBound
    q hq τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted x hxinj hxbound

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_deleted_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem homogeneousTrig_deleted_linearIndependent (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hdegree : ∀ i, (P i).natDegree ≤ d - 1)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ j)) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : Fin d => homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P (omitted.succAbove i)))
proof:
:= by
  exact cyclic_deleted_linearIndependent hd (homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (continuous_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (homogeneousTrigSpace_hasCyclicRootBound (d - 1))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig_mem_space (d - 1) (P i) (hdegree i))
    τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_deleted_evaluation_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousTrig_deleted_evaluation_det_ne_zero (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hdegree : ∀ i, (P i).natDegree ≤ d - 1)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ j)) (omitted : Fin (d + 1))
    (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hxinj : Function.Injective x)
    (hxbound : ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix (fun i => homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i)) omitted x).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact cyclicDeletedEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero hd (homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (continuous_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (homogeneousTrigSpace_hasCyclicRootBound (d - 1))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig_mem_space (d - 1) (P i) (hdegree i))
    τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff omitted x hxinj hxbound

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomial_roots_eq_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma polynomial_roots_eq_of_saturated_roots {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (root : ι → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (root i) = 0) :
    P.roots = (Finset.univ.image root).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Polynomial.roots_eq_of_natDegree_le_card_of_ne_zero
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact hroot i
  · simpa only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ] using hdegree
  · exact hP

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomial_derivative_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma polynomial_derivative_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (root : ι → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (root i) = 0)
    (i : ι) : P.derivative.eval (root i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hd
  have hmult : 1 < P.rootMultiplicity (root i) :=
    (Polynomial.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hP).mpr ⟨hroot i, hd⟩
  have hcount : P.roots.count (root i) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [polynomial_roots_eq_of_saturated_roots P hP root hinj hdegree hroot]
    exact Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one.mp (Finset.univ.image root).nodup (root i)
  rw [Polynomial.count_roots] at hcount
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomial_root_mem_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma polynomial_root_mem_of_saturated_roots {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (root : ι → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (root i) = 0)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : P.eval x = 0) : ∃ i, root i = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem := (Polynomial.mem_roots hP).mpr hx
  rw [polynomial_roots_eq_of_saturated_roots P hP root hinj hdegree hroot] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact ⟨i, hi⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots
statement:
lemma cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p)
    (hchart : ∀ t, Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0 →
      Real.cos (t / 2) ^ p * P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = f t)
    (hpoleValue : P.coeff p = f Real.pi) (root : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hz : f x = 0) : ∃ i, root i = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hmissing
  have hnot : x ∉ Set.range root := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact hmissing ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hinj' := Fin.cons_injective_of_injective hnot hinj
  have hbound' : ∀ i : Fin (p + 1),
      Fin.cons (α := fun _ => ℝ) x root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
    · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero] using hx
    · intro j
      simpa only [Fin.cons_succ] using hbound j
  have hroot' : ∀ i : Fin (p + 1),
      f (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => ℝ) x root i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
    · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero] using hz
    · intro j
      simpa only [Fin.cons_succ] using hroot j
  have hc := cayley_chart_distinct_root_count p f P hP hdegree hchart hpoleValue
    (Fin.cons x root) hinj' hbound' hroot'
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_mul
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_mul (m n : ℕ) (P Q : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ m) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig (m + n) (P * Q) t =
      homogeneousTrig m P t * homogeneousTrig n Q t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : homogeneousTrig (m + n) (P * Q) =
      fun u => homogeneousTrig m P u * homogeneousTrig n Q u := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on dense_cos_half_ne_zero
      (continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _)
      ((continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _).mul (continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _))
    intro u hu
    change homogeneousTrig (m + n) (P * Q) u =
      homogeneousTrig m P u * homogeneousTrig n Q u
    rw [homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _
        (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le_of_le hP hQ) u hu,
      homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _ hP u hu,
      homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _ hQ u hu,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, pow_add]
    ring
  exact congrFun heq t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_succ
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_succ (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig (p + 1) P t = Real.cos (t / 2) * homogeneousTrig p P t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : homogeneousTrig (p + 1) P =
      fun u => Real.cos (u / 2) * homogeneousTrig p P u := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on dense_cos_half_ne_zero
      (continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _)
      ((Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_id.div_const 2)).mul
        (continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _))
    intro u hu
    change homogeneousTrig (p + 1) P u = Real.cos (u / 2) * homogeneousTrig p P u
    rw [homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _ (by omega) u hu,
      homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan _ _ hP u hu, pow_succ]
    ring
  exact congrFun heq t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogeneousTrig_neg (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (-P) t = -homogeneousTrig p P t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTrig, Polynomial.coeff_neg, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_sineFactor
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_sineFactor (r t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig 1 (sineFactor (r / 2)) t = Real.sin ((t - r) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTrig, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero,
    sineFactor, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X,
    Polynomial.coeff_C, pow_zero, pow_one]
  rw [show (t - r) / 2 = t / 2 - r / 2 by ring, Real.sin_sub]
  norm_num
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.natDegree_le_pred_of_coeff_top_eq_zero
statement:
lemma natDegree_le_pred_of_coeff_top_eq_zero (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hp : 0 < p)
