    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (htop : P.coeff p = 0) : P.natDegree ≤ p - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  by_cases hkp : k = p
  · simpa [hkp] using htop
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp hP k (by omega)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineFactor_eq_C_mul_X_sub_C_tan
statement:
private lemma sineFactor_eq_C_mul_X_sub_C_tan (a : ℝ) (ha : Real.cos a ≠ 0) :
    sineFactor a = C (Real.cos a) * (X - C (Real.tan a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineFactor, mul_sub, ← C_mul, mul_comm (Real.cos a), Real.tan_mul_cos ha]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_sineFactor_quotient_of_eval_tan_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_sineFactor_quotient_of_eval_tan_eq_zero (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hp : 0 < p) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (a : ℝ) (ha : Real.cos a ≠ 0)
    (hroot : P.eval (Real.tan a) = 0) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ[X], Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1 ∧ P = sineFactor a * Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hroot
  have hdegR : R.natDegree ≤ p - 1 := by
    by_cases hRzero : R = 0
    · simp [hRzero]
    · rw [hR, Polynomial.natDegree_mul (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _) hRzero,
        Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C] at hP
      omega
  refine ⟨C (Real.cos a)⁻¹ * R,
    (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans hdegR, ?_⟩
  rw [sineFactor_eq_C_mul_X_sub_C_tan a ha]
  calc
    P = (X - C (Real.tan a)) * R := hR
    _ = (C (Real.cos a) * C (Real.cos a)⁻¹) *
        ((X - C (Real.tan a)) * R) := by
      rw [← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, C_1, one_mul]
    _ = C (Real.cos a) * (X - C (Real.tan a)) *
        (C (Real.cos a)⁻¹ * R) := by ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient
statement:
lemma exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hp : 0 < p) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hroot : homogeneousTrig p P r = 0) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ[X], Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1 ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, homogeneousTrig p P t =
        Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcos : Real.cos (r / 2) = 0
  · have hrpi : r = Real.pi := (cos_half_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico r hr).mp hcos
    subst r
    have htop : P.coeff p = 0 := by simpa only [homogeneousTrig_pi] using hroot
    have hdeg := natDegree_le_pred_of_coeff_top_eq_zero p P hp hP htop
    refine ⟨-P, by simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_neg] using hdeg, ?_⟩
    intro t
    have hraise := homogeneousTrig_succ (p - 1) P hdeg t
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hp] at hraise
    rw [homogeneousTrig_neg, hraise]
    rw [show (t - Real.pi) / 2 = t / 2 - Real.pi / 2 by ring,
      Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
    ring
  · have hcos' : Real.cos (r / 2) ≠ 0 := hcos
    have heval : P.eval (Real.tan (r / 2)) = 0 := by
      rw [homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p P hP r hcos'] at hroot
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hroot).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hcos')
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hPQ⟩ :=
      exists_sineFactor_quotient_of_eval_tan_eq_zero p P hp hP (r / 2) hcos' heval
    refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
    intro t
    calc
      homogeneousTrig p P t =
          homogeneousTrig (1 + (p - 1)) (sineFactor (r / 2) * Q) t := by
        rw [show 1 + (p - 1) = p by omega, hPQ]
      _ = Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t := by
        rw [homogeneousTrig_mul 1 (p - 1) _ _ (sineFactor_natDegree_le _) hQ t,
          homogeneousTrig_sineFactor]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_deriv_homogeneousTrig
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_deriv_homogeneousTrig (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (homogeneousTrig p P))
      (homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p (cayleyOperator p P)) t / 4) t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) =
      fun u => homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P) u / 2 :=
    funext (deriv_homogeneousTrig p P hP)
  rw [heq]
  apply ((hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P)
    (cayleyOperator_natDegree_le p P hP) t).div_const 2).congr_deriv
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sine_half_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u - r) / 2) (1 / 2) t := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const r).div_const 2
  exact hhalf.sin.congr_deriv (by ring)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_cosine_half_sub_div_two
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u - r) / 2) (1 / 2) t := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const r).div_const 2
  exact (hhalf.cos.div_const 2).congr_deriv (by ring)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_value_at_root
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_value_at_root (p : ℕ) (P Q : ℝ[X])
    (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1) (r : ℝ)
    (hfactor : ∀ t : ℝ, homogeneousTrig p P t =
      Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t) :
    homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q r = 2 * deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) r
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := (hasDerivAt_sine_half_sub r r).mul
    (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q hQ r)
  have heq : homogeneousTrig p P = fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t := funext hfactor
  change HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) *
    homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t) _ r at hprod
  rw [← heq] at hprod
  have hd := hprod.deriv
  simp only [sub_self, zero_div, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hd
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_at_root
statement:
lemma deriv_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_at_root (p : ℕ) (P Q : ℝ[X])
    (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1) (r : ℝ)
    (hfactor : ∀ t : ℝ, homogeneousTrig p P t =
      Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t) :
    deriv (homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q) r = deriv (deriv (homogeneousTrig p P)) r
proof:
:= by
  have heq : homogeneousTrig p P = fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t := funext hfactor
  have hderiv : deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) = fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.cos ((t - r) / 2) / 2 * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t +
      Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * deriv (homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q) t := by
    funext t
    have hg := (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q hQ t).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hprod := (hasDerivAt_sine_half_sub r t).mul hg
    change HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin ((u - r) / 2) *
      homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q u) _ t at hprod
    rw [← heq] at hprod
    exact hprod.deriv
  have hg := (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q hQ r).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hgg := hasDerivAt_deriv_homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q hQ r
  have hsum := ((hasDerivAt_cosine_half_sub_div_two r r).mul hg).add
    ((hasDerivAt_sine_half_sub r r).mul hgg)
  change HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
    Real.cos ((t - r) / 2) / 2 * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t +
    Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * deriv (homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q) t) _ r at hsum
  rw [← hderiv] at hsum
  have hd := hsum.deriv
  simp only [sub_self, zero_div, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, neg_zero,
    zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero] at hd
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_with_root_data
statement:
lemma exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_with_root_data (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hp : 0 < p) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hroot : homogeneousTrig p P r = 0) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ[X], Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1 ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, homogeneousTrig p P t =
        Real.sin ((t - r) / 2) * homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q t) ∧
      homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q r = 2 * deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) r ∧
      deriv (homogeneousTrig (p - 1) Q) r =
        deriv (deriv (homogeneousTrig p P)) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hfactor⟩ := exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient p P hp hP r hr hroot
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, hfactor,
    homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_value_at_root p P Q hQ r hfactor,
    deriv_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_at_root p P Q hQ r hfactor⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_wronskian
statement:
lemma cayleyOperator_wronskian (p : ℕ) (P Q : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    P.eval x * (cayleyOperator p Q).eval x -
        (cayleyOperator p P).eval x * Q.eval x =
      (1 + x ^ 2) * polynomialWronskian P Q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cayleyOperator_eval, cayleyOperator_eval, polynomialWronskian]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_eq_polynomialWronskian_on_chart
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_eq_polynomialWronskian_on_chart
    (θ a b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    sineWronskian θ a b t =
      (Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2) / 2 *
          polynomialWronskian (interpolantPolynomial θ a)
            (interpolantPolynomial θ b) (Real.tan (t / 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineWronskian
  rw [(hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_on_chart θ a t ht).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_on_chart θ b t ht).deriv,
    ← cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ a t ht,
    ← cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ b t ht,
    cayleyOperator_eval, cayleyOperator_eval, polynomialWronskian]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_chart_factor_pos
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_chart_factor_pos (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    0 < (Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 *
      (1 + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : 0 < (Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 :=
    sq_pos_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
  have htan : 0 < 1 + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2 :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
  exact div_pos (mul_pos hcos htan) (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_iff
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_iff
    (θ a b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    sineWronskian θ a b t < 0 ↔
      polynomialWronskian (interpolantPolynomial θ a)
        (interpolantPolynomial θ b) (Real.tan (t / 2)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineWronskian_eq_polynomialWronskian_on_chart θ a b t ht]
  have hiff :
      ((Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2) / 2) *
          polynomialWronskian (interpolantPolynomial θ a)
            (interpolantPolynomial θ b) (Real.tan (t / 2)) <
      ((Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.tan (t / 2) ^ 2) / 2) * 0 ↔
      polynomialWronskian (interpolantPolynomial θ a)
        (interpolantPolynomial θ b) (Real.tan (t / 2)) < 0 :=
    mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (sineWronskian_chart_factor_pos n t ht)
  simpa only [mul_zero] using hiff

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_neg_of_polynomialWronskian_neg
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_neg_of_polynomialWronskian_neg
    (θ a b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0)
    (hW : polynomialWronskian (interpolantPolynomial θ a)
      (interpolantPolynomial θ b) (Real.tan (t / 2)) < 0) :
    sineWronskian θ a b t < 0
proof:
:=
  (sineWronskian_neg_on_chart_iff θ a b t ht).mpr hW

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.no_positive_cut_one
statement: lemma no_positive_cut_one (cut : Fin 1) : ¬0 < cut.val
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angle_lt_of_mem_ordinaryGap
statement:
lemma angle_lt_of_mem_ordinaryGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut)
    {k : Fin n} (hk : k < cut) : angles.angle k < t
proof:
:= by
  have hkle : k ≤ gapPredecessor cut := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hk
  exact (angles.strictMono.monotone hkle).trans_lt ht.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lt_angle_of_mem_ordinaryGap
statement:
lemma lt_angle_of_mem_ordinaryGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut)
    {k : Fin n} (hk : ¬k < cut) : t < angles.angle k
proof:
:=
  ht.2.trans_le (angles.strictMono.monotone (le_of_not_gt hk))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.ordinaryGap_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma ordinaryGap_mem_Ioo (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) :
    t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans_lt ht.1, ht.2.trans (angles.lt_two_pi _)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_half_sub_pos
statement:
private lemma sin_half_sub_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : a < 2 * Real.pi) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hba : b < a) : 0 < Real.sin ((a - b) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_half_sub_neg
statement:
private lemma sin_half_sub_neg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : b < 2 * Real.pi)
    (hab : a < b) : Real.sin ((a - b) / 2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt <;> linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_gapIndexSign
statement: lemma abs_gapIndexSign (cut k : Fin n) : |gapIndexSign cut k| = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapIndexSign
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_nodeIndexSign
statement: lemma abs_nodeIndexSign (j k : Fin n) : |nodeIndexSign j k| = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold nodeIndexSign
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_gapCoefficient
statement: lemma abs_gapCoefficient (cut j : Fin n) : |gapCoefficient cut j| = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapCoefficient
  rw [Finset.abs_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro k hk
  rw [abs_mul, abs_gapIndexSign, abs_nodeIndexSign, one_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one (cut j : Fin n) :
    gapCoefficient cut j = 1 ∨ gapCoefficient cut j = -1
proof:
:=
  abs_eq_abs.mp (by simpa only [abs_one] using abs_gapCoefficient cut j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_at_cut
statement: lemma gapCoefficient_at_cut (cut : Fin n) : gapCoefficient cut cut = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapCoefficient
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro k hk
  by_cases h : k < cut <;> simp [gapIndexSign, nodeIndexSign, h]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.nodeIndexSign_consecutive
statement:
private lemma nodeIndexSign_consecutive {j l k : Fin n} (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val)
    (hkj : k ≠ j) : nodeIndexSign j k = nodeIndexSign l k
proof:
:= by
  have hside : k < j ↔ k < l := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      show k.val < l.val
      omega
    · intro h
      have hkval : k.val ≠ j.val := fun heq => hkj (Fin.ext heq)
      show k.val < j.val
      omega
  simp only [nodeIndexSign, hside]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_consecutive
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_consecutive (cut j l : Fin n) (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val) :
    gapCoefficient cut l =
      -(gapIndexSign cut j * gapIndexSign cut l) * gapCoefficient cut j
proof:
:= by
  have hjlt : j < l := by show j.val < l.val; omega
  have hjne : j ≠ l := ne_of_lt hjlt
  let P : ℝ := ∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j).erase l,
    gapIndexSign cut k * nodeIndexSign j k
  have hprod : (∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase l).erase j,
      gapIndexSign cut k * nodeIndexSign l k) = P := by
    rw [Finset.erase_right_comm]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [← nodeIndexSign_consecutive hjl (Finset.mem_erase.mp
      (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).2).1]
  have hjfactor : gapCoefficient cut j = -gapIndexSign cut l * P := by
    unfold gapCoefficient
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase j)
      (fun k => gapIndexSign cut k * nodeIndexSign j k)
      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hjne.symm, Finset.mem_univ l⟩)]
    have hsign : nodeIndexSign j l = -1 := by
      simp [nodeIndexSign, not_lt.mpr hjlt.le]
    rw [hsign]
    change (gapIndexSign cut l * -1) * P = -gapIndexSign cut l * P
    ring
  have hlfactor : gapCoefficient cut l = gapIndexSign cut j * P := by
    unfold gapCoefficient
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase l)
      (fun k => gapIndexSign cut k * nodeIndexSign l k)
      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hjne, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)]
    rw [show nodeIndexSign l j = 1 by simp [nodeIndexSign, hjlt], hprod, mul_one]
  rw [hjfactor, hlfactor]
  unfold gapIndexSign
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip (cut j l : Fin n) (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val)
    (hlcut : l ≠ cut) : gapCoefficient cut l = -gapCoefficient cut j
proof:
:= by
  have hside : j < cut ↔ l < cut := by
    have hlval : l.val ≠ cut.val := fun heq => hlcut (Fin.ext heq)
    change j.val < cut.val ↔ l.val < cut.val
    omega
  have hsign : gapIndexSign cut j * gapIndexSign cut l = 1 := by
    unfold gapIndexSign
    by_cases h : j < cut
    · simp [h, hside.mp h]
    · have hl : ¬l < cut := fun hl => h (hside.mpr hl)
      simp [h, hl]
  rw [gapCoefficient_consecutive cut j l hjl, hsign, neg_one_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_at_predecessor
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_at_predecessor (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    gapCoefficient cut (gapPredecessor cut) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : (gapPredecessor cut).val + 1 = cut.val := by
    change cut.val - 1 + 1 = cut.val
    omega
  have hp : gapPredecessor cut < cut := by
    show cut.val - 1 < cut.val
    omega
  have h := gapCoefficient_consecutive cut (gapPredecessor cut) cut hpred
  simpa [gapIndexSign, hp, gapCoefficient_at_cut] using h.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.phaseNodes_injective
statement:
lemma CyclicAngles.phaseNodes_injective (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    Function.Injective (phaseNodes angles.angle)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply angles.strictMono.injective
  apply Circle.exp_injOn_Ico (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (by simp)
    ⟨angles.nonneg i, angles.lt_two_pi i⟩ ⟨angles.nonneg j, angles.lt_two_pi j⟩
  exact Circle.coe_injective hij

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_at_node
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_at_node (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut j : Fin n) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) (angles.angle j) =
      gapCoefficient cut j
proof:
:=
  sineInterpolant_at_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective (gapCoefficient cut) j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_numerator_ne_zero_on_gap
statement:
lemma sin_numerator_ne_zero_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (k : Fin n) :
    Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have htturn := ordinaryGap_mem_Ioo angles cut hcut ht
  by_cases hk : k < cut
  · exact (sin_half_sub_pos htturn.2 (angles.nonneg k)
      (angle_lt_of_mem_ordinaryGap angles cut hcut ht hk)).ne'
  · exact (sin_half_sub_neg htturn.1.le (angles.lt_two_pi k)
      (lt_angle_of_mem_ordinaryGap angles cut hcut ht hk)).ne

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_gap
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (j : Fin n) :
    sineCardinal angles.angle j t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact div_ne_zero (sin_numerator_ne_zero_on_gap angles cut hcut ht k)
    (sine_denominator_ne_zero angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
      (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sin_numerator_on_gap
statement:
lemma abs_sin_numerator_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (k : Fin n) :
    |Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2)| =
      gapIndexSign cut k * Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have htturn := ordinaryGap_mem_Ioo angles cut hcut ht
  by_cases hk : k < cut
  · rw [gapIndexSign, if_pos hk, one_mul]
    exact abs_of_pos (sin_half_sub_pos htturn.2 (angles.nonneg k)
      (angle_lt_of_mem_ordinaryGap angles cut hcut ht hk))
  · rw [gapIndexSign, if_neg hk, neg_one_mul]
    exact abs_of_neg (sin_half_sub_neg htturn.1.le (angles.lt_two_pi k)
      (lt_angle_of_mem_ordinaryGap angles cut hcut ht hk))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sin_denominator_ordered
statement:
lemma abs_sin_denominator_ordered (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    |Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2)| =
      nodeIndexSign j k * Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < j
  · rw [nodeIndexSign, if_pos hk, one_mul]
    exact abs_of_pos (sin_half_sub_pos (angles.lt_two_pi j) (angles.nonneg k)
      (angles.strictMono hk))
  · have hjlt : j < k := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hk) hjk
    rw [nodeIndexSign, if_neg hk, neg_one_mul]
    exact abs_of_neg (sin_half_sub_neg (angles.nonneg j) (angles.lt_two_pi k)
      (angles.strictMono hjlt))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sine_ratio_on_gap
statement:
lemma abs_sine_ratio_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    |Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2) /
        Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2)| =
      (gapIndexSign cut k * nodeIndexSign j k) *
        (Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2) /
          Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_div, abs_sin_numerator_on_gap angles cut hcut ht k,
    abs_sin_denominator_ordered angles hjk]
  by_cases hc : k < cut <;> by_cases hj : k < j <;>
    simp [gapIndexSign, nodeIndexSign, hc, hj, neg_div, div_neg]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sineCardinal_on_gap
statement:
theorem abs_sineCardinal_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (j : Fin n) :
    |sineCardinal angles.angle j t| =
      gapCoefficient cut j * sineCardinal angles.angle j t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinal gapCoefficient
  rw [Finset.abs_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact abs_sine_ratio_on_gap angles cut hcut ht (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_mul_sineCardinal_pos
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_mul_sineCardinal_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) (j : Fin n) :
    0 < gapCoefficient cut j * sineCardinal angles.angle j t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_sineCardinal_on_gap angles cut hcut ht j]
  exact abs_pos.mpr (sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_gap angles cut hcut ht j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineLebesgueFunction_on_gap
statement:
theorem sineLebesgueFunction_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) :
    (∑ j, |sineCardinal angles.angle j t|) =
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact abs_sineCardinal_on_gap angles cut hcut ht j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_on_gap
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp t : ℂ) =
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lebesgueFunction_phase]
  exact sineLebesgueFunction_on_gap angles cut hcut ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angle_lt_of_mem_wrapGap
statement:
lemma angle_lt_of_mem_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) (k : Fin n) : angles.angle k < t
proof:
:= by
  have hkle : k ≤ lastNodeIndex hn := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt k.isLt
  exact (angles.strictMono.monotone hkle).trans_lt ht.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapGap_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma wrapGap_mem_Ioo (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans_lt ht.1, ht.2⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_wrapCoefficient
statement: lemma abs_wrapCoefficient (j : Fin n) : |wrapCoefficient j| = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold wrapCoefficient
  rw [Finset.abs_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun k _hk => abs_nodeIndexSign j k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
lemma wrapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one (j : Fin n) :
    wrapCoefficient j = 1 ∨ wrapCoefficient j = -1
proof:
:=
  abs_eq_abs.mp (by simpa only [abs_one] using abs_wrapCoefficient j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_zero
statement:
private lemma gapCoefficient_zero (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    gapCoefficient ⟨0, hn⟩ j = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * wrapCoefficient j
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapCoefficient
  have hsign (k : Fin n) : gapIndexSign ⟨0, hn⟩ k = -1 := by
    simp only [gapIndexSign, Fin.lt_def, Nat.not_lt_zero, if_false]
  simp_rw [hsign]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const]
  simp only [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j), Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, wrapCoefficient]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient
statement:
lemma wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient (hn : 0 < n) (j : Fin n) :
    wrapCoefficient j = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * gapCoefficient ⟨0, hn⟩ j
proof:
:= by
  have heps : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [gapCoefficient_zero hn, ← mul_assoc, heps, one_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_at_first
statement:
lemma wrapCoefficient_at_first (hn : 0 < n) :
    wrapCoefficient (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient hn, gapCoefficient_at_cut, mul_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_at_last
statement: lemma wrapCoefficient_at_last (hn : 0 < n) : wrapCoefficient (lastNodeIndex hn) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold wrapCoefficient
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro k hk
  have hkne : k ≠ lastNodeIndex hn := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
  have hkval : k.val ≠ n - 1 := fun heq => hkne (Fin.ext heq)
  have hklt : k < lastNodeIndex hn := by
    show k.val < n - 1
    omega
  simp [nodeIndexSign, hklt]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_eq_prod_mul_wrapCoefficient
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_eq_prod_mul_wrapCoefficient (cut j : Fin n) :
    gapCoefficient cut j =
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, gapIndexSign cut k) * wrapCoefficient j
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapCoefficient wrapCoefficient
  exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_wrap_flip
statement:
theorem gapCoefficient_wrap_flip (hn : 0 < n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * gapCoefficient cut (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) =
      -gapCoefficient cut (lastNodeIndex hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirstlt : (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) < cut := hcut
  have hfirst : gapIndexSign cut (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) = 1 := by
    simp [gapIndexSign, hfirstlt]
  have hlastle : cut ≤ lastNodeIndex hn := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt cut.isLt
  have hlast : gapIndexSign cut (lastNodeIndex hn) = -1 := by
    simp [gapIndexSign, not_lt.mpr hlastle]
  have hfirstprod := Finset.prod_erase (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) hfirst
  have hlastprod := Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (gapIndexSign cut) (Finset.mem_univ (lastNodeIndex hn))
  rw [hlast, neg_one_mul] at hlastprod
  have heps : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [gapCoefficient_eq_prod_mul_wrapCoefficient,
    gapCoefficient_eq_prod_mul_wrapCoefficient,
    wrapCoefficient_at_first, wrapCoefficient_at_last, mul_one, hfirstprod]
  calc
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * ((∏ k, gapIndexSign cut k) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)) =
        (∏ k, gapIndexSign cut k) *
          ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)) := by ring
    _ = ∏ k, gapIndexSign cut k := by rw [heps, mul_one]
    _ = -(∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase (lastNodeIndex hn), gapIndexSign cut k) := hlastprod.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_consecutive_flip
statement:
theorem wrapCoefficient_consecutive_flip (hn : 0 < n) (j l : Fin n)
    (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val) : wrapCoefficient l = -wrapCoefficient j
proof:
:= by
  have hlzero : l ≠ (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    change l.val = 0 at this
    omega
  rw [wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient hn l,
    wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient hn j,
    gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip ⟨0, hn⟩ j l hjl hlzero, mul_neg]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_numerator_pos_on_wrapGap
proof:
:=
  sin_half_sub_pos ht.2 (angles.nonneg k) (angle_lt_of_mem_wrapGap angles ht k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_wrapGap
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) (j : Fin n) : sineCardinal angles.angle j t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact div_ne_zero (sin_numerator_pos_on_wrapGap angles ht k).ne'
    (sine_denominator_ne_zero angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
      (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sine_ratio_on_wrapGap
statement:
lemma abs_sine_ratio_on_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    |Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2) /
        Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2)| =
      nodeIndexSign j k * (Real.sin ((t - angles.angle k) / 2) /
        Real.sin ((angles.angle j - angles.angle k) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (sin_numerator_pos_on_wrapGap angles ht k),
    abs_sin_denominator_ordered angles hjk]
  by_cases h : k < j <;> simp [nodeIndexSign, h, div_neg]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sineCardinal_on_wrapGap
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinal wrapCoefficient
  rw [Finset.abs_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact abs_sine_ratio_on_wrapGap angles ht (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapCoefficient_mul_sineCardinal_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_sineCardinal_on_wrapGap angles ht j]
  exact abs_pos.mpr (sineCardinal_ne_zero_on_wrapGap angles ht j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineLebesgueFunction_on_wrapGap
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact abs_sineCardinal_on_wrapGap angles ht j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_on_wrapGap
statement:
theorem lebesgueFunction_on_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ wrapGap angles) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp t : ℂ) =
      sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lebesgueFunction_phase]
  exact sineLebesgueFunction_on_wrapGap angles ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_at_node
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_at_node (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (j : Fin n) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (angles.angle j) = wrapCoefficient j
proof:
:=
  sineInterpolant_at_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective wrapCoefficient j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_at_last
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_at_last (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [wrapInterpolant_at_node, wrapCoefficient_at_last]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_at_zero
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_at_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient 0 = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← angles.first_eq_zero, wrapInterpolant_at_node, wrapCoefficient_at_first]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_add_two_pi
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_add_two_pi (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (t + 2 * Real.pi) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  simp_rw [sineCardinal_add_two_pi]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.wrapInterpolant_at_two_pi
statement:
lemma wrapInterpolant_at_two_pi (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (2 * Real.pi) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := wrapInterpolant_add_two_pi angles 0
  rw [zero_add, wrapInterpolant_at_zero, ← mul_pow] at h
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_eq_numerator_div_denominator
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_eq_numerator_div_denominator (z : Fin n → ℂ) (k : Fin n)
    (w : ℂ) :
    ‖cardinal z k w‖ = cardinalNormNumerator z k w / cardinalNormDenominator z k
proof:
:= by
  unfold cardinal cardinalNormNumerator cardinalNormDenominator
  rw [norm_prod]
  simp_rw [norm_div]
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinalNormDenominator_pos
statement:
lemma cardinalNormDenominator_pos (z : Fin n → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective z)
    (k : Fin n) : 0 < cardinalNormDenominator z k
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro l hl
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun heq =>
    (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1 (hinj heq).symm))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_cardinal_numerator_lower
statement:
lemma circle_cardinal_numerator_lower (z : Fin n → Circle) (k : Fin n) (y : Circle)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hsep : ∀ l, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖) :
    c ^ (n - 1) ≤ cardinalNormNumerator (fun l => (z l : ℂ)) k (y : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (∏ _l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, c) ≤
      ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, ‖(y : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ :=
    Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => hc) (fun l _ => hsep l)
  simpa only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ k),
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, cardinalNormNumerator] using hprod

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_cardinal_numerator_upper_of_near_node
statement:
lemma circle_cardinal_numerator_upper_of_near_node (z : Fin n → Circle)
    (k l : Fin n) (hkl : l ≠ k) (x : Circle) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hnear : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ ≤ b) :
    cardinalNormNumerator (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) k (x : ℂ) ≤ b * 2 ^ (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.erase k
  have hl : l ∈ s := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hkl, Finset.mem_univ l⟩
  have hrest : (∏ i ∈ s.erase l, ‖(x : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 2) := by
    have hprod := Finset.prod_le_prod
      (fun i (_ : i ∈ s.erase l) => norm_nonneg ((x : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)))
      (fun i (_ : i ∈ s.erase l) => norm_circle_sub_le_two x (z i))
    have hcard : (s.erase l).card = n - 2 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hl]
      simp only [s, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ k), Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin]
      omega
    simpa only [Finset.prod_const, hcard] using hprod
  have hrest0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ s.erase l, ‖(x : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖ :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  change (∏ i ∈ s, ‖(x : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖) ≤ _
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s (fun i => ‖(x : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖) hl]
  exact mul_le_mul hnear hrest hrest0 hb

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_comparison_factor_mul_pow
statement:
lemma cardinal_comparison_factor_mul_pow (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (c : ℝ) :
    (2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 2) = c ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : n - 1 = (n - 2) + 1 := by omega
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 2) * 2 := by
    rw [hexp, pow_succ]
  rw [div_pow, htwo]
  field_simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_cardinal_comparison_of_near_node
statement:
lemma circle_cardinal_comparison_of_near_node (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (z : Fin n → Circle) (hinj : Function.Injective z) (k l : Fin n) (hkl : l ≠ k)
    (y x : Circle) (c b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsep : ∀ i, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖)
    (hnear : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ ≤ b) :
    2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1) * ‖cardinal (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) k (x : ℂ)‖ ≤
      b * ‖cardinal (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) k (y : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  let Z : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => (z i : ℂ)
  let K : ℝ := 2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
    (pow_nonneg (div_nonneg hc.le (by norm_num)) _)
  have hy := circle_cardinal_numerator_lower z k y c hc.le hsep
  have hx := circle_cardinal_numerator_upper_of_near_node z k l hkl x b hb.le hnear
  have hnum : K * cardinalNormNumerator Z k (x : ℂ) ≤
      b * cardinalNormNumerator Z k (y : ℂ) := by
    calc
      K * cardinalNormNumerator Z k (x : ℂ) ≤ K * (b * 2 ^ (n - 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hK
      _ = b * c ^ (n - 1) := by
        rw [show K * (b * 2 ^ (n - 2)) =
          b * (K * 2 ^ (n - 2)) by ring]
        rw [cardinal_comparison_factor_mul_pow hsize]
      _ ≤ b * cardinalNormNumerator Z k (y : ℂ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb.le
  have hden : 0 < cardinalNormDenominator Z k :=
    cardinalNormDenominator_pos Z (Circle.coe_injective.comp hinj) k
  change K * ‖cardinal Z k (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ b * ‖cardinal Z k (y : ℂ)‖
  rw [norm_cardinal_eq_numerator_div_denominator, norm_cardinal_eq_numerator_div_denominator,
    ← mul_div_assoc, ← mul_div_assoc]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hden.le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_cardinal_comparison
statement:
lemma circle_cardinal_comparison (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (z : Fin n → Circle) (hinj : Function.Injective z) (y x : Circle) (c b : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b) (hsep : ∀ i, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖)
    (hnear : ∀ k, ∃ l, l ≠ k ∧ ‖(x : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ ≤ b) :
    ∀ k, 2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1) * ‖cardinal (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) k (x : ℂ)‖ ≤
      b * ‖cardinal (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) k (y : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨l, hkl, hl⟩ := hnear k
  exact circle_cardinal_comparison_of_near_node hsize z hinj k l hkl y x c b hc hb hsep hl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_lebesgue_comparison
statement:
lemma circle_lebesgue_comparison (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (z : Fin n → Circle) (hinj : Function.Injective z) (y x : Circle) (c b : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b) (hsep : ∀ i, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖)
    (hnear : ∀ k, ∃ l, l ≠ k ∧ ‖(x : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ ≤ b) :
    2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1) * lebesgueFunction (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) ≤
      b * lebesgueFunction (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) (y : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ =>
    circle_cardinal_comparison hsize z hinj y x c b hc hb hsep hnear k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_lebesgue_lower_of_close_pair
statement:
lemma circle_lebesgue_lower_of_close_pair (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (z : Fin n → Circle) (hinj : Function.Injective z) (k l : Fin n) (hkl : l ≠ k)
    (y : Circle) (c b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsep : ∀ i, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖)
    (hnear : ‖(z k : ℂ) - (z l : ℂ)‖ ≤ b) :
    2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1) ≤
      b * lebesgueFunction (fun i => (z i : ℂ)) (y : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hother : ∀ j, ∃ i, i ≠ j ∧ ‖(z k : ℂ) - (z i : ℂ)‖ ≤ b := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · subst j
      exact ⟨l, hkl, hnear⟩
    · exact ⟨k, Ne.symm hj, by simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using hb.le⟩
  have h := circle_lebesgue_comparison hsize z hinj y (z k) c b hc hb hsep hother
  rw [lebesgueFunction_at_node (fun i => (z i : ℂ))
    (Circle.coe_injective.comp hinj) k, mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_lower_of_separated_point_close_pair
statement:
lemma amplification_lower_of_separated_point_close_pair (hsize : 2 ≤ n)
    (nodes : NodeFamily n) (k l : Fin n) (hkl : l ≠ k) (y : Circle) (c b : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsep : ∀ i, c ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) - nodes.coordinates i‖)
    (hnear : ‖nodes.coordinates k - nodes.coordinates l‖ ≤ b) :
    2 * (c / 2) ^ (n - 1) / b ≤ amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hb).mpr
  have h := circle_lebesgue_lower_of_close_pair hsize nodes.point nodes.injective
    k l hkl y c b hc hb hsep hnear
  exact h.trans (by
    have heval := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_amplification nodes y) hb.le
    change b * lebesgueFunction (fun i => (nodes.point i : ℂ)) (y : ℂ) ≤
      b * amplification nodes at heval
    simpa only [mul_comm] using heval)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivity_coherent_cofactors
statement:
theorem peakSensitivity_coherent_cofactors (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    (∀ i, 0 < rectangularCofactor (peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize) i) ∨
      (∀ i, rectangularCofactor (peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize) i < 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact peakSensitivity_left_relation_coherent_sign angles hsize _
    (rectangularCofactor_left_relation _)
    (rectangularCofactor_ne_zero_of_first_minor _
      (peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero angles hsize 0))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivity_augmented_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem peakSensitivity_augmented_det_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    (augmentedOnesMatrix (peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize)).det ≠ 0

:=
  augmentedOnesMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors _
    (peakSensitivity_coherent_cofactors angles hsize)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivity_adjacent_difference_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem peakSensitivity_adjacent_difference_det_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    (adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix (peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize)).det ≠ 0

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_zeroPolynomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogeneousTrig_zeroPolynomial (p : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (0 : ℝ[X]) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousTrig]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_add
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_add (p : ℕ) (P Q : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (P + Q) t = homogeneousTrig p P t + homogeneousTrig p Q t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTrig, Polynomial.coeff_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_C_mul
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_C_mul (p : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (P : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (C a * P) t = a * homogeneousTrig p P t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTrig, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_finset_sum
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (p : ℕ) (s : Finset ι)
    (P : ι → ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (∑ i ∈ s, P i) t = ∑ i ∈ s, homogeneousTrig p (P i) t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi, homogeneousTrig_add, ih]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_linear_combination
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_linear_combination {ι : Type*} (p : ℕ) (s : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig p (∑ i ∈ s, C (a i) * P i) t =
      ∑ i ∈ s, a i * homogeneousTrig p (P i) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousTrig_finset_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact homogeneousTrig_C_mul p (a i) (P i) t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_natDegree_linear_combination_le
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_natDegree_linear_combination_le {ι : Type*}
    (p : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ[X])
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, (P i).natDegree ≤ p) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, C (a i) * P i).natDegree ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _
    (fun i hi => (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (hP i hi))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_of_distinct_roots
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_of_distinct_roots (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) (root : Fin (p + 1) → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig p P (root i) = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hP
  have hcount := homogeneousTrig_distinct_root_count p P hP hdegree root hinj hbound hroot
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_iff (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p) : homogeneousTrig p P = 0 ↔ P = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    let root : Fin (p + 1) → ℝ := fun i => 2 * Real.pi * i.val / (p + 1)
    have hden : (0 : ℝ) < p + 1 := by positivity
    have hmono : StrictMono root := by
      intro i j hij
      dsimp [root]
      apply div_lt_div_of_pos_right _ hden
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by exact_mod_cast hij) (by positivity)
    apply homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_of_distinct_roots p P hdegree root hmono.injective
    · intro i
      constructor
      · dsimp [root]
        positivity
      · dsimp [root]
        apply (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mpr
        have hi : (i.val : ℝ) < p + 1 := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    · intro i
      exact congrFun hzero (root i)
  · rintro rfl
    funext t
    exact homogeneousTrig_zeroPolynomial p t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_linear_combination_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_linear_combination_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type*} (p : ℕ)
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ[X])
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, (P i).natDegree ≤ p) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, C (a i) * P i) = 0 ↔
      ∀ t, (∑ i ∈ s, a i * homogeneousTrig p (P i) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero t
    rw [← homogeneousTrig_linear_combination, hzero]
    exact homogeneousTrig_zeroPolynomial p t
  · intro hzero
    apply (homogeneousTrig_eq_zero_iff p _
      (homogeneousTrig_natDegree_linear_combination_le p s a P hP)).mp
    funext t
    rw [homogeneousTrig_linear_combination]
    exact hzero t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_mem_space
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_mem_space (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) :
    homogeneousTrig p P ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace p
proof: := ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace
statement:
lemma continuous_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace p) : Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
  exact continuous_homogeneousTrig p P

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.distinct_root_count_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace
statement:
lemma distinct_root_count_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace {m : ℕ} (p : ℕ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace p) (hne : f ≠ 0)
    (root : Fin m → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root)
    (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0) : m ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
  have hPne : P ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hne
    funext t
    exact homogeneousTrig_zeroPolynomial p t
  exact homogeneousTrig_distinct_root_count p P hPne hP root hinj hbound hroot

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootProduct_eq_mul_complement
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteRootProduct, Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_compl k]
  simp only [finiteRootComplement, Finset.compl_singleton]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootComplement_eval_self_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finiteRootComplement, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro l hl
  have hlk : l ≠ k := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hd.ne hlk.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootProduct_derivative_eval_root
statement:
lemma finiteRootProduct_derivative_eval_root {m : ℕ}
    (d : Fin m → ℝ) (k : Fin m) :
    (finiteRootProduct d).derivative.eval (d k) =
      (finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteRootProduct_eq_mul_complement d k, Polynomial.derivative_mul]
  simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootBasis_eval_self
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteRootBasis, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (finiteRootComplement_eval_self_ne_zero hd k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootBasis_eval_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteRootBasis, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  suffices (finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d l) = 0 by rw [this, mul_zero]
  simp only [finiteRootComplement, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hlk, Finset.mem_univ l⟩)
  simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootBasis_eq_lagrangeBasis
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq Finset.univ hd.injOn
  · have hEvalNe := finiteRootComplement_eval_self_ne_zero hd k
    have hComplementNe : finiteRootComplement d k ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      rw [hzero, Polynomial.eval_zero] at hEvalNe
      exact hEvalNe rfl
    rw [finiteRootBasis, Polynomial.degree_mul,
      Polynomial.degree_C (inv_ne_zero hEvalNe), zero_add,
      Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hComplementNe,
      finiteRootComplement, natDegree_finset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ k), Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_lt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt k.isLt) Nat.zero_lt_one
  · have hdegree := Lagrange.degree_basis hd.injOn (Finset.mem_univ k)
    rw [hdegree, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_lt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt k.isLt) Nat.zero_lt_one
  · intro l _hl
    by_cases hlk : l = k
    · subst l
      rw [finiteRootBasis_eval_self hd]
      exact (Lagrange.eval_basis_self hd.injOn (Finset.mem_univ k)).symm
    · rw [finiteRootBasis_eval_of_ne k l hlk]
      exact (Lagrange.eval_basis_of_ne (Ne.symm hlk) (Finset.mem_univ l)).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootBasis_wronskian
statement:
lemma finiteRootBasis_wronskian {m : ℕ} (d : Fin m → ℝ)
    (scale : ℝ) (k : Fin m) (x : ℝ) :
    ((finiteRootProduct d * C scale).eval x *
        (finiteRootBasis d k).derivative.eval x -
      (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval x *
        (finiteRootBasis d k).eval x) =
      -(scale * ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k))⁻¹) *
        ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteRootProduct_eq_mul_complement d k]
  simp only [finiteRootBasis, Polynomial.derivative_mul,
    Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X, Polynomial.derivative_C,
    sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_zero,
    Polynomial.eval_one]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootScaledBasis_wronskian
statement:
lemma finiteRootScaledBasis_wronskian {m : ℕ}
    (d : Fin m → ℝ) (scale value : ℝ) (k : Fin m) (x : ℝ) :
    ((finiteRootProduct d * C scale).eval x *
        (C value * finiteRootBasis d k).derivative.eval x -
      (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval x *
        (C value * finiteRootBasis d k).eval x) =
      -(value * scale *
          ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k))⁻¹) *
        ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := finiteRootBasis_wronskian d scale k x
  calc
    (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).eval x *
          (C value * finiteRootBasis d k).derivative.eval x -
        (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval x *
          (C value * finiteRootBasis d k).eval x =
        value * ((finiteRootProduct d * C scale).eval x *
          (finiteRootBasis d k).derivative.eval x -
        (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval x *
          (finiteRootBasis d k).eval x) := by
            simp only [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_C,
              zero_mul, zero_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
            ring
    _ = value * (-(scale *
          ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k))⁻¹) *
        ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2) := by rw [hbase]
    _ = -(value * scale *
          ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k))⁻¹) *
        ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2 := by ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootInterpolant_eq_lagrange
statement:
lemma finiteRootInterpolant_eq_lagrange {m : ℕ}
    {d : Fin m → ℝ} (hd : Function.Injective d) (S : ℝ[X]) :
    finiteRootInterpolant d S =
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ d (fun k => S.eval (d k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteRootInterpolant, Lagrange.interpolate_apply]
  simp only [finiteRootBasis_eq_lagrangeBasis hd]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootInterpolant_degree_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteRootInterpolant_eq_lagrange hd]
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := Finset.univ) (v := d)
      (fun k => S.eval (d k)) hd.injOn

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteRootInterpolant_eval_root
statement:
lemma finiteRootInterpolant_eval_root {m : ℕ}
    {d : Fin m → ℝ} (hd : Function.Injective d) (S : ℝ[X])
    (k : Fin m) :
    (finiteRootInterpolant d S).eval (d k) = S.eval (d k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteRootInterpolant_eq_lagrange hd]
  exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ hd.injOn (Finset.mem_univ k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_finiteRootComplement_eval_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : ∃ k : Fin m, x = d k
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨k, finiteRootComplement_eval_self_ne_zero hd k⟩
  · let k : Fin m := ⟨0, hm⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    simp only [finiteRootComplement, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro l _hl
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun heq => hx ⟨l, heq⟩)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finite_markov_wronskian_neg
statement:
theorem finite_markov_wronskian_neg {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (d : Fin m → ℝ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (scale : ℝ)
    (hscale : scale ≠ 0) (S : ℝ[X]) (hSdegree : S.natDegree ≤ m)
    (hresidue : ∀ k : Fin m,
      0 < S.eval (d k) *
        (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval (d k))
    (x : ℝ) :
    (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).eval x * S.derivative.eval x -
      (finiteRootProduct d * C scale).derivative.eval x * S.eval x < 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : ℝ[X] := finiteRootProduct d
  let D : ℝ[X] := M * C scale
  let R : ℝ[X] := finiteRootInterpolant d S
  have hMmonic : M.Monic := by
    change (∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)), (X - C (d k))).Monic
    exact monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun k _hk => monic_X_sub_C (d k)
  have hMne : M ≠ 0 := hMmonic.ne_zero
  have hMdegree : M.natDegree = m := by
    change (∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)),
      (X - C (d k))).natDegree = m
    rw [natDegree_finset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin]
  have hRdegree : R.degree < m := by
    simpa only [R] using finiteRootInterpolant_degree_lt hd S
  have hRnatDegree : R.natDegree ≤ m := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_degree_le]
    exact hRdegree.le
  have hMdvd : M ∣ S - R := by
    change (∏ k : Fin m, (X - C (d k))) ∣ S - R
    apply Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
    · exact pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C hd
    · intro k
      rw [Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot, Polynomial.IsRoot,
        Polynomial.eval_sub]
      change S.eval (d k) - (finiteRootInterpolant d S).eval (d k) = 0
      rw [finiteRootInterpolant_eval_root hd S k, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hMdvd
  have hSRdegree : (S - R).natDegree ≤ m :=
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le S R).trans (max_le hSdegree hRnatDegree)
  have hQdegree : Q.natDegree = 0 := by
    by_cases hQzero : Q = 0
    · simp [hQzero]
    · have hproduct : (M * Q).natDegree ≤ m := by
        rw [← hQ]
        exact hSRdegree
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul hMne hQzero, hMdegree] at hproduct
      omega
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero.mp hQdegree
  have hSfactor : S = R + M * C q := by
    rw [← hq] at hQ
    calc
      S = (S - R) + R := by ring
      _ = M * C q + R := by rw [hQ]
      _ = R + M * C q := by ring
  have hWinvariant :
      D.eval x * S.derivative.eval x - D.derivative.eval x * S.eval x =
        D.eval x * R.derivative.eval x - D.derivative.eval x * R.eval x := by
    rw [hSfactor]
    dsimp only [D]
    simp only [Polynomial.derivative_add, Polynomial.derivative_mul,
      Polynomial.derivative_C, mul_zero, add_zero,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    ring
  let coefficient : Fin m → ℝ := fun k =>
    S.eval (d k) * scale *
      ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k))⁻¹
  have hcoefficient : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < coefficient k := by
    intro k
    let e : ℝ := (finiteRootComplement d k).eval (d k)
    have he : e ≠ 0 := finiteRootComplement_eval_self_ne_zero hd k
    have hderivative : D.derivative.eval (d k) = e * scale := by
      simp only [D, M, Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_C,
        mul_zero, add_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [finiteRootProduct_derivative_eval_root]
    have hpositive : 0 < S.eval (d k) * (e * scale) := by
      rw [← hderivative]
      simpa only [D, M] using hresidue k
    have he2 : 0 < e ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero he
    have heq : coefficient k * e ^ 2 = S.eval (d k) * (e * scale) := by
      dsimp only [coefficient, e]
      field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hWsum :
      D.eval x * R.derivative.eval x - D.derivative.eval x * R.eval x =
        -∑ k : Fin m, coefficient k *
          ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [R, finiteRootInterpolant, Polynomial.derivative_sum,
      Polynomial.eval_finset_sum]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _hk
    rw [finiteRootScaledBasis_wronskian]
    simp only [coefficient]
    ring
  have hsumPos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin m, coefficient k *
      ((finiteRootComplement d k).eval x) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro k _hk
      exact mul_nonneg (hcoefficient k).le (sq_nonneg _)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_finiteRootComplement_eval_ne_zero hm hd x
      exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ k,
        mul_pos (hcoefficient k) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hk)⟩
  rw [hWinvariant, hWsum]
  exact neg_neg_of_pos hsumPos

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSum_exists_zero_between_opposite_values
statement:
private lemma crossSum_exists_zero_between_opposite_values (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hopposite : f b = -f a) (hne : f a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo a b ∧ f t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
  · have hright : 0 < f b := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hneg, hright⟩
  · have hright : f b < 0 := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo' hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hright, hpos⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_root_on_gap
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_root_on_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hkpos : 0 < k.val) (hk : k < i ∨ j < k) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (gapPredecessor k)) (angles.angle k) ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : (gapPredecessor k).val + 1 = k.val := by
    change k.val - 1 + 1 = k.val
    omega
  have hpk : gapPredecessor k < k := by change k.val - 1 < k.val; omega
  have hpredoutside : gapPredecessor k < i ∨ j ≤ gapPredecessor k := by
    rcases hk with hki | hjk
    · exact Or.inl (hpk.trans hki)
    · exact Or.inr (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hjk)
  have hkoutside : k < i ∨ j ≤ k := hk.imp id le_of_lt
  apply crossSum_exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j))
    (angles.strictMono hpk)
  · exact crossSumInterpolant_consecutive_flip angles i j (gapPredecessor k) k
      hij hpred hpredoutside hkoutside
  · exact (crossSumInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff angles i j
      (gapPredecessor k) hij.le).mpr hpredoutside

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumInterpolant_wrap_opposite
statement:
theorem crossSumInterpolant_wrap_opposite (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (2 * Real.pi) =
      -sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn))
proof:
:= by
  have hzlt : (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) < i := hi
  have hlast : j ≤ lastNodeIndex hn := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt j.isLt
  have hzero : sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) 0 =
      2 * gapCoefficient i (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) := by
    rw [← angles.first_eq_zero]
    exact crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j _ hij.le (Or.inl hzlt)
  have hlastvalue := crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j
    (lastNodeIndex hn) hij.le (Or.inr hlast)
  have hperiod := sineInterpolant_add_two_pi angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) 0
  rw [zero_add, hzero] at hperiod
  calc
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (2 * Real.pi) =
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (2 * gapCoefficient i ⟨0, hn⟩) := hperiod
    _ = 2 * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * gapCoefficient i ⟨0, hn⟩) := by ring
    _ = -(2 * gapCoefficient i (lastNodeIndex hn)) := by
      rw [gapCoefficient_wrap_flip hn i hi]
      ring
    _ = -sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) := by rw [hlastvalue]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_root_on_wrapGap
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_root_on_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ wrapGap angles ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply crossSum_exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j))
    (angles.lt_two_pi (lastNodeIndex hn))
  · exact crossSumInterpolant_wrap_opposite angles i j hij hi
  · exact (crossSumInterpolant_at_node_ne_zero_iff angles i j
      (lastNodeIndex hn) hij.le).mpr (Or.inr (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt j.isLt))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_root_at_index
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_root_at_index (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hkj : k ≠ j) :
    ∃ t, crossSumRootLocation angles i j k t ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmiddle : i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · exact ⟨angles.angle k, by simp [crossSumRootLocation, hmiddle],
      crossSumInterpolant_at_node_inside angles i j k hij.le hmiddle.1 hmiddle.2⟩
  · have houtside : k < i ∨ j < k := by
      have hneq : k.val ≠ j.val := fun h => hkj (Fin.ext h)
      by_cases hki : k < i
      · exact Or.inl hki
      · right
        have hik : i ≤ k := le_of_not_gt hki
        have hjk : j ≤ k := le_of_not_gt (fun h => hmiddle ⟨hik, h⟩)
        change j.val < k.val
        have hjkval : j.val ≤ k.val := hjk
        omega
    by_cases hkzero : k.val = 0
    · have hipos : 0 < i.val := by
        rcases houtside with hki | hjk
        · have hval : k.val < i.val := hki; omega
        · have hval : j.val < k.val := hjk; omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hz⟩ := exists_crossSum_root_on_wrapGap angles i j hij hipos
      exact ⟨t, by simpa [crossSumRootLocation, hmiddle, hkzero] using ht, hz⟩
    · have hkpos : 0 < k.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hkzero
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hz⟩ := exists_crossSum_root_on_gap angles i j k hij hkpos houtside
      exact ⟨t, by simpa [crossSumRootLocation, hmiddle, hkzero] using ht, hz⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumRootLocation_le_angle
statement:
lemma crossSumRootLocation_le_angle (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : crossSumRootLocation angles i j k t)
    (hregular : k.val ≠ 0 ∨ i ≤ k ∧ k < j) : t ≤ angles.angle k
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossSumRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hmiddle hkzero
  · exact ht.le
  · rcases hregular with hk | hmiddle'
    · exact (hk hkzero).elim
    · exact (hmiddle hmiddle').elim
  · exact ht.2.le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angle_lt_of_crossSumRootLocation_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hlpos : 0 < l.val := by have hval : k.val < l.val := hkl; omega
  unfold crossSumRootLocation at hu
  split_ifs at hu with hmiddle hlzero
  · rw [hu]
    exact angles.strictMono hkl
  · omega
  · exact (angles.strictMono.monotone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hkl)).trans_lt hu.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumRootLocation_distinct_of_lt
statement:
lemma crossSumRootLocation_distinct_of_lt (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k l : Fin n) (hkl : k < l) {t u : ℝ}
    (ht : crossSumRootLocation angles i j k t)
    (hu : crossSumRootLocation angles i j l u) : t ≠ u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hregular : k.val ≠ 0 ∨ i ≤ k ∧ k < j
  · exact ne_of_lt ((crossSumRootLocation_le_angle angles i j k ht hregular).trans_lt
      (angle_lt_of_crossSumRootLocation_of_lt angles i j k l hkl hu))
  · have hkzero : k.val = 0 := by tauto
    have hmiddle : ¬(i ≤ k ∧ k < j) := by tauto
    have hwrap : t ∈ wrapGap angles := by
      simpa [crossSumRootLocation, hmiddle, hkzero] using ht
    have hlzero : l.val ≠ 0 := by have hval : k.val < l.val := hkl; omega
    have huless := crossSumRootLocation_le_angle angles i j l hu (Or.inl hlzero)
    exact ne_of_gt (huless.trans_lt (angle_lt_of_mem_wrapGap angles hwrap l))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumRootLocation_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma crossSumRootLocation_mem_Ico (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : crossSumRootLocation angles i j k t) :
    t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossSumRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hmiddle hkzero
  · rw [ht]
    exact ⟨angles.nonneg k, angles.lt_two_pi k⟩
  · exact ⟨(wrapGap_mem_Ioo angles ht).1.le, ht.2⟩
  · exact ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans ht.1.le, ht.2.trans (angles.lt_two_pi k)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_roots_on_erase
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_roots_on_erase (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : ↥(Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin n)) → ℝ, Function.Injective root ∧
      (∀ k, crossSumRootLocation angles i j k.val (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin n))
  have hz (k : s) : ∃ t, crossSumRootLocation angles i j k.val t ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0 :=
    exists_crossSum_root_at_index angles i j k.val hij (Finset.mem_erase.mp k.property).1
  let root : s → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (hz k)
  have hloc (k : s) : crossSumRootLocation angles i j k.val (root k) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hz k)).1
  refine ⟨root, ?_, hloc, fun k => crossSumRootLocation_mem_Ico angles i j k.val
    (hloc k), fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hz k)).2⟩
  intro k l heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  rcases lt_trichotomy k.val l.val with hkl | hkl | hlk
  · exact False.elim ((crossSumRootLocation_distinct_of_lt angles i j k.val l.val hkl
      (hloc k) (hloc l)) heq)
  · exact hkl
  · exact False.elim ((crossSumRootLocation_distinct_of_lt angles i j l.val k.val hlk
      (hloc l) (hloc k)) heq.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumRootIndex_ne_cut
statement:
lemma crossSumRootIndex_ne_cut (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n - 1)) :
    crossSumRootIndex j k ≠ j
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_erase.mp
    (((Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp) k).property)).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_roots_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_roots_with_locations (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, Function.Injective root ∧
      (∀ k, crossSumRootLocation angles i j (crossSumRootIndex j k) (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨root, hinj, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ := exists_crossSum_roots_on_erase angles i j hij
  let e := (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp :
    (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin n)).card = n - 1)
  exact ⟨fun k => root (e k), hinj.comp e.injective, fun k => hloc (e k),
    fun k => hbound (e k), fun k => hroot (e k)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
lemma crossSumPolynomial_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
    (fun k => ⟨angles.nonneg k, angles.lt_two_pi k⟩) (crossSumCoefficient i j) j
  exact (crossSumCoefficient_ne_zero_iff i j j hij.le).mpr (Or.inr le_rfl)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossSum_saturated_roots_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_crossSum_saturated_roots_with_locations (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, Function.Injective root ∧
      (∀ k, crossSumRootLocation angles i j (crossSumRootIndex j k) (root k)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)) (root k) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0 ↔
          ∃ k, root k = t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hinj, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ := exists_crossSum_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  have hP := crossSumPolynomial_ne_zero angles i j hij
  refine ⟨root, hinj, hloc, hbound, hroot, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots angles.angle
      (crossSumCoefficient i j) hP root hinj hbound hroot
  · intro t ht
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
        (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j))
        (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)) hP
        (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _) (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
        (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hinj hbound hroot t ht hz
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact hroot k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_sym_interval_lower_bound
statement:
lemma sin_sym_interval_lower_bound (r x : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hlo : r ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ Real.pi - r) :
    Real.sin r ≤ Real.sin x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ≤ Real.pi / 2
  · exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hx hlo
  · rw [← Real.sin_pi_sub x]
    exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_quarter_gap_pos
statement:
lemma sin_quarter_gap_pos (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hwidth : b - a ≤ 2 * Real.pi) :
    0 < Real.sin ((b - a) / 4)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
  · linarith
  · linarith [Real.pi_pos]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub_lower_of_half_angle
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub_lower_of_half_angle (r t s : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hlo : r ≤ |(t - s) / 2|) (hhi : |(t - s) / 2| ≤ Real.pi - r) :
    2 * Real.sin r ≤ ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_phase_sub, Real.abs_sin_eq_sin_abs_of_abs_le_pi (by linarith)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sin_sym_interval_lower_bound r _ hr hlo hhi)
    (by norm_num)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound
statement:
lemma norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound (a b v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ 2 * Real.pi) (hout : v ≤ a ∨ b ≤ v) :
    2 * Real.sin ((b - a) / 4) ≤
      ‖(Circle.exp ((a + b) / 2) : ℂ) - (Circle.exp v : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_phase_sub_lower_of_half_angle
  · linarith
  · rcases hout with hva | hbv
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ ((a + b) / 2 - v) / 2)]
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : ((a + b) / 2 - v) / 2 ≤ 0)]
      linarith
  · rcases hout with hva | hbv
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ ((a + b) / 2 - v) / 2)]
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : ((a + b) / 2 - v) / 2 ≤ 0)]
      linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound_pos
statement:
lemma norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound_pos (a b v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ 2 * Real.pi) (hout : v ≤ a ∨ b ≤ v) :
    0 < 2 * Real.sin ((b - a) / 4) ∧
      2 * Real.sin ((b - a) / 4) ≤
        ‖(Circle.exp ((a + b) / 2) : ℂ) - (Circle.exp v : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mul_pos (by norm_num) (sin_quarter_gap_pos a b hab (by linarith)), ?_⟩
  exact norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound a b v ha hab hb hv0 hvT hout

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_midpoint_sub_pos
statement:
lemma norm_phase_midpoint_sub_pos (a b v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ 2 * Real.pi) (hout : v ≤ a ∨ b ≤ v) :
    0 < ‖(Circle.exp ((a + b) / 2) : ℂ) - (Circle.exp v : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le
    (norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound_pos a b v ha hab hb hv0 hvT hout).1
    (norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound a b v ha hab hb hv0 hvT hout)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_quarter_le_of_gap_width
statement:
lemma sin_quarter_le_of_gap_width (d a b : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hlo : d ≤ b - a) (hhi : b - a ≤ 2 * Real.pi) :
    Real.sin (d / 4) ≤ Real.sin ((b - a) / 4)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
    (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_midpoint_sub_uniform_lower_bound
statement:
lemma norm_phase_midpoint_sub_uniform_lower_bound (d a b v : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hwidth : d ≤ b - a)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ 2 * Real.pi) (hout : v ≤ a ∨ b ≤ v) :
    0 < 2 * Real.sin (d / 4) ∧
      2 * Real.sin (d / 4) ≤
        ‖(Circle.exp ((a + b) / 2) : ℂ) - (Circle.exp v : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mul_pos (by norm_num) ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sin_quarter_le_of_gap_width d a b hd.le hwidth (by linarith))
      (by norm_num)).trans
        (norm_phase_midpoint_sub_lower_bound a b v ha hab hb hv0 hvT hout)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.phase_midpoint_ne_of_outside
statement:
lemma phase_midpoint_ne_of_outside (a b v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ 2 * Real.pi) (hout : v ≤ a ∨ b ≤ v) :
    (Circle.exp ((a + b) / 2) : ℂ) ≠ (Circle.exp v : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hpos := norm_phase_midpoint_sub_pos a b v ha hab hb hv0 hvT hout
  rw [heq, sub_self, norm_zero] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_circle_sub_le_two
statement: lemma norm_circle_sub_le_two (z w : Circle) : ‖(z : ℂ) - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖(z : ℂ) - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖(z : ℂ)‖ + ‖(w : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = 2 := by rw [Circle.norm_coe, Circle.norm_coe]; norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub_le_abs_sub
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub_le_abs_sub (t s : ℝ) :
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ)‖ ≤ |t - s|
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ)‖ =
        2 * |Real.sin ((t - s) / 2)| := norm_phase_sub t s
    _ ≤ 2 * |(t - s) / 2| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Real.abs_sin_le_abs
      (by norm_num)
    _ = |t - s| := by rw [abs_div]; norm_num; ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub_le_sub
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub_le_sub (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ‖(Circle.exp b : ℂ) - (Circle.exp a : ℂ)‖ ≤ b - a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)] using norm_phase_sub_le_abs_sub b a

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedGapDerivativePolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma orderedGapDerivativePolynomial_natDegree_le (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i : Fin n) : (orderedGapDerivativePolynomial angles i).natDegree ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
    (derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le angles.angle
      (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut hn i)))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_homogeneousTrig
statement:
lemma deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_homogeneousTrig (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i : Fin n) :
    deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) =
      homogeneousTrig (n - 1) (orderedGapDerivativePolynomial angles i)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  change deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle
    (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut hn i))) t = _
  rw [deriv_sineInterpolant_globalCayley, orderedGapDerivativePolynomial,
    homogeneousTrig_C_mul]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial
statement:
lemma exists_orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ[X], Q.natDegree ≤ n - 2 ∧
      (∀ t, deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) t =
        Real.sin ((t - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
          homogeneousTrig (n - 2) Q t) ∧
      homogeneousTrig (n - 2) Q (orderedPeak angles hsize i) =
        2 * deriv (deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i)) (orderedPeak angles hsize i)
proof:
:= by
  have hrepr := deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_homogeneousTrig angles i
  have hroot : homogeneousTrig (n - 1) (orderedGapDerivativePolynomial angles i)
      (orderedPeak angles hsize i) = 0 := by
    rw [← hrepr]
    exact (orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero angles hsize i).deriv
  have hb := orderedPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize i
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hfactor, hvalue, _⟩ :=
    exists_homogeneousTrig_sine_quotient_with_root_data (n - 1)
      (orderedGapDerivativePolynomial angles i) (by omega)
      (orderedGapDerivativePolynomial_natDegree_le angles i)
      (orderedPeak angles hsize i) ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2⟩ hroot
  have he : n - 1 - 1 = n - 2 := by omega
  rw [he] at hQ hfactor hvalue
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    rw [hrepr]
    exact hfactor t
  · rw [hrepr]
    exact hvalue

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial_natDegree_le (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    (orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial angles hsize i).natDegree ≤ n - 2
proof:
:=
  (exists_orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial angles hsize i).choose_spec.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_sine_factor
statement:
lemma deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_sine_factor (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i) t =
      Real.sin ((t - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
        orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i t
proof:
:=
  (exists_orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial angles hsize i).choose_spec.2.1 t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeakQuotient_value_at_peak
statement:
lemma orderedPeakQuotient_value_at_peak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) =
      2 * deriv (deriv (orderedGapInterpolant angles i)) (orderedPeak angles hsize i)
proof:
:=
  (exists_orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial angles hsize i).choose_spec.2.2

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_orderedPeakQuotient
statement:
lemma continuous_orderedPeakQuotient (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) : Continuous (orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i)
proof:
:=
  continuous_homogeneousTrig _ _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeakQuotient_mem_space
statement:
lemma orderedPeakQuotient_mem_space (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 2)
proof:
:=
  homogeneousTrig_mem_space _ _ (orderedPeakQuotientPolynomial_natDegree_le angles hsize i)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeakQuotient_diag_neg
statement:
lemma orderedPeakQuotient_diag_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize i) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedPeakQuotient_value_at_peak]
  exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by norm_num) (orderedPeak_second_deriv_neg angles hsize i)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_pos
statement:
