lemma sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    0 < Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
  · exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr (orderedPeak_strictMono angles hsize hij)) (by norm_num)
  · have hi := orderedPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize i
    have hj := orderedPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize j
    linarith [hi.1, hj.2]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_neg
statement:
lemma sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - orderedPeak angles hsize j) / 2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (orderedPeak angles hsize i - orderedPeak angles hsize j) / 2 =
    -((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) by ring, Real.sin_neg]
  exact neg_neg_of_pos (sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_pos angles hsize i j hij)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.orderedPeakQuotient_offdiag_phase_pos
statement:
theorem orderedPeakQuotient_offdiag_phase_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · have h := orderedPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos angles hsize i j hlt
    rw [deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_sine_factor angles hsize i] at h
    have hs := sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_pos angles hsize i j hlt
    have he : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        (Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
          orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) =
        Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
          ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
            orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) := by ring
    rw [he] at h
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hs).mp h
  · have h := orderedPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg angles hsize j i hgt
    rw [deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_sine_factor angles hsize i,
      Nat.add_comm j.val i.val] at h
    have hs := sin_half_orderedPeak_sub_neg angles hsize j i hgt
    have he : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
        (Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
          orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) =
        Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize j - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2) *
          ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
            orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (orderedPeak angles hsize j)) := by ring
    rw [he] at h
    by_contra hpos
    have hp := mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hs.le (le_of_not_gt hpos)
    exact (not_le_of_gt h) hp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.erasedNodeIndex_val
statement:
lemma erasedNodeIndex_val (cut : Fin n) (q : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (((Finset.univ.erase cut : Finset (Fin n)).orderIsoOfFin (by simp) q).val).val =
      if q.val < cut.val then q.val else q.val + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 cut
  | succ m =>
    change ((Finset.univ.erase cut : Finset (Fin (m + 1))).orderEmbOfFin
      (by simp) q).val = _
    have he : (Finset.univ.erase cut : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) = {cut}ᶜ := by
      ext x
      simp
    simp only [he, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_compl_singleton_eq_succAboveOrderEmb]
    change (cut.succAbove q).val = _
    by_cases h : q.val < cut.val
    · rw [if_pos h, Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt cut q h]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg h, Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc cut q (le_of_not_gt h)]
      rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootIndex_val
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootIndex_val (i : Fin n) (q : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q).val =
      if q.val < i.val then q.val else q.val + 1
proof:
:=
  erasedNodeIndex_val i q

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSumRootIndex_val
statement:
lemma crossSumRootIndex_val (j : Fin n) (q : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (crossSumRootIndex j q).val =
      if q.val < j.val then q.val else q.val + 1
proof:
:=
  erasedNodeIndex_val j q

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angle_lt_of_crossDifferenceRootLocation_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossDifferenceRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hmiddle
  · exact (angles.strictMono.monotone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hkl)).trans_lt ht.1
  · rw [ht]
    exact angles.strictMono hkl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cross_roots_strictly_interlace_adjacent
statement:
theorem cross_roots_strictly_interlace_adjacent (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (Droot Troot : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hDloc : ∀ q, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) (Droot q))
    (hTloc : ∀ q, crossSumRootLocation angles i j
      (crossSumRootIndex j q) (Troot q))
    (q : Fin (n - 1)) (hqnext : q.val + 1 < n - 1) :
    Droot q < Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩ ∧
      Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩ < Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩
proof:
:= by
  let s : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩
  let a := crossDifferenceRootIndex i q
  let b := crossDifferenceRootIndex i s
  let r := crossSumRootIndex j s
  have ha := crossDifferenceRootIndex_val i q
  have hb := crossDifferenceRootIndex_val i s
  have hr := crossSumRootIndex_val j s
  change a.val = _ at ha
  change b.val = if q.val + 1 < i.val then q.val + 1 else q.val + 1 + 1 at hb
  change r.val = if q.val + 1 < j.val then q.val + 1 else q.val + 1 + 1 at hr
  have hDa := hDloc q
  have hDb := hDloc s
  have hTr := hTloc s
  change crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j a (Droot q) at hDa
  change crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j b (Droot s) at hDb
  change crossSumRootLocation angles i j r (Troot s) at hTr
  have hijval : i.val < j.val := hij
  change Droot q < Troot s ∧ Troot s < Droot s
  by_cases hqi : q.val < i.val
  · rw [if_pos hqi] at ha
    by_cases hsi : q.val + 1 < i.val
    · rw [if_pos hsi] at hb
      have hsj : q.val + 1 < j.val := by omega
      rw [if_pos hsj] at hr
      have hAmiddle : ¬(i < a ∧ a < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val < a.val ∧ a.val < j.val); omega
      have hBmiddle : ¬(i < b ∧ b < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val < b.val ∧ b.val < j.val); omega
      have hRmiddle : ¬(i ≤ r ∧ r < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < j.val); omega
      have hRzero : r.val ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_neg hAmiddle] at hDa
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_neg hBmiddle] at hDb
      simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_neg hRmiddle, if_neg hRzero] at hTr
      have hpred : gapPredecessor r = a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change r.val - 1 = a.val
        omega
      have hrb : r = b := Fin.ext (by omega)
      rw [hpred] at hTr
      constructor
      · rw [hDa]
        exact hTr.1
      · rw [hDb]
        simpa only [hrb] using hTr.2
    · rw [if_neg hsi] at hb
      have hsj : q.val + 1 < j.val := by omega
      rw [if_pos hsj] at hr
      have hAmiddle : ¬(i < a ∧ a < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val < a.val ∧ a.val < j.val); omega
      have hRmiddle : i ≤ r ∧ r < j := by
        change i.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < j.val; omega
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_neg hAmiddle] at hDa
      simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_pos hRmiddle] at hTr
      constructor
      · rw [hDa, hTr]
        exact angles.strictMono (show a < r from by change a.val < r.val; omega)
      · rw [hTr]
        exact angle_lt_of_crossDifferenceRootLocation_of_lt angles i j r b
          (by change r.val < b.val; omega) hDb
  · rw [if_neg hqi] at ha
    have hsi : ¬q.val + 1 < i.val := by omega
    rw [if_neg hsi] at hb
    by_cases hsj : q.val + 1 < j.val
    · rw [if_pos hsj] at hr
      have hAmiddle : i < a ∧ a < j := by
        change i.val < a.val ∧ a.val < j.val; omega
      have hRmiddle : i ≤ r ∧ r < j := by
        change i.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < j.val; omega
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_pos hAmiddle] at hDa
      simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_pos hRmiddle] at hTr
      have har : a = r := Fin.ext (by omega)
      constructor
      · rw [hTr]
        simpa only [har] using hDa.2
      · rw [hTr]
        exact angle_lt_of_crossDifferenceRootLocation_of_lt angles i j r b
          (by change r.val < b.val; omega) hDb
    · rw [if_neg hsj] at hr
      have hAmiddle : ¬(i < a ∧ a < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val < a.val ∧ a.val < j.val); omega
      have hBmiddle : ¬(i < b ∧ b < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val < b.val ∧ b.val < j.val); omega
      have hRmiddle : ¬(i ≤ r ∧ r < j) := by
        change ¬(i.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < j.val); omega
      have hRzero : r.val ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_neg hAmiddle] at hDa
      simp only [crossDifferenceRootLocation, if_neg hBmiddle] at hDb
      simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_neg hRmiddle, if_neg hRzero] at hTr
      have hpred : gapPredecessor r = a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change r.val - 1 = a.val
        omega
      have hrb : r = b := Fin.ext (by omega)
      rw [hpred] at hTr
      constructor
      · rw [hDa]
        exact hTr.1
      · rw [hDb]
        simpa only [hrb] using hTr.2

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSum_first_root_outside_difference_span
statement:
lemma crossSum_first_root_outside_difference_span (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hm : 0 < n - 1)
    (Droot Troot : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hDloc : ∀ q, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) (Droot q))
    (hTloc : ∀ q, crossSumRootLocation angles i j
      (crossSumRootIndex j q) (Troot q)) :
    (∀ q, Troot ⟨0, hm⟩ < Droot q) ∨ (∀ q, Droot q < Troot ⟨0, hm⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let first : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, hm⟩
  let zero : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  have hjpos : 0 < j.val := by have h := hij; change i.val < j.val at h; omega
  have hindex : crossSumRootIndex j first = zero := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have h := crossSumRootIndex_val j first
    simpa only [first, zero, if_pos hjpos] using h
  have hT := hTloc first
  rw [hindex] at hT
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hmiddle : i ≤ zero ∧ zero < j := by
      change i.val ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < j.val
      omega
    simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_pos hmiddle] at hT
    left
    intro q
    have hDindex : zero < crossDifferenceRootIndex i q := by
      have h := crossDifferenceRootIndex_val i q
      have hnot : ¬q.val < i.val := by omega
      rw [if_neg hnot] at h
      change 0 < (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q).val
      omega
    rw [hT]
    exact angle_lt_of_crossDifferenceRootLocation_of_lt angles i j zero
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) hDindex (hDloc q)
  · have hmiddle : ¬(i ≤ zero ∧ zero < j) := by
      change ¬(i.val ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < j.val)
      omega
    simp only [crossSumRootLocation, if_neg hmiddle, zero] at hT
    right
    intro q
    have hupper := crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_angle angles i j
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) (hDloc q)
    have hlast : crossDifferenceRootIndex i q ≤ lastNodeIndex hn :=
      Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q).isLt
    exact (hupper.trans (angles.strictMono.monotone hlast)).trans_lt hT.1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interlacing_root_index_of_mem_adjacent_closed
statement:
lemma interlacing_root_index_of_mem_adjacent_closed {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (Droot Troot : Fin m → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono Droot)
    (hfirst : (∀ q, Troot ⟨0, hm⟩ < Droot q) ∨
      (∀ q, Droot q < Troot ⟨0, hm⟩))
    (hinter : ∀ q (hq : q.val + 1 < m), Droot q < Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩ ∧
      Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩ < Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩)
    (q : Fin m) (hq : q.val + 1 < m) (l : Fin m)
    (hl : Troot l ∈ Set.Icc (Droot q) (Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩)) :
    l = ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlzero : l.val = 0
  · have heq : l = ⟨0, hm⟩ := Fin.ext hlzero
    rw [heq] at hl
    rcases hfirst with hfirst | hfirst
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hl.1) (hfirst q))
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hl.2) (hfirst ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩))
  · let p : Fin m := ⟨l.val - 1, by omega⟩
    have hpnext : p.val + 1 < m := by dsimp [p]; omega
    have hpl : (⟨p.val + 1, hpnext⟩ : Fin m) = l := by
      apply Fin.ext
      dsimp [p]
      omega
    have hinterl := hinter p hpnext
    rw [hpl] at hinterl
    by_cases hlq : l ≤ q
    · have hupper := hinterl.2.trans_le (hmono.monotone hlq)
      exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hl.1) hupper)
    · by_contra hne
      have hqp : (⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩ : Fin m) ≤ p := by
        have hneval : l.val ≠ q.val + 1 := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
        change q.val + 1 ≤ l.val - 1
        change ¬l.val ≤ q.val at hlq
        omega
      have hlower := (hmono.monotone hqp).trans_lt hinterl.1
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hl.2) hlower

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.difference_no_zero_on_adjacent_arc
statement:
lemma difference_no_zero_on_adjacent_arc (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (Droot : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono Droot)
    (hbound : ∀ q, Droot q ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hexhaust : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi),
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t = 0 ↔
        ∃ q, Droot q = t)
    (q : Fin (n - 1)) (hq : q.val + 1 < n - 1) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (Droot q) (Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩),
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht hz
  have htbound : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨(hbound q).1.trans ht.1.le, ht.2.trans (hbound ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩).2⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (hexhaust t htbound).mp hz
  by_cases hlq : l ≤ q
  · have hupper := hmono.monotone hlq
    rw [hl] at hupper
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hupper) ht.1
  · have hql : (⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩ : Fin (n - 1)) ≤ l := by
      change q.val + 1 ≤ l.val
      change ¬l.val ≤ q.val at hlq
      omega
    have hlower := hmono.monotone hql
    rw [hl] at hlower
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hlower) ht.2

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossSum_no_other_zero_on_adjacent_arc
statement:
lemma crossSum_no_other_zero_on_adjacent_arc (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hm : 0 < n - 1)
    (Droot Troot : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono Droot)
    (hDloc : ∀ q, crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j
      (crossDifferenceRootIndex i q) (Droot q))
    (hTloc : ∀ q, crossSumRootLocation angles i j
      (crossSumRootIndex j q) (Troot q))
    (hDbound : ∀ q, Droot q ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hTexhaust : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi),
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t = 0 ↔
        ∃ q, Troot q = t)
    (q : Fin (n - 1)) (hq : q.val + 1 < n - 1) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (Droot q) (Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩),
      t ≠ Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩ →
        sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht hne hz
  have htbound : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨(hDbound q).1.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt (hDbound ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩).2⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (hTexhaust t htbound).mp hz
  have hlmem : Troot l ∈ Set.Icc (Droot q) (Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hq⟩) := by
    rwa [hl]
  have hleq := interlacing_root_index_of_mem_adjacent_closed hm Droot Troot hmono
    (crossSum_first_root_outside_difference_span angles i j hij hm Droot Troot hDloc hTloc)
    (cross_roots_strictly_interlace_adjacent angles i j hij Droot Troot hDloc hTloc)
    q hq l hlmem
  exact hne (hl.symm.trans (congrArg Troot hleq))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_crossDifference_positive_root_residues
statement:
theorem exists_crossDifference_positive_root_residues (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, Function.Injective root ∧
      (∀ q, root q ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ q, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (root q) = 0) ∧
      (∀ q, 0 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (root q) *
        deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) (root q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Droot, hmono, hDloc, hDbound, hDroot, hDsimple, hDexhaust⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_saturated_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  obtain ⟨Troot, _hTinj, hTloc, _hTbound, hTroot, hTsimple, hTexhaust⟩ :=
    exists_crossSum_saturated_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  have hm : 0 < n - 1 := by
    have h := hij
    change i.val < j.val at h
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega
  obtain ⟨anchor, _hanchoreq, hanchor⟩ := crossResidueAnchor_in_root_list angles i j hij
    Droot hmono.injective hDbound hDroot
  refine ⟨Droot, hmono.injective, hDbound, hDroot, ?_⟩
  apply finite_chain_positive_of_adjacent_iff
    (fun q => sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (Droot q) *
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) (Droot q))
    ?_ anchor hanchor
  intro q l hsucc
  have hqnext : q.val + 1 < n - 1 := by rw [hsucc]; exact l.isLt
  have hleq : l = ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩ := Fin.ext hsucc.symm
  rw [hleq]
  obtain ⟨har, hrb⟩ := cross_roots_strictly_interlace_adjacent angles i j hij
    Droot Troot hDloc hTloc q hqnext
  have hTnoother := crossSum_no_other_zero_on_adjacent_arc angles i j hij hm
    Droot Troot hmono hDloc hTloc hDbound hTexhaust q hqnext
  apply positive_residue_iff_across_interlacing
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)) har hrb
    (continuous_sineInterpolant _ _) (continuous_sineInterpolant _ _)
    (hDroot q) (hDroot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)
    ((differentiable_sineInterpolant _ _ (Droot q)).hasDerivAt)
    ((differentiable_sineInterpolant _ _ (Droot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)).hasDerivAt)
    (hDsimple q) (hDsimple ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)
    (difference_no_zero_on_adjacent_arc angles i j Droot hmono hDbound hDexhaust q hqnext)
    (hTroot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)
    ((differentiable_sineInterpolant _ _ (Troot ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)).hasDerivAt)
    (hTsimple ⟨q.val + 1, hqnext⟩)
  · intro t ht
    exact hTnoother t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le.trans hrb.le⟩ (ne_of_lt ht.2)
  · intro t ht
    exact hTnoother t ⟨har.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩ (ne_of_gt ht.1)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGap_sineWronskian_neg
statement:
theorem crossGap_sineWronskian_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
      (crossSumCoefficient i j) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : 2 ≤ n := by
    have h := hij
    change i.val < j.val at h
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega
  obtain ⟨root, hinj, hbound, hroot, hresidue⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_positive_root_residues angles i j hij
  exact sineWronskian_neg_of_cyclic_root_residues hsize angles.angle
    (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (crossSumCoefficient i j)
    root hinj hbound hroot hresidue t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg
statement:
theorem crossGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (t : ℝ) :
    crossGapPhase i j * sineWronskian angles.angle (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t < 0
proof:
:=
  (crossWronskian_neg_iff angles.angle i j t).mp
    (crossGap_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij t)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.coordinates_injective
statement:
lemma NodeFamily.coordinates_injective (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    Function.Injective nodes.coordinates
proof:
:=
  Circle.coe_injective.comp nodes.injective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.norm_coordinates
statement:
@[simp] lemma NodeFamily.norm_coordinates (nodes : NodeFamily n) (j : Fin n) :
    ‖nodes.coordinates j‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Circle.norm_coe _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_self
statement:
lemma cardinal_self (z : Fin n → ℂ) (hz : Function.Injective z) (j : Fin n) :
    cardinal z j (z j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro k hk
  exact div_self (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1 (hz h).symm))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_other
statement:
lemma cardinal_other (z : Fin n → ℂ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    cardinal z j (z i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩)
  simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_at_node
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_at_node (z : Fin n → ℂ) (hz : Function.Injective z) (i : Fin n) :
    lebesgueFunction z (z i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [cardinal_self z hz i, norm_one]
  · intro j hj hji
    rw [cardinal_other z (Ne.symm hji), norm_zero]
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_nonneg
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_nonneg (z : Fin n → ℂ) (w : ℂ) :
    0 ≤ lebesgueFunction z w
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_cardinal
statement:
lemma continuous_cardinal (z : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    Continuous (cardinal z j)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_finsetProd
  intro k hk
  exact (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma continuous_lebesgueFunction (z : Fin n → ℂ) :
    Continuous (lebesgueFunction z)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro j hj
  exact (continuous_cardinal z j).norm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_circle_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma continuous_circle_lebesgueFunction (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    Continuous (fun w : Circle => lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ))
proof:
:=
  (continuous_lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_circle_maximum
statement:
lemma exists_circle_maximum (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    ∃ w : Circle, ∀ v : Circle,
      lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (v : ℂ) ≤
        lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := isCompact_univ.exists_isMaxOn
    (show (Set.univ : Set Circle).Nonempty from ⟨1, Set.mem_univ 1⟩)
    (continuous_circle_lebesgueFunction nodes).continuousOn
  exact ⟨w, fun v => hw (Set.mem_univ v)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.bddAbove_circle_lebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma bddAbove_circle_lebesgueFunction (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (fun w : Circle => lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_circle_maximum nodes
  refine ⟨lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ), ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨v, rfl⟩
  exact hw v

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.le_amplification
statement:
lemma le_amplification (nodes : NodeFamily n) (w : Circle) :
    lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ) ≤ amplification nodes
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_circle_lebesgueFunction nodes) ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_le_iff
statement:
lemma amplification_le_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n) (b : ℝ) :
    amplification nodes ≤ b ↔
      ∀ w : Circle, lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ) ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h w
    exact (le_amplification nodes w).trans h
  · intro h
    apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
    rintro y ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact h w

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_attained
statement:
lemma amplification_attained (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    ∃ w : Circle, amplification nodes = lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_circle_maximum nodes
  exact ⟨w, le_antisymm ((amplification_le_iff nodes _).mpr hw)
    (le_amplification nodes w)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_le_amplification
statement:
lemma one_le_amplification (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    1 ≤ amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  have h := le_amplification nodes (nodes.point i)
  change lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (nodes.coordinates i) ≤ amplification nodes at h
  rw [lebesgueFunction_at_node nodes.coordinates nodes.coordinates_injective i] at h
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_angle_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma regular_angle_mem_Ico (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    2 * Real.pi * ((i.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hiR : (i.val : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt
  have hpi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg hpi.le (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hnR.le)
  · have hdiv : (i.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) < 1 := (div_lt_one hnR).mpr hiR
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hdiv hpi

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularPoint_injective
statement:
lemma regularPoint_injective (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Injective (regularPoint n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hangle := Circle.exp_injOn_Ico
    (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (by simp)
    (regular_angle_mem_Ico n hn i) (regular_angle_mem_Ico n hn j) hij
  have hpi : (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hquot : (i.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hpi hangle
  have hval : (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) := (div_left_inj' hnR).mp hquot
  apply Fin.ext
  exact_mod_cast hval

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularNodes_isRegularRotation
statement:
lemma regularNodes_isRegularRotation (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsRegularRotation (regularNodes n hn)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨1, Equiv.refl _, fun i => (one_mul _).symm⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularPoint_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma regularPoint_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    regularPoint n ⟨0, hn⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [regularPoint]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_ne_zero
statement:
lemma sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle k) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpeak := gapPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize (physicalGapCut hn i)
  by_cases hcut : (physicalGapCut hn i).val = 0
  · have hwrap : orderedPeak angles hsize i ∈ wrapGap angles := by
      exact (gapInterval_of_zero angles _ hcut) ▸ hpeak
    exact (sin_numerator_pos_on_wrapGap angles hwrap k).ne'
  · have hc : 0 < (physicalGapCut hn i).val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcut
    have hord : orderedPeak angles hsize i ∈ ordinaryGap angles (physicalGapCut hn i) hc := by
      exact (gapInterval_of_pos angles _ hc) ▸ hpeak
    exact sin_numerator_ne_zero_on_gap angles _ hc hord k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityRowFactor_ne_zero
statement:
lemma peakSensitivityRowFactor_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun k _ => sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_ne_zero angles hsize i k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityColumnFactor_ne_zero
statement:
lemma peakSensitivityColumnFactor_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn) (j : Fin d) :
    peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_ne_zero
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact sine_denominator_ne_zero angles.angle angles.phaseNodes_injective
    (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityMatrix_apply_factorization
statement:
lemma peakSensitivityMatrix_apply_factorization (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i : Fin (d + 1)) (j : Fin d) :
    peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize i j = peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i *
      peakQuotientNodeMatrix angles hsize i j * peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold peakSensitivityMatrix peakQuotientNodeMatrix peakSensitivityColumnFactor
  rw [deriv_orderedGapInterpolant_sine_factor angles hsize i]
  rw [show (angles.angle j.succ - orderedPeak angles hsize i) / 2 =
    -((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle j.succ) / 2) by ring, Real.sin_neg]
  unfold sineCardinal
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  unfold peakSensitivityRowFactor
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d + 1)))
    (fun k => Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle k) / 2))
    (Finset.mem_univ j.succ)]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityMatrix_factorization
statement:
lemma peakSensitivityMatrix_factorization (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize = Matrix.diagonal (peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize) *
      peakQuotientNodeMatrix angles hsize * Matrix.diagonal (peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  exact peakSensitivityMatrix_apply_factorization angles hsize i j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakQuotientNodeMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem peakQuotientNodeMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ((peakQuotientNodeMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact actualPeakQuotient_deleted_evaluation_det_ne_zero angles hsize omitted
    (fun j => angles.angle j.succ)
    (angles.strictMono.injective.comp (Fin.succ_injective d))
    (fun j => ⟨angles.nonneg j.succ, angles.lt_two_pi j.succ⟩)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_factorization
statement:
theorem peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_factorization (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ((peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).det =
      (∏ i : Fin d, peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize (omitted.succAbove i)) *
        ((peakQuotientNodeMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).det *
          ∏ j : Fin d, peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles j
proof:
:= by
  let R : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize (omitted.succAbove i))
  let Q : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (peakQuotientNodeMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id
  let C : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal (peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles)
  have hmatrix : (peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id =
      R * Q * C := by
    ext i j
    simp only [R, Q, C, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
      id_eq]
    exact peakSensitivityMatrix_apply_factorization angles hsize _ _
  rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul]
  simp only [R, Q, C, Matrix.det_diagonal]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ((peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [peakSensitivityMatrix_deleted_det_factorization]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact mul_ne_zero
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => peakSensitivityRowFactor_ne_zero angles hsize _))
      (peakQuotientNodeMatrix_deleted_det_ne_zero angles hsize omitted)
  · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => peakSensitivityColumnFactor_ne_zero angles j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isHomeomorph_heightDifferenceMap
statement:
theorem isHomeomorph_heightDifferenceMap (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    IsHomeomorph (heightDifferenceMap hsize)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreconnectedSpace (angularParameterDomain d) :=
    Subtype.preconnectedSpace (isPreconnected_angularParameterDomain d)
  let : Nonempty (angularParameterDomain d) :=
    ⟨⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩⟩
  exact euclideanTarget_isHomeomorph_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper
    (isLocalHomeomorph_heightDifferenceMap hsize) (isProperMap_heightDifferenceMap hsize)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceMap_injective
statement:
theorem heightDifferenceMap_injective (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    Function.Injective (heightDifferenceMap hsize)
proof:
:=
  (isHomeomorph_heightDifferenceMap hsize).injective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceMap_surjective
statement:
theorem heightDifferenceMap_surjective (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    Function.Surjective (heightDifferenceMap hsize)
proof:
:=
  (isHomeomorph_heightDifferenceMap hsize).surjective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :
    heightDifferenceMap hsize u = 0 ↔
      ∀ i, parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val = parameterOrderedHeight hsize 0 u.val
proof:
:= by
  change parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u.val = 0 ↔ _
  rw [← finiteHeightDifferences_parameterOrderedHeightMap]
  exact finiteHeightDifferences_eq_zero_iff (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize u.val)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.existsUnique_heightDifferenceMap_eq
statement:
theorem existsUnique_heightDifferenceMap_eq (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∃! u : angularParameterDomain d, heightDifferenceMap hsize u = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := heightDifferenceMap_surjective hsize y
  exact ⟨u, hu, fun v hv => heightDifferenceMap_injective hsize (hv.trans hu.symm)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.existsUnique_equal_parameterOrderedHeights
statement:
theorem existsUnique_equal_parameterOrderedHeights (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    ∃! u : angularParameterDomain d,
      ∀ i, parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val = parameterOrderedHeight hsize 0 u.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huniq⟩ := existsUnique_heightDifferenceMap_eq hsize 0
  exact ⟨u, (heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff hsize u).mp hu,
    fun v hv => huniq v ((heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff hsize v).mpr hv)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterGapWidth_succ
statement:
lemma parameterGapWidth_succ (u : Fin d → ℝ) (i : Fin d) :
    parameterGapWidth i.succ u = angularParameterAngles u i.succ -
      angularParameterAngles u i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : gapLeftNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d) i.succ = i.castSucc := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [gapLeftNodeIndex, gapPredecessor]
  simp only [parameterGapWidth, Fin.val_succ, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, hpred]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterGapWidth_zero
statement:
lemma parameterGapWidth_zero (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    parameterGapWidth (0 : Fin (d + 1)) u =
      2 * Real.pi - angularParameterAngles u (lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d))
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameterGapWidth, gapLeftNodeIndex]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.mem_shrunkenAngularSimplex
statement:
lemma mem_shrunkenAngularSimplex (u : Fin d → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) :
    u ∈ shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε ↔ ∀ cut, ε ≤ parameterGapWidth cut u
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isClosed_shrunkenAngularSimplex
statement:
lemma isClosed_shrunkenAngularSimplex (d : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) :
    IsClosed (shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε =
      ⋂ cut : Fin (d + 1), {u : Fin d → ℝ | ε ≤ parameterGapWidth cut u} := by
    ext u
    simp only [shrunkenAngularSimplex, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
  rw [heq]
  exact isClosed_iInter (fun cut => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_parameterGapWidth cut))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shrunkenAngularSimplex_strictMono
statement:
lemma shrunkenAngularSimplex_strictMono {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {u : Fin d → ℝ} (hu : u ∈ shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε) :
    StrictMono (angularParameterAngles u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
  intro i
  have hwidth := hu i.succ
  rw [parameterGapWidth_succ] at hwidth
  exact sub_pos.mp (hε.trans_le hwidth)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shrunkenAngularSimplex_last_le
proof:
:= by
  have hlast := hu 0
  rw [parameterGapWidth_zero] at hlast
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_domain
statement:
lemma shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_domain {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε ⊆ angularParameterDomain d
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hmono := shrunkenAngularSimplex_strictMono hε hu
  refine ⟨hmono, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hlast := shrunkenAngularSimplex_last_le hu
  have hi : angularParameterAngles u i.succ ≤
      angularParameterAngles u (lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d)) :=
    hmono.monotone (show i.succ ≤ lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d) from Fin.le_last _)
  change u i < 2 * Real.pi
  change u i ≤ angularParameterAngles u (lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d)) at hi
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shrunkenAngularSimplex_coordinate_bounds
statement:
lemma shrunkenAngularSimplex_coordinate_bounds {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {u : Fin d → ℝ} (hu : u ∈ shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε) (i : Fin d) :
    ε ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ 2 * Real.pi - ε
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := shrunkenAngularSimplex_strictMono hε hu
  have hwidth := hu i.succ
  rw [parameterGapWidth_succ, angularParameterAngles_succ] at hwidth
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ angularParameterAngles u i.castSucc := by
    have h := hmono.monotone (show (0 : Fin (d + 1)) ≤ i.castSucc from Fin.zero_le _)
    simpa only [angularParameterAngles_zero] using h
  have hi : angularParameterAngles u i.succ ≤
      angularParameterAngles u (lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d)) :=
    hmono.monotone (show i.succ ≤ lastNodeIndex (Nat.succ_pos d) from Fin.le_last _)
  exact ⟨by linarith, hi.trans (shrunkenAngularSimplex_last_le hu)⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_box
statement:
lemma shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_box {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin d => ε) (fun _ => 2 * Real.pi - ε)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  exact ⟨fun i => (shrunkenAngularSimplex_coordinate_bounds hε hu i).1,
    fun i => (shrunkenAngularSimplex_coordinate_bounds hε hu i).2⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex
statement:
theorem isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    IsCompact (shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε)
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact
    (Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin d => ε) (fun _ => 2 * Real.pi - ε))).of_isClosed_subset
    (isClosed_shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε) (shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_box hε)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isBounded_shrunkenAngularSimplex
statement:
lemma isBounded_shrunkenAngularSimplex {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε)
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex hε).isBounded

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.mem_shrunkenAngularSimplex_iff_minimumGapWidth
statement:
lemma mem_shrunkenAngularSimplex_iff_minimumGapWidth (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (ε : ℝ) :
    u ∈ shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε ↔ ε ≤ minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨cut, heq⟩ := exists_gapWidth_eq_minimum (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu)
    rw [← heq, ← parameterGapWidth_of_mem_domain u hu]
    exact h cut
  · intro h cut
    rw [parameterGapWidth_of_mem_domain u hu]
    exact h.trans (minimumGapWidth_le (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) cut)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_lt_at_zero_of_hasDerivAt_neg
proof:
:= by
  have hslope := hf.tendsto_slope_zero_right.eventually_lt_const hf'
  filter_upwards [hslope, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht hpos
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hpos
  simp only [zero_add, smul_eq_mul] at ht
  have hdiff : f t - f 0 < 0 := neg_of_mul_neg_right ht (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hpos))
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_finite_height_descent
statement:
theorem exists_finite_height_descent
    (H : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (L : (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (d + 1) → ℝ))
    (s : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hs : IsOpen s) (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ s)
    (hH : HasFDerivAt H L u) (M : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ i, H u i ≤ M)
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (homitted : H u omitted < M)
    (v : Fin d → ℝ) (hdir : ∀ i, i ≠ omitted → L v i < 0) :
    ∃ w ∈ s, ∀ i, H w i < M
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ) := fun t => u + t • v
  have hp : HasDerivAt p v 0 := by
    simpa [p] using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add u
  have hp0 : p 0 = u := by simp [p]
  have hrows : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1), ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), H (p t) i < M := by
    intro i
    have hHi : HasFDerivAt (fun w => H w i)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp L) u :=
      by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] using
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp u hH)
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun t => H (p t) i) (L v i) 0 := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] using
        hHi.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hp hp0.symm
    by_cases hi : i = omitted
    · subst i
      have hevent := hcomp.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa [hp0] using homitted)
      exact hevent.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · have hevent := eventually_lt_at_zero_of_hasDerivAt_neg hcomp (hdir i hi)
      exact hevent.mono fun t ht => ht.trans_le (by simpa [hp0] using hbound i)
  have hsEvent₀ : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), p t ∈ s :=
    hp.continuousAt (hs.mem_nhds (by simpa [hp0] using hu))
  have hsEvent : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), p t ∈ s :=
    hsEvent₀.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hrows_t⟩ := (hsEvent.and (Filter.eventually_all.mpr hrows)).exists
  exact ⟨p t, ht, hrows_t⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deletedHeightDerivative_apply
statement:
lemma deletedHeightDerivative_apply (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (u v : Fin d → ℝ)
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) (i : Fin d) :
    deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted v i =
      fderiv ℝ (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize) u v (omitted.succAbove i)
proof: := rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deletedHeightJacobian_mulVec
statement:
lemma deletedHeightJacobian_mulVec (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (u v : Fin d → ℝ)
    (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ((parameterHeightJacobian hsize u).submatrix omitted.succAbove id).mulVec v =
      deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted v
proof:
:= by
  have hm : LinearMap.toMatrix' (deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted).toLinearMap =
      (parameterHeightJacobian hsize u).submatrix omitted.succAbove id := by
    ext i j
    rfl
  rw [← hm]
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec (deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted).toLinearMap v

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deletedHeightDerivative_bijective
statement:
theorem deletedHeightDerivative_bijective (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    Function.Bijective (deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (deletedHeightDerivative hsize u omitted) := by
    intro v w hvw
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero
      (parameterHeightJacobian_deleted_det_ne_zero u hu hsize omitted)
    simpa only [deletedHeightJacobian_mulVec] using hvw
  exact ⟨hinj, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_decreasing_actual_height_direction
statement:
theorem exists_decreasing_actual_height_direction (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (omitted : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ∃ v : Fin d → ℝ, ∀ i, i ≠ omitted →
      fderiv ℝ (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize) u v i = -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (deletedHeightDerivative_bijective hsize u hu omitted).2 (fun _ => -1)
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
  exact congrFun hv j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterOrderedHeight_eq_amplification_of_minimum
statement:
theorem parameterOrderedHeight_eq_amplification_of_minimum (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d)
    (hmin : ∀ v : angularParameterDomain d,
      angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize v)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val = angularParameterAmplification hsize u
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (parameterOrderedHeight_le_angularParameterAmplification hsize u i)
  by_contra hnot
  have hi : parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val < angularParameterAmplification hsize u :=
    lt_of_not_ge hnot
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_decreasing_actual_height_direction hsize u.val u.property i
  have hH : HasFDerivAt (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize)
      (fderiv ℝ (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize) u.val) u.val := by
    exact (hasFDerivAt_parameterOrderedHeightMap_of_mem_domain u.val u.property hsize).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hrows⟩ := exists_finite_height_descent
    (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize) (fderiv ℝ (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize) u.val)
    (angularParameterDomain d) (isOpen_angularParameterDomain d) u.val u.property hH
    (angularParameterAmplification hsize u)
    (fun j => parameterOrderedHeight_le_angularParameterAmplification hsize u j) i hi v
    (fun j hj => by rw [hv j hj]; norm_num)
  have hless : angularParameterAmplification hsize ⟨w, hw⟩ < angularParameterAmplification hsize u := by
    rw [angularParameterAmplification_eq_orderedHeightMaximum]
    exact (Finset.sup'_lt_iff _).mpr (fun j _ => hrows j)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmin ⟨w, hw⟩)) hless

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.equal_parameterOrderedHeights_of_minimum
statement:
theorem equal_parameterOrderedHeights_of_minimum (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d)
    (hmin : ∀ v : angularParameterDomain d,
      angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize v) :
    ∀ i, parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val = parameterOrderedHeight hsize 0 u.val
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (parameterOrderedHeight_eq_amplification_of_minimum hsize u hmin i).trans
    (parameterOrderedHeight_eq_amplification_of_minimum hsize u hmin 0).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.polynomial_distinct_root_count
statement:
lemma polynomial_distinct_root_count {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (root : ι → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hroot : ∀ i, P.eval (root i) = 0) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ P.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hP (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero P hinj hroot
    (not_le.mp h))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayley_chart_distinct_root_count
statement:
lemma cayley_chart_distinct_root_count (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ p)
    (hchart : ∀ t, Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0 →
      Real.cos (t / 2) ^ p * P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = f t)
    (hpoleValue : P.coeff p = f Real.pi) (root : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, f (root i) = 0) : m ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heval (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0)
      (hz : f t = 0) : P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = 0 := by
    have h := (hchart t ht).trans hz
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
  by_cases hpole : ∃ j, root j = Real.pi
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hpole
    let rest := (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin m))
    have hcos (i : rest) : Real.cos (root i.val / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      apply (cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (root i.val) (hbound i.val)).mpr
      intro h
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp i.property).1 (hinj (h.trans hj.symm))
    have htan : Function.Injective (fun i : rest => Real.tan (root i.val / 2)) := by
      intro i k h
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hinj
      exact tan_half_injOn_Ico ⟨hbound i.val, hcos i⟩ ⟨hbound k.val, hcos k⟩ h
    have hc := polynomial_distinct_root_count P hP
      (fun i : rest => Real.tan (root i.val / 2)) htan
      (fun i => heval _ (hcos i) (hroot i.val))
    have hcard : Fintype.card rest = m - 1 := by simp [rest]
    rw [hcard] at hc
    have hz : f Real.pi = 0 := by rw [← hj]; exact hroot j
    have hd : P.natDegree < p := by
      by_contra hlt
      have heq : P.natDegree = p := le_antisymm hdegree (not_lt.mp hlt)
      have hcoeff : P.coeff P.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP
      rw [heq, hpoleValue, hz] at hcoeff
      exact hcoeff rfl
    have hm : 0 < m := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt j.isLt
    omega
  · have hcos (i : Fin m) : Real.cos (root i / 2) ≠ 0 :=
      (cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (root i) (hbound i)).mpr (fun h => hpole ⟨i, h⟩)
    have htan : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m => Real.tan (root i / 2)) := by
      intro i j h
      exact hinj (tan_half_injOn_Ico ⟨hbound i, hcos i⟩ ⟨hbound j, hcos j⟩ h)
    have hc := polynomial_distinct_root_count P hP
      (fun i : Fin m => Real.tan (root i / 2)) htan
      (fun i => heval _ (hcos i) (hroot i))
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hc.trans hdegree

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hci : c i ≠ 0) :
    interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpole : θ i = Real.pi
  · apply interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_at_pi θ c
    have h := sineInterpolant_at_node θ hθ c i
    rw [hpole] at h
    rwa [h]
  · exact interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node_on_chart θ hθ c i
      ((cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (θ i) (hbound i)).mpr hpole) hci

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0) (root : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ i, root i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ i, sineInterpolant θ c (root i) = 0) : m ≤ n - 1
proof:
:=
  cayley_chart_distinct_root_count (n - 1) (sineInterpolant θ c)
    (interpolantPolynomial θ c) hP (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c)
    (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ c) (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top θ c)
    root hinj hbound hroot

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count_of_node
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count_of_node (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (hθbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hci : c i ≠ 0) (root : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ k, sineInterpolant θ c (root k) = 0) : m ≤ n - 1
proof:
:=
  sineInterpolant_distinct_root_count θ c
    (interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node θ hθ hθbound c i hci) root hinj hbound hroot

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinalPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma cardinalPolynomial_natDegree_le (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (cardinalPolynomial θ j).natDegree ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase j).card = n - 1 := by simp
  unfold cardinalPolynomial
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans
    ((sineProductPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _).trans_eq hcard)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_pow_mul_cardinalPolynomial_eval_tan
statement:
lemma cos_pow_mul_cardinalPolynomial_eval_tan (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1) * (cardinalPolynomial θ j).eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) =
      sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase j).card = n - 1 := by simp
  have hprod := cos_pow_mul_sineProductPolynomial_eval_tan
    (Finset.univ.erase j) (fun k => θ k / 2) (t / 2) ht
  rw [hcard] at hprod
  unfold cardinalPolynomial
  rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  calc
    Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
        ((∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))⁻¹ *
          (sineProductPolynomial (Finset.univ.erase j) (fun k => θ k / 2)).eval
            (Real.tan (t / 2))) =
      (Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
        (sineProductPolynomial (Finset.univ.erase j) (fun k => θ k / 2)).eval
          (Real.tan (t / 2))) *
        (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, Real.sin (t / 2 - θ k / 2)) *
        (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))⁻¹ := by rw [hprod]
    _ = sineCardinal θ j t := by
      unfold sineCardinal
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, div_eq_mul_inv]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      congr 1
      ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (interpolantPolynomial θ c).natDegree ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro j hj
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (cardinalPolynomial_natDegree_le θ j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan
statement:
lemma cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
        (interpolantPolynomial θ c).eval (Real.tan (t / 2)) = sineInterpolant θ c t
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolantPolynomial sineInterpolant
  rw [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_left_comm,
    cos_pow_mul_cardinalPolynomial_eval_tan θ j t ht]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_at_node
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_at_node (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : sineInterpolant θ c (θ i) = c i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [sineCardinal_self θ hθ, mul_one]
  · intro j hj hji
    rw [sineCardinal_other θ (Ne.symm hji), mul_zero]
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_on_chart
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_on_chart (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (sineInterpolant θ c)
      ((Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
        (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)).eval (Real.tan (t / 2))) / 2)
      t
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / 2) (1 / 2) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id t).div_const 2
  have hweighted :=
    (hasDerivAt_cosineWeighted (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) (t / 2) ht).comp t hhalf
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ u in nhds t, Real.cos (u / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_id.div_const 2)).continuousAt.eventually_ne ht
  have heq : sineInterpolant θ c =ᶠ[nhds t]
      (fun u : ℝ => cosineWeighted (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c) (u / 2)) := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with u hu
    exact (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ c u hu).symm
  have hr := hweighted.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one_div] using hr

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma derivativePolynomial_natDegree_le (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (cayleyOperator (n - 1) (interpolantPolynomial θ c)).natDegree ≤ n - 1
proof:
:=
  cayleyOperator_natDegree_le _ _ (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineFactor_coeff_one
statement: lemma sineFactor_coeff_one (a : ℝ) : (sineFactor a).coeff 1 = Real.cos a
proof:
:= by
  simp [sineFactor]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineProductPolynomial_coeff_card
statement:
lemma sineProductPolynomial_coeff_card {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (sineProductPolynomial s a).coeff s.card = ∏ i ∈ s, Real.cos (a i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sineProductPolynomial, Nat.mul_one, sineFactor_coeff_one] using
    (Polynomial.coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le s (fun i => sineFactor (a i)) 1
      (fun i _ => sineFactor_natDegree_le (a i)))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinalPolynomial_coeff_top
statement:
lemma cardinalPolynomial_coeff_top (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (cardinalPolynomial θ j).coeff (n - 1) = sineCardinal θ j Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase j).card = n - 1 := by simp
  have hcos : (sineProductPolynomial (Finset.univ.erase j) (fun k => θ k / 2)).coeff
      (n - 1) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, Real.cos (θ k / 2) := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact sineProductPolynomial_coeff_card _ _
  unfold cardinalPolynomial sineCardinal
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, hcos, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  have hsin (k : Fin n) : Real.sin ((Real.pi - θ k) / 2) = Real.cos (θ k / 2) := by
    rw [show (Real.pi - θ k) / 2 = Real.pi / 2 - θ k / 2 from by ring,
      Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub]
  simp_rw [hsin]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (interpolantPolynomial θ c).coeff (n - 1) = sineInterpolant θ c Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  simp only [interpolantPolynomial, sineInterpolant, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, cardinalPolynomial_coeff_top]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_degree_drop_at_pi
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_degree_drop_at_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hpole : sineInterpolant θ c Real.pi = 0) :
    (interpolantPolynomial θ c).natDegree ≤ n - 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  by_cases hkp : k = n - 1
  · rw [hkp, interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top, hpole]
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp
      (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) k (by omega)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_on_chart
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_on_chart (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) (hvalue : sineInterpolant θ c t ≠ 0) :
    interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan θ c t ht
  rw [hzero, Polynomial.eval_zero, mul_zero] at h
  exact hvalue h.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_at_pi
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_at_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hvalue : sineInterpolant θ c Real.pi ≠ 0) : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top θ c
  rw [hzero, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at h
  exact hvalue h.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node_on_chart
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_node_on_chart (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (ht : Real.cos (θ i / 2) ≠ 0) (hci : c i ≠ 0) : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply interpolantPolynomial_ne_zero_of_value_on_chart θ c (θ i) ht
  rwa [sineInterpolant_at_node θ hθ]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_lt_of_zero_at_pi
statement:
lemma interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_lt_of_zero_at_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : interpolantPolynomial θ c ≠ 0) (hpole : sineInterpolant θ c Real.pi = 0) :
    (interpolantPolynomial θ c).natDegree < n - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  have heq : (interpolantPolynomial θ c).natDegree = n - 1 :=
    le_antisymm (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c) (not_lt.mp hlt)
  have hcoeff : (interpolantPolynomial θ c).coeff
      (interpolantPolynomial θ c).natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP
  rw [heq, interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top, hpole] at hcoeff
  exact hcoeff rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogeneousTrig_zero (P : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    homogeneousTrig 0 P t = P.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousTrig]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    homogeneousTrig p P t = Real.cos (t / 2) ^ p * P.eval (Real.tan (t / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (show P.natDegree < p + 1 from by omega)]
  unfold homogeneousTrig
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkp : k ≤ p := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hpow : Real.cos (t / 2) ^ p =
      Real.cos (t / 2) ^ k * Real.cos (t / 2) ^ (p - k) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hkp]
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, div_pow, hpow]
  field_simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_pi
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrig_pi (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) :
    homogeneousTrig p P Real.pi = P.coeff p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogeneousTrig, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two,
    one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hkp
    have hklt : k < p := by
      have hkle := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      omega
    have hpos : 0 < p - k := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hklt
    simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hpos]
  · intro hp
    exact (hp (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self p))).elim

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_homogeneousTrig
statement:
lemma continuous_homogeneousTrig (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) :
    Continuous (homogeneousTrig p P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold homogeneousTrig
  fun_prop

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.dense_cos_half_ne_zero
statement: lemma dense_cos_half_ne_zero : Dense {t : ℝ | Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro t ε hε
  by_cases ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0
  · refine ⟨t, ?_, ht⟩
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self] using hε
  · have hcos : Real.cos (t / 2) = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp ht
    let δ : ℝ := min ε Real.pi / 2
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := div_pos (lt_min hε Real.pi_pos) (by norm_num)
    have hδε : δ < ε := by
      dsimp only [δ]
      have hle := min_le_left ε Real.pi
      linarith
    have hδpi : δ / 2 < Real.pi := by
      dsimp only [δ]
      have hle := min_le_right ε Real.pi
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hsin : Real.sin (t / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hsum := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (t / 2)
      norm_num [hzero, hcos] at hsum
    have hsinδ : Real.sin (δ / 2) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) hδpi)
    refine ⟨t + δ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, add_sub_cancel_left,
        abs_of_pos hδpos] using hδε
    · change Real.cos ((t + δ) / 2) ≠ 0
      have hangle : (t + δ) / 2 = t / 2 + δ / 2 := by ring
      rw [hangle, Real.cos_add, hcos, zero_mul, zero_sub]
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hsin hsinδ)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_explicit
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_explicit (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (homogeneousTrig p P) (homogeneousTrigDerivative p P t) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold homogeneousTrig homogeneousTrigDerivative
  apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum
  intro k hk
  have hhalf : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / 2) (1 / 2) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id t).div_const 2
  have hterm := ((hhalf.sin.pow k).mul (hhalf.cos.pow (p - k))).const_mul (P.coeff k)
  convert! hterm using 1
  · funext u
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply]
    ring
  · simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
    ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_homogeneousTrigDerivative
statement:
private lemma continuous_homogeneousTrigDerivative (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) :
    Continuous (homogeneousTrigDerivative p P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold homogeneousTrigDerivative
  fun_prop

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_on_chart
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_on_chart (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (homogeneousTrig p P)
      (homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P) t / 2) t
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / 2) (1 / 2) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id t).div_const 2
  have hweighted := (hasDerivAt_cosineWeighted p P (t / 2) ht).comp t hhalf
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ u in nhds t, Real.cos (u / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_id.div_const 2)).continuousAt.eventually_ne ht
  have heq : homogeneousTrig p P =ᶠ[nhds t]
      (fun u : ℝ => cosineWeighted p P (u / 2)) := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with u hu
    exact homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p P hP u hu
  have hchart : HasDerivAt (homogeneousTrig p P)
      ((Real.cos (t / 2) ^ p *
        (cayleyOperator p P).eval (Real.tan (t / 2))) / 2) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one_div] using
      hweighted.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  rw [← homogeneousTrig_eq_cos_pow_eval_tan p (cayleyOperator p P)
    (cayleyOperator_natDegree_le p P hP) t ht] at hchart
  exact hchart

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrigDerivative_eq
statement:
private lemma homogeneousTrigDerivative_eq (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) :
    homogeneousTrigDerivative p P =
      (fun t : ℝ => homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P) t / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.ext_on dense_cos_half_ne_zero
    (continuous_homogeneousTrigDerivative p P)
    ((continuous_homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P)).div_const 2)
  intro t ht
  exact (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_explicit p P t).unique
    (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_on_chart p P hP t ht)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (homogeneousTrig p P)
      (homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P) t / 2) t
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv := hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig_explicit p P t
  rw [homogeneousTrigDerivative_eq p P hP] at hderiv
  exact hderiv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_homogeneousTrig
statement:
lemma deriv_homogeneousTrig (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) t =
      homogeneousTrig p (cayleyOperator p P) t / 2
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_homogeneousTrig p P hP t).deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_coeff_top
statement:
lemma cayleyOperator_coeff_top (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).coeff p = -P.coeff (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hpadd : p - 1 + 1 = p := Nat.sub_add_cancel hp
  have htop := cayleyOperator_coeff_succ p P (p - 1)
  rw [hpadd] at htop
  have hhigh : P.coeff (p - 1 + 2) = 0 :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp hP _ (by omega)
  rw [hhigh, zero_mul, zero_add] at htop
  rw [htop]
  have hcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (p : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpadd
  have hdiff : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - (p : ℝ) = -1 := by linarith
  rw [hdiff]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_homogeneousTrig_pi
statement:
lemma deriv_homogeneousTrig_pi (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) :
    deriv (homogeneousTrig p P) Real.pi = -P.coeff (p - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_homogeneousTrig p P hP, homogeneousTrig_pi,
    cayleyOperator_coeff_top p P hp hP]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_sub
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub (t s : ℝ) :
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ)‖ =
      2 * |Real.sin ((t - s) / 2)|
proof:
:= by
  have hexponent : (s : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((t - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I =
      (t : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hfactor : (Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ) =
      Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (Complex.exp (((t - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1) := by
    rw [Circle.coe_exp, Circle.coe_exp, mul_sub, mul_one, ← Complex.exp_add, hexponent]
  calc
    ‖(Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp s : ℂ)‖ =
        ‖Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (Complex.exp (((t - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖ :=
      congrArg norm hfactor
    _ = ‖Complex.exp (((t - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    _ = ‖(2 : ℝ) * Real.sin ((t - s) / 2)‖ := by
      rw [mul_comm (((t - s : ℝ) : ℂ)) Complex.I]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one (t - s)
    _ = 2 * |Real.sin ((t - s) / 2)| := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_phase_ratio
statement:
lemma norm_phase_ratio (t a b : ℝ) :
    ‖((Circle.exp t : ℂ) - (Circle.exp b : ℂ)) /
      ((Circle.exp a : ℂ) - (Circle.exp b : ℂ))‖ =
      |Real.sin ((t - b) / 2) / Real.sin ((a - b) / 2)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_div, norm_phase_sub, norm_phase_sub, abs_div]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_phase
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_phase (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖cardinal (phaseNodes θ) j (Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖ =
      |sineCardinal θ j t|
proof:
:= by
  unfold cardinal phaseNodes sineCardinal
  rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_prod, norm_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_phase_ratio t (θ j) (θ k)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_phase
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_phase (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes θ) (Circle.exp t : ℂ) =
      ∑ j, |sineCardinal θ j t|
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lebesgueFunction, norm_cardinal_phase]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sine_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
lemma sine_denominator_ne_zero (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hsin
  have hnorm : ‖phaseNodes θ j - phaseNodes θ k‖ = 0 := by
    simpa only [phaseNodes, hsin, abs_zero, mul_zero] using norm_phase_sub (θ j) (θ k)
  exact hjk (hθ (sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm)))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_add_two_pi
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_add_two_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineCardinal θ j (t + 2 * Real.pi) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor (k : Fin n) :
      Real.sin ((t + 2 * Real.pi - θ k) / 2) /
          Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2) =
        (-1 : ℝ) * (Real.sin ((t - θ k) / 2) /
          Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2)) := by
    have hangle : (t + 2 * Real.pi - θ k) / 2 = (t - θ k) / 2 + Real.pi := by
      ring
    rw [hangle, Real.sin_add_pi, neg_div, neg_one_mul]
  unfold sineCardinal
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j)]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.phaseNodes_nodesAngles
statement:
lemma phaseNodes_nodesAngles (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    phaseNodes (nodesAngles nodes) = nodes.coordinates
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  change (Circle.exp (Complex.arg (nodes.point j : ℂ)) : ℂ) = (nodes.point j : ℂ)
  exact congrArg ((↑) : Circle → ℂ) (Circle.exp_arg (nodes.point j))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.nodesAngles_mem_Ioc
statement:
lemma nodesAngles_mem_Ioc (nodes : NodeFamily n) (j : Fin n) :
    nodesAngles nodes j ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi
proof:
:=
  Complex.arg_mem_Ioc _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.nodesAngles_injective
statement:
lemma nodesAngles_injective (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    Function.Injective (nodesAngles nodes)
proof:
:= by
  exact Circle.injective_arg.comp nodes.injective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.phaseNodes_nodesAngles_injective
statement:
lemma phaseNodes_nodesAngles_injective (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    Function.Injective (phaseNodes (nodesAngles nodes))
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseNodes_nodesAngles]
  exact Circle.coe_injective.comp nodes.injective

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_nodesAngles
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_nodesAngles (nodes : NodeFamily n) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖cardinal nodes.coordinates j (Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖ =
      |sineCardinal (nodesAngles nodes) j t|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [phaseNodes_nodesAngles] using norm_cardinal_phase (nodesAngles nodes) j t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_nodesAngles
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_nodesAngles (nodes : NodeFamily n) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (Circle.exp t : ℂ) =
      ∑ j, |sineCardinal (nodesAngles nodes) j t|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [phaseNodes_nodesAngles] using lebesgueFunction_phase (nodesAngles nodes) t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_nodesAngles_at
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_nodesAngles_at (nodes : NodeFamily n) (w : Circle) :
    lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ) =
      ∑ j, |sineCardinal (nodesAngles nodes) j (Complex.arg (w : ℂ))|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Circle.exp_arg] using
    lebesgueFunction_nodesAngles nodes (Complex.arg (w : ℂ))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.nodesAngles_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
lemma nodesAngles_denominator_ne_zero (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    {j k : Fin n} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Real.sin ((nodesAngles nodes j - nodesAngles nodes k) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  sine_denominator_ne_zero _ (phaseNodes_nodesAngles_injective nodes) hjk

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_self
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_self (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (j : Fin n) :
    sineCardinal θ j (θ j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro k hk
  exact div_self (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_other
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_other (θ : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    sineCardinal θ j (θ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩)
  simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_sineCardinal
statement:
lemma continuous_sineCardinal (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    Continuous (sineCardinal θ j)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_finsetProd
  intro k hk
  exact (Real.continuous_sin.comp
    ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const 2)).div_const _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sineCardinal_add_two_pi
statement:
lemma abs_sineCardinal_add_two_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    |sineCardinal θ j (t + 2 * Real.pi)| = |sineCardinal θ j t|
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineCardinal_add_two_pi, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_sineCardinal_periodic
statement:
lemma abs_sineCardinal_periodic (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    Function.Periodic (fun t => |sineCardinal θ j t|) (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:=
  abs_sineCardinal_add_two_pi θ j

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_sineLebesgueFunction
statement:
lemma continuous_sineLebesgueFunction (θ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun t => ∑ j, |sineCardinal θ j t|)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro j hj
  exact (continuous_sineCardinal θ j).abs

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineLebesgueFunction_periodic
statement:
lemma sineLebesgueFunction_periodic (θ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic (fun t => ∑ j, |sineCardinal θ j t|) (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  simp only [abs_sineCardinal_add_two_pi]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_circle_periodic
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_circle_periodic (z : Fin n → ℂ) :
    Function.Periodic (fun t => lebesgueFunction z (Circle.exp t : ℂ))
      (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  exact congrArg (fun w : Circle => lebesgueFunction z (w : ℂ)) (Circle.exp_add_two_pi t)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteHeightDifferences_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma finiteHeightDifferences_apply (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (k : Fin d) :
    finiteHeightDifferences H k = H k.succ - H k.castSucc
proof: := rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_adjacent_height_sub_le_norm
statement:
lemma abs_adjacent_height_sub_le_norm (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (k : Fin d) :
    |H k.succ - H k.castSucc| ≤ ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, finiteHeightDifferences_apply] using
    norm_le_pi_norm (finiteHeightDifferences H) k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_height_sub_first_le_index_mul_norm
statement:
lemma abs_height_sub_first_le_index_mul_norm (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    |H i - H 0| ≤ (i.val : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    calc
      |H i.succ - H 0| = |(H i.succ - H i.castSucc) + (H i.castSucc - H 0)| := by
        congr 1
        ring
      _ ≤ |H i.succ - H i.castSucc| + |H i.castSucc - H 0| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ + (i.val : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ :=
        add_le_add (abs_adjacent_height_sub_le_norm H i) ih
      _ = (i.succ.val : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ := by
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.abs_height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm
statement:
lemma abs_height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    |H i - H j| ≤ 2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (i.val : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (show i.val ≤ d by omega)
  have hj : (j.val : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (show j.val ≤ d by omega)
  calc
    |H i - H j| = |(H i - H 0) - (H j - H 0)| := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ |H i - H 0| + |H j - H 0| := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_sub_le (H i - H 0) (H j - H 0)
    _ ≤ (i.val : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ +
        (j.val : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ :=
      add_le_add (abs_height_sub_first_le_index_mul_norm H i)
        (abs_height_sub_first_le_index_mul_norm H j)
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ + (d : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (norm_nonneg _))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj (norm_nonneg _))
    _ = 2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖ := by ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm
statement:
lemma height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    H i - H j ≤ 2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖finiteHeightDifferences H‖
proof:
:=
  (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm H i j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteHeightDifferences_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma finiteHeightDifferences_eq_zero_iff (H : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) :
    finiteHeightDifferences H = 0 ↔ ∀ i, H i = H 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero i
    have h := abs_height_sub_first_le_index_mul_norm H i
    rw [hzero, norm_zero, mul_zero] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h (abs_nonneg _)))
  · intro hconst
    funext k
    simp only [finiteHeightDifferences_apply, hconst k.succ, hconst k.castSucc,
      sub_self, Pi.zero_apply]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circle_exp_two_mul_eq_of_tan_eq
statement:
lemma circle_exp_two_mul_eq_of_tan_eq (u v : ℝ)
    (hu : Real.cos u ≠ 0) (hv : Real.cos v ≠ 0)
    (htan : Real.tan u = Real.tan v) :
    Circle.exp (2 * u) = Circle.exp (2 * v)
proof:
:= by
  have hcosSq : Real.cos u ^ 2 = Real.cos v ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.inv_one_add_tan_sq hu, ← Real.inv_one_add_tan_sq hv, htan]
  have hcos : Real.cos (2 * u) = Real.cos (2 * v) := by
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul, Real.cos_two_mul, hcosSq]
  have hsin : Real.sin (2 * u) = Real.sin (2 * v) := by
    rw [Real.sin_two_mul, Real.sin_two_mul,
      ← Real.tan_mul_cos hu, ← Real.tan_mul_cos hv]
    calc
      2 * (Real.tan u * Real.cos u) * Real.cos u =
          2 * Real.tan u * Real.cos u ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 2 * Real.tan v * Real.cos v ^ 2 := by rw [htan, hcosSq]
      _ = 2 * (Real.tan v * Real.cos v) * Real.cos v := by ring
  apply Circle.coe_injective
  apply Complex.ext
  · simpa only [Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re] using hcos
  · simpa only [Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im] using hsin

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.tan_half_injOn_Ico
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht s hs heq
  have heqExp := circle_exp_two_mul_eq_of_tan_eq
    (t / 2) (s / 2) ht.2 hs.2 heq
  have htangle : 2 * (t / 2) = t := by ring
  have hsangle : 2 * (s / 2) = s := by ring
  rw [htangle, hsangle] at heqExp
  exact Circle.exp_injOn_Ico (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (by simp)
    ht.1 hs.1 heqExp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_half_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma cos_half_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
