    Real.cos (t / 2) = 0 ↔ t = Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcos
    have hhalf : t / 2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi := by
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hpi : Real.pi / 2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi := by
      constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have heq : t / 2 = Real.pi / 2 :=
      Real.injOn_cos hhalf hpi (by rw [hcos, Real.cos_pi_div_two])
    linarith
  · intro heq
    rw [heq, Real.cos_pi_div_two]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma cos_half_ne_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Real.cos (t / 2) ≠ 0 ↔ t ≠ Real.pi
proof:
:=
  not_congr (cos_half_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico t ht)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.negOnePow_mul_self
statement:
private lemma negOnePow_mul_self (k : ℕ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (-1 : ℝ) ^ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℝ k with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.negOnePow_complement
statement:
private lemma negOnePow_complement (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ d * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (d - i.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : i.val ≤ d := Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt
  have hp : (-1 : ℝ) ^ d = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (d - i.val) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hle]
  rw [hp, mul_assoc, negOnePow_mul_self, mul_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_pos_of_le
statement:
lemma sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_pos_of_le (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i k : Fin (d + 1)) (hki : k ≤ i) :
    0 < Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle k) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := (orderedPeak_mem_node_gap angles hsize i).1
  have hnode := angles.strictMono.monotone hki
  have hpeak := orderedPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize i
  have hnonneg := angles.nonneg k
  apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> linarith [hpeak.1, hpeak.2]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_neg_of_lt
statement:
lemma sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_neg_of_lt (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i k : Fin (d + 1)) (hik : i < k) :
    Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle k) / 2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hright := (orderedPeak_mem_node_gap angles hsize i).2
  have hnode := cyclicGapRight_le_angle_of_lt angles hik
  have hpeak := orderedPeak_mem_Ioo angles hsize i
  have hupper := angles.lt_two_pi k
  apply Real.sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt <;> linarith [hpeak.1, hpeak.2]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityRowFactor_phase_pos
statement:
theorem peakSensitivityRowFactor_phase_pos (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (d - i.val) * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod : 0 < ∏ k : Fin (d + 1),
      (if i < k then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
        Real.sin ((orderedPeak angles hsize i - angles.angle k) / 2) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro k _
    by_cases hik : i < k
    · rw [if_pos hik, neg_one_mul]
      exact neg_pos.mpr (sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_neg_of_lt angles hsize i k hik)
    · rw [if_neg hik, one_mul]
      exact sin_orderedPeak_sub_node_pos_of_le angles hsize i k (le_of_not_gt hik)
  have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin (d + 1) => i < k)) = Finset.Ioi i := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Ioi]
  have hphase : (∏ k : Fin (d + 1), if i < k then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (d - i.val) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_ite]
    simp only [Finset.prod_const, one_pow, mul_one, hfilter, Fin.card_Ioi,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, hphase] at hprod
  exact hprod

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityRowFactor_checkerboard_pos
statement:
lemma peakSensitivityRowFactor_checkerboard_pos (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    0 < ((-1 : ℝ) ^ d * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val) *
      peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i
proof:
:= by
  rw [negOnePow_complement]
  exact peakSensitivityRowFactor_phase_pos angles hsize i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivity_left_relation_quotient_relation
statement:
theorem peakSensitivity_left_relation_quotient_relation
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrel : a ᵥ* peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize = 0) :
    ∀ t, (∑ i, (a i * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i) *
      orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun i => a i * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i
  have hbnode (j : Fin d) :
      (∑ i, b i * orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (angles.angle j.succ)) = 0 := by
    have hj := congrFun hrel j
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul_apply_eq_sum, Pi.zero_apply,
      peakSensitivityMatrix_apply_factorization, peakQuotientNodeMatrix] at hj
    have heq :
        (∑ i, a i * (peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i *
          orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (angles.angle j.succ) *
          peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles j)) =
        (∑ i, b i * orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i (angles.angle j.succ)) *
          peakSensitivityColumnFactor angles j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      dsimp only [b]
      ring
    rw [heq] at hj
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hj).resolve_right (peakSensitivityColumnFactor_ne_zero angles j)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := ∑ i, b i • orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i
  have hfmem : f ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (d + 1 - 2) :=
    (homogeneousTrigSpace (d + 1 - 2)).sum_mem (fun i _ =>
      (homogeneousTrigSpace (d + 1 - 2)).smul_mem _ (orderedPeakQuotient_mem_space angles hsize i))
  have hfzero : f = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hfroot (j : Fin d) : f (angles.angle j.succ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [f, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hbnode j
    have hcount := actualPeakQuotientSpace_hasCyclicRootBound d f hfmem hne
      (fun j : Fin d => angles.angle j.succ)
      (angles.strictMono.injective.comp (Fin.succ_injective d))
      (fun j => ⟨angles.nonneg j.succ, angles.lt_two_pi j.succ⟩) hfroot
    omega
  intro t
  have ht := congrFun hfzero t
  simpa only [f, b, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] using ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivity_left_relation_coherent_sign
statement:
theorem peakSensitivity_left_relation_coherent_sign
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrel : a ᵥ* peakSensitivityMatrix angles hsize = 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 < a i) ∨ (∀ i, a i < 0)
proof:
:= by
  let b : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun i => a i * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i
  have hbrel : ∀ t, (∑ i, b i * orderedPeakQuotient angles hsize i t) = 0 :=
    peakSensitivity_left_relation_quotient_relation angles hsize a hrel
  have hbne : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hbzero
    apply ha
    funext i
    have hi : a i * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i = 0 := congrFun hbzero i
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_right (peakSensitivityRowFactor_ne_zero angles hsize i)
  have hphase (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * b i = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ d * a i) *
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ d * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val) * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i) := by
    dsimp only [b]
    calc
      _ = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ d * (-1 : ℝ) ^ d) *
          ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * (a i * peakSensitivityRowFactor angles hsize i)) := by
            rw [negOnePow_mul_self, one_mul]
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hcommon : (∀ i, 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ d * a i) ∨
      (∀ i, (-1 : ℝ) ^ d * a i < 0) := by
    rcases actualPeakQuotient_relation_coherent_sign angles hsize b hbrel hbne with h | h
    · left
      intro i
      have hi := h i
      rw [hphase] at hi
      exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right (peakSensitivityRowFactor_checkerboard_pos angles hsize i)).mp hi
    · right
      intro i
      have hi := h i
      rw [hphase] at hi
      by_contra hnot
      exact (not_le_of_gt hi) (mul_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hnot)
        (peakSensitivityRowFactor_checkerboard_pos angles hsize i).le)
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℝ d with hd | hd
  · simpa only [hd, one_mul] using hcommon
  · rcases hcommon with h | h
    · right
      intro i
      have hi := h i
      simpa only [hd, neg_one_mul, neg_pos] using hi
    · left
      intro i
      have hi := h i
      simpa only [hd, neg_one_mul, neg_neg_iff_pos] using hi

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.eq_of_points_eq

statement:
lemma regularAngularParameters_toNodeFamily (d : ℕ) :
    (cyclicAnglesOfParameters (regularAngularParameters d)

        regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)

:= by

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.isRegularRotation_of_parameters_eq_regular
statement:
lemma CyclicAngles.isRegularRotation_of_parameters_eq_regular
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))

    IsRegularRotation angles.toNodeFamily
proof:

    intro i
    change Circle.exp (angles.angle i) = regularPoint _ i
    rw [← angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters angles, h, angularParameterAngles_regular]
    rfl
  rw [NodeFamily.eq_of_points_eq _ _ hpoints]
  exact regularNodes_isRegularRotation _ _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_angularInterpolant_envelope
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_angularInterpolant_envelope (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (c : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (p : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (p' : (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hp : HasFDerivAt p p' u)
    (hcritical : deriv (sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles u) c) (p u) = 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin d → ℝ => sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles v) c (p v))
      (angularInterpolantParameterDerivative u c (p u)) u
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu).phaseNodes_injective
  have houter := hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_joint (angularParameterAngles u) c (p u) hθ
    (angularParameterAngle_mem_Ico u hu)
  have hcomp := houter.comp u ((hasFDerivAt_angularParameterAngles u).prodMk hp)
  have heq :
      (sineInterpolantJointDerivative (angularParameterAngles u) c (p u)).comp
        (angularParameterEmbedding.prod p') = angularInterpolantParameterDerivative u c (p u) := by
    ext v
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply]
    rw [sineInterpolantJointDerivative_apply, angularParameterEmbedding_apply,
      angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [angularParameterAngles_zero, angularParameterAngles_succ, zero_mul, zero_add,
      hcritical, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rwa [heq] at hcomp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.peakSensitivityRowDerivative_apply

    peakSensitivityRowDerivative angles hsize i v =

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_at_peak_eq

lemma angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_at_peak_eq
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))

    angularInterpolantParameterDerivative angles.interiorParameters
        (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) i))

    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    HasFDerivAt (parameterOrderedHeight hsize i)
      (peakSensitivityRowDerivative (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize i) u
proof:
:= by
  have hpeak := (contDiffAt_parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain u hu hsize i).differentiableAt
    (by norm_num)
  have hcritical : deriv (sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles u)
      (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) i)))
      (parameterOrderedPeak hsize i u) = 0 := by
    rw [parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain u hu]
    exact (orderedPeak_hasDerivAt_zero (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize i).deriv
  have henvelope := hasFDerivAt_angularInterpolant_envelope u hu
    (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) i))
    (parameterOrderedPeak hsize i) _ hpeak.hasFDerivAt hcritical
  have hactual : HasFDerivAt (parameterOrderedHeight hsize i)
      (angularInterpolantParameterDerivative u
        (cyclicGapCoefficient (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) i))
        (parameterOrderedPeak hsize i u)) u := by
    apply henvelope.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [(isOpen_angularParameterDomain d).eventually_mem hu] with v hv
    exact parameterOrderedHeight_eq_value_at_peak v hv hsize i
  have heq := angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_at_peak_eq
    (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize i
  simp only [CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_ofParameters] at heq
  rw [parameterOrderedPeak_of_mem_domain u hu, heq] at hactual
  exact hactual

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_parameterOrderedHeightMap_of_mem_domain

theorem hasFDerivAt_parameterOrderedHeightMap_of_mem_domain (u : Fin d → ℝ)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian_eq
statement:
theorem parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian_eq (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian hsize u =
      adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix (peakSensitivityMatrix (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian, fderiv_parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences_of_mem_domain u hu,
    peakSensitivityDifferenceLinearMap, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, sub_apply,

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem parameterAdjacentHeightJacobian_det_ne_zero (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :

proof:

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPhaseSign_mul_self
statement: lemma gapPhaseSign_mul_self (cut : Fin n) : gapPhaseSign cut * gapPhaseSign cut = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapPhaseSign
  split_ifs
  · rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  · norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGapCoefficient_eq_phase_mul
statement:
lemma cyclicGapCoefficient_eq_phase_mul (cut k : Fin n) :
    cyclicGapCoefficient cut k = gapPhaseSign cut * gapCoefficient cut k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : cut.val = 0
  · have hpositive : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt cut.isLt
    have heq : cut = (⟨0, hpositive⟩ : Fin n) := Fin.ext hz
    simp only [cyclicGapCoefficient, gapPhaseSign, hz, if_true]
    rw [wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient hpositive k, heq]
  · simp only [cyclicGapCoefficient, gapPhaseSign, hz, if_false, one_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul
statement:
lemma gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    gapInterpolant angles cut t =
      gapPhaseSign cut * sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold gapInterpolant sineInterpolant
  simp_rw [cyclicGapCoefficient_eq_phase_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul
statement:
lemma deriv_gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (cut : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (gapInterpolant angles cut) t =
      gapPhaseSign cut * deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t).const_mul
    (gapPhaseSign cut)
  have heq : gapInterpolant angles cut =
      (fun u => gapPhaseSign cut * sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) u) :=
    funext (gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul angles cut)
  rw [← heq] at h
  simpa only [deriv_sineInterpolant] using h.deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGap_sineWronskian_eq
statement:
lemma cyclicGap_sineWronskian_eq (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian angles.angle (cyclicGapCoefficient i) (cyclicGapCoefficient j) t =
      gapPhaseSign i * gapPhaseSign j *
        sineWronskian angles.angle (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineWronskian
  change gapInterpolant angles i t * deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) t -
    deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) t * gapInterpolant angles j t = _
  rw [gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul, gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul,
    deriv_gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul, deriv_gapInterpolant_eq_phase_mul]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg
statement:
theorem cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (t : ℝ) :
    cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      sineWronskian angles.angle (cyclicGapCoefficient i) (cyclicGapCoefficient j) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      sineWronskian angles.angle (cyclicGapCoefficient i) (cyclicGapCoefficient j) t =
      crossGapPhase i j * sineWronskian angles.angle (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t := by
    rw [cyclicGap_sineWronskian_eq]
    unfold cyclicCrossGapPhase
    calc
      crossGapPhase i j * gapPhaseSign i * gapPhaseSign j *
          (gapPhaseSign i * gapPhaseSign j *
            sineWronskian angles.angle (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t) =
        crossGapPhase i j * (gapPhaseSign i * gapPhaseSign i) *
          (gapPhaseSign j * gapPhaseSign j) *
            sineWronskian angles.angle (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [gapPhaseSign_mul_self, gapPhaseSign_mul_self]; ring
  rw [heq]
  exact crossGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg
statement:
theorem gapPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    cyclicCrossGapPhase i j * deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcritical := (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize i).hasDerivAt_zero.deriv
  have hW := cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij (gapPeak angles hsize i)
  unfold sineWronskian at hW
  change cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
    (gapInterpolant angles i (gapPeak angles hsize i) *
      deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i) -
        deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize i) *
          gapInterpolant angles j (gapPeak angles hsize i)) < 0 at hW
  rw [hcritical, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hW
  have hheight : 0 < gapInterpolant angles i (gapPeak angles hsize i) :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (one_lt_gapHeight angles hsize i)
  by_contra hneg
  have hnneg : 0 ≤ cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i) := le_of_not_gt hneg
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hheight.le hnneg
  have heq : gapInterpolant angles i (gapPeak angles hsize i) *
      (cyclicCrossGapPhase i j * deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i)) =
      cyclicCrossGapPhase i j * (gapInterpolant angles i (gapPeak angles hsize i) *
        deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i)) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hprod
  exact (not_le_of_gt hW) hprod

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_other_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gapPeak_other_derivative_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := gapPeak_other_derivative_phase_neg angles hsize i j hij
  rw [hzero, mul_zero] at h
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos
statement:
theorem gapPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    0 < cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j)
proof:
:= by
  have hcritical := (gapPeak_strictIntervalPeak angles hsize j).hasDerivAt_zero.deriv
  have hW := cyclicGap_phase_sineWronskian_neg angles i j hij (gapPeak angles hsize j)
  unfold sineWronskian at hW
  change cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
    (gapInterpolant angles i (gapPeak angles hsize j) *
      deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize j) -
        deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j) *
          gapInterpolant angles j (gapPeak angles hsize j)) < 0 at hW
  rw [hcritical, mul_zero, zero_sub] at hW
  have hheight : 0 < gapInterpolant angles j (gapPeak angles hsize j) :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) (one_lt_gapHeight angles hsize j)
  by_contra hpos
  have hnpos : cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j) ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hpos
  have hprod := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnpos hheight.le
  have heq : cyclicCrossGapPhase i j *
      -(deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j) *
        gapInterpolant angles j (gapPeak angles hsize j)) =
      -((cyclicCrossGapPhase i j * deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j)) *
        gapInterpolant angles j (gapPeak angles hsize j)) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hW
  linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_first_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gapPeak_first_derivative_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    deriv (gapInterpolant angles i) (gapPeak angles hsize j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := gapPeak_first_derivative_phase_pos angles hsize i j hij
  rw [hzero, mul_zero] at h
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapPeak_distinct_gap_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gapPeak_distinct_gap_derivative_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    deriv (gapInterpolant angles j) (gapPeak angles hsize i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact gapPeak_other_derivative_ne_zero angles hsize i j h
  · exact gapPeak_first_derivative_ne_zero angles hsize j i h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.coeff_X_sq_mul_derivative_succ
statement:
private theorem coeff_X_sq_mul_derivative_succ (P : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (X ^ 2 * P.derivative).coeff (n + 1) = P.coeff n * (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul']
  | succ n =>
      simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_derivative, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc,
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
        (Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul P.derivative 2 n)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cayleyOperator_coeff_zero (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).coeff 0 = P.coeff 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cayleyOperator, add_mul, mul_assoc, Polynomial.coeff_derivative]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_coeff_succ
statement:
theorem cayleyOperator_coeff_succ (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).coeff (n + 1) =
      P.coeff (n + 2) * ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + P.coeff n * ((n : ℝ) - (p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cayleyOperator, add_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
    Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_derivative,
    coeff_X_sq_mul_derivative_succ, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_mul,
    Nat.add_assoc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem cayleyOperator_natDegree_le (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ p) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).natDegree ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      change (cayleyOperator p P).coeff (n + 1) = 0
      rw [cayleyOperator_coeff_succ]
      have hhigh : P.coeff (n + 2) = 0 :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp hP _ (by omega)
      rw [hhigh, zero_mul, zero_add]
      by_cases hnp : n = p
      · subst n
        simp
      · have hmid : P.coeff n = 0 :=
          Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp hP _ (by omega)
        rw [hmid, zero_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cayleyOperator_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cayleyOperator_eval (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    (cayleyOperator p P).eval x =
      (1 + x ^ 2) * P.derivative.eval x - (p : ℝ) * x * P.eval x
proof:
:= by
  simp [cayleyOperator]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrigSpace_hasCyclicRootBound
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrigSpace_hasCyclicRootBound (p : ℕ) :
    HasCyclicRootBound p (homogeneousTrigSpace p)

:= by

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eq_zero_of_cyclic_alternation
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_cyclic_alternation {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f ∈ V) (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hτ : StrictMono τ) (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hsign : ∀ j : Fin d, f (τ j.castSucc) * f (τ j.succ) < 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexists (j : Fin d) :
      ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (τ j.castSucc) (τ j.succ), f x = 0 := by
    have hab : τ j.castSucc ≤ τ j.succ := (hτ Fin.castSucc_lt_succ).le
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (τ j.castSucc) (τ j.succ)) :=
      (hcontinuous f hf).continuousOn
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp (hsign j) with hj | hj
    · exact intermediate_value_Ioo' hab hcont ⟨hj.2, hj.1⟩
    · exact intermediate_value_Ioo hab hcont hj
  let r : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (hexists j)
  have hr_mem (j : Fin d) : r j ∈ Set.Ioo (τ j.castSucc) (τ j.succ) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hexists j)).1
  have hr_eval (j : Fin d) : f (r j) = 0 := (Classical.choose_spec (hexists j)).2
  have hr_strictMono : StrictMono r := by
    intro i j hij
    have hij' : i.val + 1 ≤ j.val := by omega
    have hmiddle : τ i.succ ≤ τ j.castSucc := by
      apply hτ.monotone
      exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by simpa using hij')
    exact ((hr_mem i).2.trans_le hmiddle).trans (hr_mem j).1
  have hr_bound (j : Fin d) : r j ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨(hbound j.castSucc).1.trans (hr_mem j).1.le,
      (hr_mem j).2.trans (hbound j.succ).2⟩
  by_contra hne
  have hcount := hrootBound d f hf hne r hr_strictMono.injective hr_bound hr_eval
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sq_negOnePow
statement: private lemma sq_negOnePow (k : ℕ) : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℝ k with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sum_eq_first_add_negative_add_positive
statement:
private lemma sum_eq_first_add_negative_add_positive {d : ℕ}
    (a v : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, a i * v i) =
      a 0 * v 0 +
        ∑ i ∈ negativeLaterIndices a, a i * v i +
          ∑ i ∈ positiveLaterIndices a, a i * v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : Finset (Fin (d + 1)) := Finset.univ.erase 0
  let N := negativeLaterIndices a
  let P := positiveLaterIndices a
  have hNsub : N ⊆ I := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hPsub : P ⊆ I := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hdis : Disjoint N P := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    intro i hiN hiP
    have hneg : a i < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiN).2
    have hpos : 0 < a i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiP).2
    linarith
  have hcover :
      (∑ i ∈ N ∪ P, a i * v i) = ∑ i ∈ I, a i * v i := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.union_subset hNsub hPsub)
    intro i hiI hiNP
    have hiN : i ∉ N := fun h => hiNP (Finset.mem_union_left P h)
    have hiP : i ∉ P := fun h => hiNP (Finset.mem_union_right N h)
    have hnneg : ¬a i < 0 := by
      intro h
      exact hiN (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiI, h⟩)
    have hnpos : ¬0 < a i := by
      intro h
      exact hiP (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiI, h⟩)
    have hai : a i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnpos) (le_of_not_gt hnneg)
    simp [hai]
  rw [Finset.sum_union hdis] at hcover
  have herase := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun i => a i * v i)
    (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (d + 1)))
  change (∑ i ∈ I, a i * v i) + a 0 * v 0 = ∑ i, a i * v i at herase
  rw [← herase, ← hcover]
  dsimp only [N, P]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_relation_normalized_sign_pattern
statement:
theorem cyclic_relation_normalized_sign_pattern {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hfirst : ∀ i, 0 < q i (τ 0))
    (hfirstLater : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) * q 0 (τ j))
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ j.val * q i (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * q i x) = 0)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (0 < a 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → a i < 0) ∨
      (a 0 < 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → 0 < a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let orient : ℝ := if 0 ≤ a 0 then 1 else -1
  let b : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun i => orient * a i
  have horient : orient = 1 ∨ orient = -1 := by
    dsimp [orient]
    split <;> simp
  have horient_ne : orient ≠ 0 := by
    rcases horient with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hbfirst : 0 ≤ b 0 := by
    dsimp [b, orient]
    split_ifs with h
    · simpa using h
    · have hlt : a 0 < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h
      simp only [neg_one_mul]
      exact neg_nonneg.mpr hlt.le
  have hbne : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    apply ha
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun hb i
    dsimp [b] at hi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_left horient_ne
  have hbrel_eval (x : ℝ) : (∑ i, b i * q i x) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i, b i * q i x) = orient * (∑ i, a i * q i x) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        dsimp [b]
        ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hrel, mul_zero]
  let N := negativeLaterIndices b
  let P := positiveLaterIndices b
  have hN : N.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hNempty
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hNempty
    have hbnonneg (i : Fin (d + 1)) : 0 ≤ b i := by
      by_cases hi : i = 0
      · simpa [hi] using hbfirst
      · apply le_of_not_gt
        intro hneg
        have hiN : i ∈ N := by
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hi, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, hneg⟩
        rw [hNempty] at hiN
        simp at hiN
    obtain ⟨i, hbi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hbne
    have hbipos : 0 < b i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hbnonneg i) (Ne.symm hbi)
    have hterm_nonneg (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
        0 ≤ b k * q k
          (τ 0) :=
      mul_nonneg (hbnonneg k)
        (hfirst k).le
    have hterm_pos :
        0 < b i * q i
          (τ 0) :=
      mul_pos hbipos
        (hfirst i)
    have hsumpos : 0 <
        ∑ k, b k * q k
          (τ 0) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _hk => hterm_nonneg k)]
      exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hterm_pos⟩
    rw [hbrel_eval] at hsumpos
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hsumpos
  
  
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := b 0 • q 0 + ∑ i ∈ N, b i • q i
  have hfmem : f ∈ V := by
    exact V.add_mem (V.smul_mem _ (hq 0))
      (V.sum_mem (fun i hi => V.smul_mem _ (hq i)))
  have hf_eval (x : ℝ) : f x = b 0 * q 0 x + ∑ i ∈ N, b i * q i x := by
    simp only [f, Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hf_eval_eq_neg_pos (x : ℝ) : f x =
      -∑ i ∈ P, b i * q i x := by
    have hsplit := sum_eq_first_add_negative_add_positive b
      (fun i => q i x)
    have hzero := hbrel_eval x
    change (∑ i, b i * q i x) =
      b 0 * q 0 x +
        ∑ i ∈ N, b i * q i x +
          ∑ i ∈ P, b i * q i x at hsplit
    rw [hf_eval]
    linarith
  have hNmem {i : Fin (d + 1)} (hi : i ∈ N) : i ≠ 0 ∧ b i < 0 := by
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
  have hPmem {i : Fin (d + 1)} (hi : i ∈ P) : i ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < b i := by
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
  have hfzero : f = 0 := by
    by_cases hP : P.Nonempty
    · have hf_sign (j : Fin (d + 1)) :
          0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) * f
            (τ j) := by
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst j
          have hsumpos : 0 < ∑ i ∈ P,
              b i * q i
                (τ 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_pos
            · intro i hi
              exact mul_pos (hPmem hi).2
                (hfirst i)
            · exact hP
          rw [hf_eval_eq_neg_pos]
          simpa using hsumpos
        · by_cases hjP : j ∈ P
          · have hfirst : 0 ≤
                b 0 * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  q 0
                    (τ j)) :=
              mul_nonneg hbfirst
                (hfirstLater j hj0).le
            have hNsum : 0 < ∑ i ∈ N,
                (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  (b i * q i
                    (τ j)) := by
              apply Finset.sum_pos
              · intro i hi
                have hine := (hNmem hi).1
                have hibneg := (hNmem hi).2
                have hij : i ≠ j := by
                  intro hij
                  subst i
                  linarith [hibneg, (hPmem hjP).2]
                have hq := hoff i j hine hij
                calc
                  0 < (-b i) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j.val *
                      q i
                        (τ j)) :=
                    mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hibneg) hq
                  _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                      (b i * q i
                        (τ j)) := by
                    rw [pow_succ]
                    ring
              · exact hN
            rw [hf_eval]
            calc
              0 < b 0 * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                    q 0
                      (τ j)) +
                  ∑ i ∈ N, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                    (b i * q i
                      (τ j)) :=
                add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hfirst hNsum
              _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  (b 0 * q 0
                      (τ j) +
                    ∑ i ∈ N, b i *
                      q i
                        (τ j)) := by
                rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
                ring
          · have hjnotpos : ¬0 < b j := by
              intro hjpos
              exact hjP (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
                ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj0, Finset.mem_univ j⟩, hjpos⟩)
            have hPsum : 0 < ∑ i ∈ P,
                (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  (-(b i * q i
                    (τ j))) := by
              apply Finset.sum_pos
              · intro i hi
                have hine := (hPmem hi).1
                have hibpos := (hPmem hi).2
                have hij : i ≠ j := by
                  intro hij
                  subst i
                  exact hjnotpos hibpos
                have hq := hoff i j hine hij
                calc
                  0 < b i * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j.val *
                      q i
                        (τ j)) := mul_pos hibpos hq
                  _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                      (-(b i * q i
                        (τ j))) := by
                    rw [pow_succ]
                    ring
              · exact hP
            rw [hf_eval_eq_neg_pos]
            calc
              0 < ∑ i ∈ P, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  (-(b i * q i
                    (τ j))) := hPsum
              _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) *
                  (-∑ i ∈ P, b i *
                    q i
                      (τ j)) := by
                rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
                congr 1
                rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      apply eq_zero_of_cyclic_alternation hd V hcontinuous hrootBound f hfmem τ hτ hbound
      intro j
      have hleft := hf_sign j.castSucc
      have hright := hf_sign j.succ
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at hleft hright
      rw [show j.val + 1 + 1 = (j.val + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ] at hright
      nlinarith [sq_negOnePow (j.val + 1)]
    · funext x
      have heval : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = 0 := by
        intro x
        rw [hf_eval_eq_neg_pos]
        rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hP]
        simp
      exact heval x
  have hPempty : P = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    intro hP
    have hsumpos : 0 < ∑ i ∈ P,
        b i * q i
          (τ 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_pos
      · intro i hi
        exact mul_pos (hPmem hi).2
          (hfirst i)
      · exact hP
    have hf0 := congrArg
      (fun g : ℝ → ℝ => g (τ 0)) hfzero
    have hf0' : f (τ 0) = 0 := by
      simpa only [Pi.zero_apply] using hf0
    rw [hf_eval_eq_neg_pos] at hf0'
    linarith
  have hblater (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi0 : i ≠ 0) : b i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hbi
    have hiP : i ∉ P := by rw [hPempty]; simp
    have hibnonpos : b i ≤ 0 := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hpos
      exact hiP (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hi0, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, hpos⟩)
    have hiN : i ∉ N := by
      intro hiN
      exact (hNmem hiN).2.ne hbi
    have hfirst : 0 ≤ b 0 * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
        q 0
          (τ i)) :=
      mul_nonneg hbfirst
        (hfirstLater i hi0).le
    have hNsum : 0 < ∑ k ∈ N, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
        (b k * q k
          (τ i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_pos
      · intro k hk
        have hk0 := (hNmem hk).1
        have hkbneg := (hNmem hk).2
        have hki : k ≠ i := by
          intro hki
          subst k
          exact hiN hk
        have hq := hoff k i hk0 hki
        calc
          0 < (-b k) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val *
              q k
                (τ i)) :=
            mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hkbneg) hq
          _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
              (b k * q k
                (τ i)) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
            ring
      · exact hN
    have hfpos : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
        f (τ i) := by
      rw [hf_eval]
      calc
        0 < b 0 * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
              q 0
                (τ i)) +
            ∑ k ∈ N, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
              (b k * q k
                (τ i)) :=
          add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hfirst hNsum
        _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) *
            (b 0 * q 0
                (τ i) +
              ∑ k ∈ N, b k * q k
                (τ i)) := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          ring
    rw [hfzero] at hfpos
    simp at hfpos
  have hbzero : b 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb0
    have hNsumneg :
        ∑ i ∈ N, b i * q i
          (τ 0) < 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_neg
      · intro i hi
        exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (hNmem hi).2
          (hfirst i)
      · exact hN
    have hsplit := sum_eq_first_add_negative_add_positive b
      (fun i => q i
        (τ 0))
    change (∑ i, b i * q i
        (τ 0)) =
      b 0 * q 0
          (τ 0) +
        ∑ i ∈ N, b i * q i
          (τ 0) +
        ∑ i ∈ P, b i * q i
          (τ 0) at hsplit
    rw [hbrel_eval, hb0, hPempty] at hsplit
    simp at hsplit
    exact (ne_of_lt hNsumneg) hsplit.symm
  have hbfirstpos : 0 < b 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hbfirst (Ne.symm hbzero)
  have hblaterneg (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) : b i < 0 := by
    have hnonpos : b i ≤ 0 := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hpos
      have hiP : i ∈ P := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hi, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, hpos⟩
      rw [hPempty] at hiP
      simp at hiP
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnonpos (hblater i hi)
  rcases horient with horient | horient
  · left
    constructor
    · simpa [b, horient] using hbfirstpos
    · intro i hi
      simpa [b, horient] using hblaterneg i hi
  · right
    constructor
    · have := hbfirstpos
      simp only [b, horient, neg_one_mul] at this
      linarith
    · intro i hi
      have := hblaterneg i hi
      simp only [b, horient, neg_one_mul] at this
      linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicRelationNormalizer_sq
statement:
private lemma cyclicRelationNormalizer_sq {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    cyclicRelationNormalizer i * cyclicRelationNormalizer i = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicRelationNormalizer
  split_ifs
  · norm_num
  · nlinarith [sq_negOnePow i.val]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclic_relation_coherent_sign
statement:
theorem cyclic_relation_coherent_sign {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ))
    (hcontinuous : ∀ f ∈ V, Continuous f)
    (hrootBound : HasCyclicRootBound (d - 1) V)
    (q : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ V)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, q i (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) * q i (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * q i x) = 0)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * a i) ∨
      (∀ i, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * a i < 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ → ℝ := fun i => cyclicRelationNormalizer i • q i
  let c : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun i => cyclicRelationNormalizer i * a i
  have hrmem (i : Fin (d + 1)) : r i ∈ V := V.smul_mem _ (hq i)
  have hfirst (i : Fin (d + 1)) : 0 < r i (τ 0) := by
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simpa [r, cyclicRelationNormalizer] using neg_pos.mpr (hdiag 0)
    · have h := hoff i 0 hi
      simpa [r, cyclicRelationNormalizer, hi] using h
  have hfirstLater (j : Fin (d + 1)) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
      0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val + 1) * r 0 (τ j) := by
    have h := hoff 0 j hj.symm
    simpa [r, cyclicRelationNormalizer, pow_succ] using h
  have hroff (i j : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ j.val * r i (τ j) := by
    have h := hoff i j hij
    simpa [r, cyclicRelationNormalizer, hi, pow_add, mul_assoc,
      mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h
  have hcrel (x : ℝ) : (∑ i, c i * r i x) = 0 := by
    convert hrel x using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    dsimp [c, r]
    calc
      cyclicRelationNormalizer i * a i * (cyclicRelationNormalizer i * q i x) =
          (cyclicRelationNormalizer i * cyclicRelationNormalizer i) * (a i * q i x) := by ring
      _ = a i * q i x := by rw [cyclicRelationNormalizer_sq, one_mul]
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    apply ha
    funext i
    have hci := congrFun hc i
    have hs := cyclicRelationNormalizer_sq i
    dsimp [c] at hci
    change cyclicRelationNormalizer i * a i = 0 at hci
    change a i = 0
    have hsne : cyclicRelationNormalizer i ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      rw [hz, zero_mul] at hs
      norm_num at hs
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hci).resolve_left hsne
  rcases cyclic_relation_normalized_sign_pattern hd V hcontinuous hrootBound r hrmem
      τ hτ hbound hfirst hfirstLater hroff c hcrel hcne with h | h
  · right
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      have h0 := h.1
      simp [c, cyclicRelationNormalizer] at h0
      simpa using h0
    · simpa only [c, cyclicRelationNormalizer, if_neg hi] using h.2 i hi
  · left
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      have h0 := h.1
      simp [c, cyclicRelationNormalizer] at h0
      simpa using h0
    · simpa only [c, cyclicRelationNormalizer, if_neg hi] using h.2 i hi

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_relation_coherent_sign
statement:
theorem homogeneousTrig_relation_coherent_sign {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hdegree : ∀ i, (P i).natDegree ≤ d - 1)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) x) = 0)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * a i) ∨
      (∀ i, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val * a i < 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact cyclic_relation_coherent_sign hd (homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (continuous_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (d - 1))
    (homogeneousTrigSpace_hasCyclicRootBound (d - 1))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i))
    (fun i => homogeneousTrig_mem_space (d - 1) (P i) (hdegree i))
    τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff a hrel ha

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_relation_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousTrig_relation_coeff_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hdegree : ∀ i, (P i).natDegree ≤ d - 1)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) x) = 0)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases homogeneousTrig_relation_coherent_sign hd P hdegree τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff
      a hrel ha with h | h
  · intro i hi
    have := h i
    simp [hi] at this
  · intro i hi
    have := h i
    simp [hi] at this

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrig_relation_eq_zero_of_missing_coeff
statement:
theorem homogeneousTrig_relation_eq_zero_of_missing_coeff {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hdegree : ∀ i, (P i).natDegree ≤ d - 1)
    (τ : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (hτ : StrictMono τ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, τ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ i) < 0)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + j.val) *
      homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) (τ j))
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrel : ∀ x, (∑ i, a i * homogeneousTrig (d - 1) (P i) x) = 0)
    (missing : Fin (d + 1)) (hmissing : a missing = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ha
  exact (homogeneousTrig_relation_coeff_ne_zero hd P hdegree τ hτ hbound hdiag hoff
    a hrel ha missing) hmissing

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.coordinates_rotate
statement:
@[simp] lemma NodeFamily.coordinates_rotate (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle)
    (i : Fin n) :
    (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates i = (rotation : ℂ) * nodes.coordinates i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [NodeFamily.coordinates, NodeFamily.rotate, Circle.coe_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.coordinates_reindex
statement:
@[simp] lemma NodeFamily.coordinates_reindex (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    (nodes.reindex permutation).coordinates i = nodes.coordinates (permutation i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_mul
statement:
lemma cardinal_mul (z : Fin n → ℂ) {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (j : Fin n) (w : ℂ) :
    cardinal (fun i => a * z i) j (a * w) = cardinal z j w
proof:
:= by
  unfold cardinal
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [← mul_sub a w (z k), ← mul_sub a (z j) (z k)]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ ha

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_mul
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_mul (z : Fin n → ℂ) {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin n) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖cardinal (fun i => a * z i) j (a * w)‖ = ‖cardinal z j w‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardinal_mul z ha]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_mul
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_mul (z : Fin n → ℂ) {a : ℂ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    lebesgueFunction (fun i => a * z i) (a * w) = lebesgueFunction z w
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact norm_cardinal_mul z ha j w

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_rotate
statement:
lemma cardinal_rotate (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) (j : Fin n)
    (w : Circle) :
    cardinal (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates j ((rotation * w : Circle) : ℂ) =
      cardinal nodes.coordinates j (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Circle.coe_mul]
  change cardinal (fun i => (rotation : ℂ) * nodes.coordinates i) j
    ((rotation : ℂ) * (w : ℂ)) = _
  exact cardinal_mul nodes.coordinates (Circle.coe_ne_zero rotation) j (w : ℂ)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_rotate
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_rotate (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) (j : Fin n)
    (w : Circle) :
    ‖cardinal (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates j ((rotation * w : Circle) : ℂ)‖ =
      ‖cardinal nodes.coordinates j (w : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardinal_rotate]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_rotate
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_rotate (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) (w : Circle) :
    lebesgueFunction (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates ((rotation * w : Circle) : ℂ) =
      lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact norm_cardinal_rotate nodes rotation j w

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_rotate
statement:
lemma amplification_rotate (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) :
    amplification (nodes.rotate rotation) = amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (amplification_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro w
    calc
      lebesgueFunction (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates (w : ℂ) =
          lebesgueFunction (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates
            ((rotation * (rotation⁻¹ * w) : Circle) : ℂ) := by simp
      _ = lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates ((rotation⁻¹ * w : Circle) : ℂ) :=
        lebesgueFunction_rotate nodes rotation (rotation⁻¹ * w)
      _ ≤ amplification nodes := le_amplification nodes (rotation⁻¹ * w)
  · apply (amplification_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro w
    calc
      lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates (w : ℂ) =
          lebesgueFunction (nodes.rotate rotation).coordinates
            ((rotation * w : Circle) : ℂ) :=
        (lebesgueFunction_rotate nodes rotation w).symm
      _ ≤ amplification (nodes.rotate rotation) :=
        le_amplification (nodes.rotate rotation) (rotation * w)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_reindex
statement:
lemma cardinal_reindex (z : Fin n → ℂ) (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (j : Fin n) (w : ℂ) :
    cardinal (fun i => z (permutation i)) j w = cardinal z (permutation j) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold cardinal
  apply Finset.prod_equiv permutation
  · intro i
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
    exact (not_congr permutation.injective.eq_iff).symm
  · intro i hi
    rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.norm_cardinal_reindex
statement:
lemma norm_cardinal_reindex (z : Fin n → ℂ) (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (j : Fin n) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖cardinal (fun i => z (permutation i)) j w‖ =
      ‖cardinal z (permutation j) w‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardinal_reindex]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_reindex
statement:
lemma lebesgueFunction_reindex (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (w : ℂ) :
    lebesgueFunction (nodes.reindex permutation).coordinates w =
      lebesgueFunction nodes.coordinates w
proof:
:= by
  unfold lebesgueFunction
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv permutation
  intro j
  change ‖cardinal (fun i => nodes.coordinates (permutation i)) j w‖ = _
  exact norm_cardinal_reindex nodes.coordinates permutation j w

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_reindex
statement:
lemma amplification_reindex (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    amplification (nodes.reindex permutation) = amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  unfold amplification
  simp only [lebesgueFunction_reindex]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_rotate_iff
statement:
lemma isMinimizer_rotate_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) :
    IsMinimizer (nodes.rotate rotation) ↔ IsMinimizer nodes
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsMinimizer, amplification_rotate]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_reindex_iff
statement:
lemma isMinimizer_reindex_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    IsMinimizer (nodes.reindex permutation) ↔ IsMinimizer nodes
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsMinimizer, amplification_reindex]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isRegularRotation_rotate_iff
statement:
lemma isRegularRotation_rotate_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n) (rotation : Circle) :
    IsRegularRotation (nodes.rotate rotation) ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, permutation, h⟩
    refine ⟨rotation⁻¹ * r, permutation, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hi := congrArg (fun z : Circle => rotation⁻¹ * z) (h i)
    change rotation⁻¹ * (rotation * nodes.point i) =
      rotation⁻¹ * (r * regularPoint n (permutation i)) at hi
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_assoc] using hi
  · rintro ⟨r, permutation, h⟩
    refine ⟨rotation * r, permutation, ?_⟩
    intro i
    change rotation * nodes.point i = (rotation * r) * regularPoint n (permutation i)
    rw [h i, mul_assoc]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isRegularRotation_reindex_iff
statement:
lemma isRegularRotation_reindex_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n)
    (permutation : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    IsRegularRotation (nodes.reindex permutation) ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rotation, p, h⟩
    refine ⟨rotation, permutation.symm.trans p, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hi := h (permutation.symm i)
    change nodes.point (permutation (permutation.symm i)) =
      rotation * regularPoint n (p (permutation.symm i)) at hi
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.trans_apply] using hi
  · rintro ⟨rotation, p, h⟩
    refine ⟨rotation, permutation.trans p, ?_⟩
    intro i
    exact h (permutation i)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularPoint_add
statement:
lemma regularPoint_add {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (i j : Fin n) :
    regularPoint n (i + j) = regularPoint n i * regularPoint n j
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne n)
  unfold regularPoint
  rw [← Circle.exp_add, Fin.val_add_eq_ite]
  by_cases h : n ≤ i.val + j.val
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_sub h, Nat.cast_add]
    have heq : 2 * Real.pi * (((i.val : ℝ) + j.val - n) / n) =
        (2 * Real.pi * (i.val / n) + 2 * Real.pi * (j.val / n)) - 2 * Real.pi := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq, Circle.exp_sub_two_pi]
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_add]
    congr 1
    ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_lebesgueFunction_rotate
statement:
theorem regular_lebesgueFunction_rotate {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (i : Fin n) (w : Circle) :
    lebesgueFunction (regularNodes n hn).coordinates
      ((regularPoint n i * w : Circle) : ℂ) =
      lebesgueFunction (regularNodes n hn).coordinates (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hn⟩
  let p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := Equiv.addLeft i
  have hcoord : ((regularNodes n hn).rotate (regularPoint n i)).coordinates =
      ((regularNodes n hn).reindex p).coordinates := by
    funext j
    change ((regularPoint n i : ℂ) * (regularPoint n j : ℂ)) =
      (regularPoint n (i + j) : ℂ)
    rw [regularPoint_add, Circle.coe_mul]
  have h := lebesgueFunction_rotate (regularNodes n hn) (regularPoint n i) w
  rw [hcoord, lebesgueFunction_reindex] at h
  exact h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_lebesgueFunction_shift
statement:
theorem regular_lebesgueFunction_shift {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction (regularNodes n hn).coordinates
      (Circle.exp (t + 2 * Real.pi * ((i.val : ℝ) / n)) : ℂ) =
      lebesgueFunction (regularNodes n hn).coordinates (Circle.exp t : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Circle.exp_add, mul_comm (Circle.exp t)]
  exact regular_lebesgueFunction_rotate hn i (Circle.exp t)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularCyclicAngles_angle
statement:
lemma regularCyclicAngles_angle (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    (regularCyclicAngles d).angle i =
      2 * Real.pi * ((i.val : ℝ) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  angularParameterAngles_regular d i

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularCyclicAngles_coordinates
statement:
lemma regularCyclicAngles_coordinates (d : ℕ) :
    phaseNodes (regularCyclicAngles d).angle =
      (regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)).coordinates
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (Circle.exp ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle i) : ℂ) = _
  rw [regularCyclicAngles_angle]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularCyclicAngles_isRegularRotation
statement:
theorem regularCyclicAngles_isRegularRotation (d : ℕ) :
    IsRegularRotation (regularCyclicAngles d).toNodeFamily
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, Equiv.refl _, ?_⟩
  intro i
  change Circle.exp ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle i) = 1 * regularPoint (d + 1) i
  rw [regularCyclicAngles_angle, one_mul]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularCyclicGapRight
statement:
lemma regularCyclicGapRight (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) i =
      2 * Real.pi * (((i.val : ℝ) + 1) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < d + 1
  · rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hi, regularCyclicAngles_angle]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  · have heq : i.val + 1 = d + 1 := by have h := i.isLt; omega
    have heqR : (i.val : ℝ) + 1 = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast heq
    rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_neg hi, heqR, div_self hn, mul_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_ordered_gap_translate
statement:
lemma regular_ordered_gap_translate (k : Fin (d + 1)) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle k)
      (cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) k)) :
    t - (regularCyclicAngles d).angle k ∈
      Set.Ioo ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle 0)
        (cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularCyclicAngles_angle, regularCyclicGapRight] at ht ⊢
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero, zero_add]
  rw [regularCyclicAngles_angle]
  have heq : 2 * Real.pi * (((k.val : ℝ) + 1) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      2 * Real.pi * ((k.val : ℝ) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        2 * Real.pi * (1 / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by ring
  rw [heq] at ht
  rcases ht with ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩
  constructor <;> linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_ordered_gap_translate_back
statement:
lemma regular_ordered_gap_translate_back (k : Fin (d + 1)) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle 0)
      (cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) 0)) :
    t + (regularCyclicAngles d).angle k ∈
      Set.Ioo ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle k)
        (cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularCyclicAngles_angle, regularCyclicGapRight] at ht ⊢
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero, zero_add] at ht
  have heq : 2 * Real.pi * (((k.val : ℝ) + 1) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      2 * Real.pi * ((k.val : ℝ) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        2 * Real.pi * (1 / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  rcases ht with ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩
  constructor <;> linarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_orderedHeight_eq_literal
statement:
lemma regular_orderedHeight_eq_literal (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    orderedHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k =
      lebesgueFunction (regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)).coordinates
        (Circle.exp (orderedPeak (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedHeight, gapHeight_eq_lebesgueFunction, regularCyclicAngles_coordinates]
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_literal_le_orderedHeight
statement:
lemma regular_literal_le_orderedHeight (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo ((regularCyclicAngles d).angle k)
      (cyclicGapRight (regularCyclicAngles d) k)) :
    lebesgueFunction (regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)).coordinates
      (Circle.exp t : ℂ) ≤ orderedHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : t ∈ gapInterval (regularCyclicAngles d)
      (physicalGapCut (Nat.succ_pos d) k) := by
    rw [gapInterval, gapLeft_physicalGapCut, gapRight_physicalGapCut]
    exact ht
  rw [← regularCyclicAngles_coordinates, lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval _ _ hgap]
  exact gapInterpolant_le_gapHeight _ hsize _ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hgap)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_orderedHeight_eq
statement:
theorem regular_orderedHeight_eq (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    orderedHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k =
      orderedHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [regular_orderedHeight_eq_literal]
    let t := orderedPeak (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k - (regularCyclicAngles d).angle k
    have ht := regular_ordered_gap_translate k
      (orderedPeak_mem_node_gap (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k)
    have hshift := regular_lebesgueFunction_shift (Nat.succ_pos d) k t
    rw [← regularCyclicAngles_angle] at hshift
    have heq : t + (regularCyclicAngles d).angle k =
        orderedPeak (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize k := by dsimp [t]; ring
    rw [heq] at hshift
    rw [hshift]
    exact regular_literal_le_orderedHeight hsize 0 ht
  · let t := orderedPeak (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize 0
    have ht := regular_ordered_gap_translate_back k
      (orderedPeak_mem_node_gap (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize 0)
    have hshift := regular_lebesgueFunction_shift (Nat.succ_pos d) k t
    rw [← regularCyclicAngles_angle] at hshift
    rw [regular_orderedHeight_eq_literal, ← hshift]
    exact regular_literal_le_orderedHeight hsize k ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regular_gapHeight_eq
statement:
theorem regular_gapHeight_eq (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    gapHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize i =
      gapHeight (regularCyclicAngles d) hsize j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := physicalGapCut_surjective (Nat.succ_pos d) i
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := physicalGapCut_surjective (Nat.succ_pos d) j
  exact (regular_orderedHeight_eq hsize k).trans (regular_orderedHeight_eq hsize l).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterOrderedHeight_regular_eq
statement:
theorem parameterOrderedHeight_regular_eq (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (i j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize i (regularAngularParameters d) =
      parameterOrderedHeight hsize j (regularAngularParameters d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain _ (regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d),
    parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain _ (regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d)]
  exact (regular_orderedHeight_eq hsize i).trans (regular_orderedHeight_eq hsize j).symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences_regular_eq_zero
statement:
theorem parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences_regular_eq_zero (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize (regularAngularParameters d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.succ (regularAngularParameters d) -
    parameterOrderedHeight hsize i.castSucc (regularAngularParameters d) = 0
  rw [parameterOrderedHeight_regular_eq hsize i.succ i.castSucc, sub_self]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant θ c ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨interpolantPolynomial θ c, interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le θ c,
    (homogeneousTrig_interpolantPolynomial θ c).symm⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    sineCardinal θ j ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : sineInterpolant θ (Pi.single j 1) = sineCardinal θ j := by
    funext t
    simp [sineInterpolant, Pi.single_apply]
  rw [← heq]
  exact sineInterpolant_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace θ (Pi.single j 1)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.homogeneousTrigSpace_eq_of_at_nodes
statement:
lemma homogeneousTrigSpace_eq_of_at_nodes (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (f g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1))
    (hg : g ∈ homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)) (hnode : ∀ i, f (θ i) = g (θ i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra hne
  have hinj : Function.Injective θ := by
    intro i k hik
    apply hθ
    simp only [phaseNodes, hik]
  have hcount := distinct_root_count_of_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1) (f - g)
    ((homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)).sub_mem hf hg) hne θ hinj hbound
    (fun i => by simp [hnode i])
  omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_update_node_transport
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_update_node_transport (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (u t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hu : Function.Injective (phaseNodes (Function.update θ j u))) :
    sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c t = sineInterpolant θ c t +
      (sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c (θ j) - c j) * sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c =
      sineInterpolant θ c +
        (sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c (θ j) - c j) • sineCardinal θ j := by
    apply homogeneousTrigSpace_eq_of_at_nodes θ j.pos hθ hbound
    · exact sineInterpolant_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace _ _
    · exact (homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)).add_mem
        (sineInterpolant_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace θ c)
        ((homogeneousTrigSpace (n - 1)).smul_mem _
          (sineCardinal_mem_homogeneousTrigSpace θ j))
    · intro i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          sineInterpolant_at_node θ hθ c j, sineCardinal_self θ hθ j]
        ring
      · have hnode : sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c (θ i) = c i := by
          simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hij] using
            sineInterpolant_at_node (Function.update θ j u) hu c i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hnode,
          sineInterpolant_at_node θ hθ c i, sineCardinal_other θ hij, mul_zero, add_zero]
  exact congrFun heq t

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update_at_original_node
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update_at_original_node (θ c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (j : Fin n) (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c (θ j))
      (-deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j)) (θ j)
proof:
:= by
  let H : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => sineInterpolant x.1 c x.2
  let L := fderiv ℝ H (θ, θ j)
  have hH : HasFDerivAt H L (θ, θ j) :=
    (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint 1 θ (θ j) c hθ).differentiableAt
      (by norm_num) |>.hasFDerivAt
  have hupdate := hasDerivAt_update θ j (θ j)
  have hcoord := hH.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (θ j)
    (hupdate.prodMk (hasDerivAt_const (θ j) (θ j))) (by
      simp only [Function.update_eq_self])
  have hdiag := hH.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (θ j)
    (hupdate.prodMk (hasDerivAt_id (θ j))) (by
      simp only [Function.update_eq_self, id_eq])
  have heval := hH.comp_hasDerivAt (θ j)
    ((hasDerivAt_const (θ j) θ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id (θ j)))
  have hconst : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c u)
      0 (θ j) := by
    apply (hasDerivAt_const (θ j) (c j)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [eventually_phaseNodes_injective_update θ j hθ] with u hu
    simpa only [Function.update_self] using
      sineInterpolant_at_node (Function.update θ j u) hu c j
  have heval' : HasDerivAt (sineInterpolant θ c)
      (deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j)) (θ j) :=
    (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c (θ j)).hasDerivAt
  have hdiagzero : L (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) = 0 := hdiag.unique hconst
  have hevalvalue : L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) =
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) := heval.unique heval'
  have hsplit : L (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) =
      L (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) + L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hvalue : L (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) =
      -deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) := by
    rw [hdiagzero, hevalvalue] at hsplit
    linarith
  exact hvalue ▸ hcoord

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c t)
      (-deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t) (θ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar :=
    (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update_at_original_node θ c j hθ).sub_const (c j)
  have hright := (hasDerivAt_const (θ j) (sineInterpolant θ c t)).add
    (hscalar.mul_const (sineCardinal θ j t))
  simp only [zero_add] at hright
  apply hright.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [eventually_phaseNodes_injective_update θ j hθ] with u hu
  exact sineInterpolant_update_node_transport θ c j u t hθ hbound hu

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_update
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_update (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    deriv (fun u : ℝ => sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c t) (θ j) =
      -deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update θ c j t hθ hbound).deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_single
statement:
lemma fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_single (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t) θ (Pi.single j 1) =
      -deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_parameters 1 θ c t hθ).differentiableAt
    (by norm_num)
  have hcomp := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (θ j)
    (hasDerivAt_update θ j (θ j)) (by simp only [Function.update_eq_self])
  exact hcomp.unique (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant_update θ c j t hθ hbound)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_apply (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t) θ v =
      ∑ j, v j * (-deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single v]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hsingle : Pi.single j (v j) = v j • Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext k
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simp
    · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hkj]
  rw [hsingle, map_smul, fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_single θ c j t hθ hbound,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply
statement:
lemma sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    sineInterpolantParameterDerivative θ c t v =
      ∑ j, v j * (-deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sineInterpolantParameterDerivative, sum_apply,
    smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_parameters
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_parameters (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t)
      (sineInterpolantParameterDerivative θ c t) θ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t) θ =
      sineInterpolantParameterDerivative θ c t := by
    ext v
    rw [fderiv_sineInterpolant_parameters_apply θ c t hθ hbound,
      sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply]
  rw [← heq]
  exact (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_parameters 1 θ c t hθ).differentiableAt
    (by norm_num) |>.hasFDerivAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolantJointDerivative_apply
statement:
lemma sineInterpolantJointDerivative_apply (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolantJointDerivative θ c t (v, s) =
      (∑ j, v j * (-deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) (θ j) * sineCardinal θ j t)) +
        s * deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sineInterpolantJointDerivative, add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_joint
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_joint (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i, θ i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => sineInterpolant x.1 c x.2)
      (sineInterpolantJointDerivative θ c t) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  let H : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => sineInterpolant x.1 c x.2
  let L := fderiv ℝ H (θ, t)
  have hH : HasFDerivAt H L (θ, t) :=
    (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint 1 θ t c hθ).differentiableAt
      (by norm_num) |>.hasFDerivAt
  have hleft := hH.comp θ (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) θ t)
  have hleftmap := hleft.unique (hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_parameters θ c t hθ hbound)
  have heval := hH.comp_hasDerivAt t
    ((hasDerivAt_const t θ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t))
  have hevalvalue : L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) =
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t := heval.unique
    (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c t).hasDerivAt
  have heq : L = sineInterpolantJointDerivative θ c t := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rcases x with ⟨v, s⟩
    have hleftvalue : L (v, (0 : ℝ)) = sineInterpolantParameterDerivative θ c t v := by
      have hv := congrArg (fun f : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => f v) hleftmap
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply] using hv
    have hrightvalue : L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), s) = s * deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t := by
      calc
        L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), s) = L (s • ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) := by
          congr 1
          simp
        _ = s • L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := map_smul L s _
        _ = s * deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t := by rw [hevalvalue, smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      L (v, s) = L (v, (0 : ℝ)) + L ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), s) := by
        rw [← map_add]
        congr 1
        simp
      _ = sineInterpolantJointDerivative θ c t (v, s) := by
        rw [hleftvalue, hrightvalue, sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply,
          sineInterpolantJointDerivative_apply]
  exact heq ▸ hH

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.rectangularCofactor_left_relation
statement:
lemma rectangularCofactor_left_relation (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    rectangularCofactor M ᵥ* M = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext j
  let A : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i k => Fin.cases (M i j) (fun k' => M i k') k
  have hcols : ∀ i, A i 0 = A i j.succ := by simp [A]
  have hne : (0 : Fin (d + 1)) ≠ j.succ := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ] at hv
    omega
  have hdet : A.det = 0 := Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq hne hcols
  have hexpand := Matrix.det_succ_column A (0 : Fin (d + 1))
  rw [hdet] at hexpand
  have hminor (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
      (A.submatrix i.succAbove (0 : Fin (d + 1)).succAbove).det =
        (M.submatrix i.succAbove id).det := by
    congr 1
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero, A, Fin.cases_zero, hminor] at hexpand
  simpa [rectangularCofactor, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, mul_assoc,
    mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hexpand.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.rectangularCofactor_ne_zero_of_first_minor
statement:
lemma rectangularCofactor_ne_zero_of_first_minor
    (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hminor : (M.submatrix (0 : Fin (d + 1)).succAbove id).det ≠ 0) :
    rectangularCofactor M ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := congrFun hz (0 : Fin (d + 1))
  simp only [rectangularCofactor, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h
  exact hminor h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.augmentedOnesMatrix_det_eq_sum_cofactors
statement:
lemma augmentedOnesMatrix_det_eq_sum_cofactors
    (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    (augmentedOnesMatrix M).det = ∑ i, rectangularCofactor M i
proof:
:= by
  have hexpand := Matrix.det_succ_column_zero (augmentedOnesMatrix M)
  have hminor (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
      ((augmentedOnesMatrix M).submatrix i.succAbove
        Fin.succ).det = (M.submatrix i.succAbove id).det := by
    congr 1
  simpa only [augmentedOnesMatrix, Fin.cases_zero, mul_one, hminor,
    rectangularCofactor] using hexpand

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.augmentedOnesMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors
statement:
lemma augmentedOnesMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors
    (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hcoherent : (∀ i, 0 < rectangularCofactor M i) ∨
      (∀ i, rectangularCofactor M i < 0)) : (augmentedOnesMatrix M).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [augmentedOnesMatrix_det_eq_sum_cofactors]
  rcases hcoherent with h | h
  · exact (Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => h i) Finset.univ_nonempty).ne'
  · exact (Finset.sum_neg (fun i _ => h i) Finset.univ_nonempty).ne

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_augmented
statement:
theorem adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_augmented
    (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (haug : (augmentedOnesMatrix M).det ≠ 0) :
    (adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix M).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hvne, hv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  let rowValue : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j, M i j * v j
  have hadj (i : Fin d) : rowValue i.succ = rowValue i.castSucc := by
    have hi := congrFun hv i
    simp only [adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Pi.zero_apply, rowValue] at hi ⊢
    simp_rw [sub_mul] at hi
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hi
    linarith
  have hconst (i : Fin (d + 1)) : rowValue i = rowValue 0 := by
    induction i using Fin.induction with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ i ih => exact (hadj i).trans ih
  let w : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ := Fin.cases (-(rowValue 0)) v
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hw
    apply hvne
    funext j
    have hj := congrFun hw j.succ
    simpa [w] using hj
  have hAw : (augmentedOnesMatrix M).mulVec w = 0 := by
    funext i
    rw [show (augmentedOnesMatrix M).mulVec w i = -(rowValue 0) + rowValue i by
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, augmentedOnesMatrix, w, Fin.sum_univ_succ, rowValue]]
    rw [hconst i]
    simp
  exact haug (Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp ⟨w, hwne, hAw⟩)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors
statement:
theorem adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors
    (M : Matrix (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hcoherent : (∀ i, 0 < rectangularCofactor M i) ∨
      (∀ i, rectangularCofactor M i < 0)) :
    (adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix M).det ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  adjacentRowDifferenceMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_augmented M
    (augmentedOnesMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_coherent_cofactors M hcoherent)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapHeight_le_gapHeightMaximum
statement:
lemma gapHeight_le_gapHeightMaximum (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) : gapHeight angles hsize cut ≤ gapHeightMaximum angles hsize
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup' (gapHeight angles hsize) (Finset.mem_univ cut)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_lt_gapHeightMaximum
statement:
lemma one_lt_gapHeightMaximum (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 < gapHeightMaximum angles hsize
proof:
:=
  (one_lt_gapHeight angles hsize ⟨0, hn⟩).trans_le
    (gapHeight_le_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize ⟨0, hn⟩)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.circleLebesgue_le_gapHeightMaximum
statement:
lemma circleLebesgue_le_gapHeightMaximum (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    lebesgueFunction (phaseNodes angles.angle) (Circle.exp t : ℂ) ≤
      gapHeightMaximum angles hsize
proof:
:= by
  rcases angles.exists_node_or_gap t ht with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨cut, hcut, hgap⟩ | hwrap
  · have hnode : (Circle.exp (angles.angle i) : ℂ) = phaseNodes angles.angle i := rfl
    rw [hnode, lebesgueFunction_at_node _ angles.phaseNodes_injective i]
    exact (one_lt_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize).le
  · have hinterval : t ∈ gapInterval angles cut := by
      rwa [gapInterval_of_pos angles cut hcut]
    rw [lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval angles cut hinterval]
    exact (gapInterpolant_le_gapHeight angles hsize cut
