      (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hinterval)).trans (gapHeight_le_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize cut)
  · have hinterval : t ∈ gapInterval angles ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
      rwa [gapInterval_zero]
    rw [lebesgueFunction_on_gapInterval angles ⟨0, hn⟩ hinterval]
    exact (gapInterpolant_le_gapHeight angles hsize ⟨0, hn⟩
      (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hinterval)).trans
        (gapHeight_le_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize ⟨0, hn⟩)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularAmplification_eq_gapHeightMaximum
statement:
theorem angularAmplification_eq_gapHeightMaximum (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) : angularAmplification angles = gapHeightMaximum angles hsize
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (amplification_le_iff angles.toNodeFamily _).mpr
    intro w
    rw [CyclicAngles.toNodeFamily_coordinates]
    have h := circleLebesgue_le_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize (cyclicPhase w)
      (cyclicPhase_mem_Ico w)
    rwa [exp_cyclicPhase] at h
  · apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro cut hcut
    exact gapHeight_le_angularAmplification angles hsize cut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_lt_angularAmplification
statement:
lemma one_lt_angularAmplification (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 < angularAmplification angles
proof:
:= by
  rw [angularAmplification_eq_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize]
  exact one_lt_gapHeightMaximum angles hsize

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_eq_ordered_gapHeightMaximum
statement:
theorem amplification_eq_ordered_gapHeightMaximum (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    amplification nodes = gapHeightMaximum (orderedAngles nodes hn) hsize
proof:
:= by
  let rotated := anchoredNodes nodes hn
  let normalized := rotated.reindex rotated.sortedPermutation
  have hcoordinates : normalized.coordinates = (orderedAngles nodes hn).toNodeFamily.coordinates := by
    funext i
    change ((anchoredNodes nodes hn).point ((anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPermutation i) : ℂ) =
      (Circle.exp ((anchoredNodes nodes hn).sortedPhase i) : ℂ)
    exact congrArg ((↑) : Circle → ℂ) ((anchoredNodes nodes hn).exp_sortedPhase i).symm
  have hinvariant : amplification normalized = amplification nodes := by
    dsimp only [normalized]
    rw [amplification_reindex]
    exact amplification_rotate nodes (nodes.point ⟨0, hn⟩)⁻¹
  calc
    amplification nodes = amplification normalized := hinvariant.symm
    _ = angularAmplification (orderedAngles nodes hn) := by
      unfold angularAmplification amplification
      rw [hcoordinates]
    _ = gapHeightMaximum (orderedAngles nodes hn) hsize :=
      angularAmplification_eq_gapHeightMaximum _ hsize

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.one_lt_amplification_of_two_le
statement:
lemma one_lt_amplification_of_two_le (nodes : NodeFamily n) (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 < amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := by omega
  rw [amplification_eq_ordered_gapHeightMaximum nodes hn hsize]
  exact one_lt_gapHeightMaximum _ hsize

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex_subtype
statement:
lemma isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex_subtype {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    IsCompact {u : angularParameterDomain d | u.val ∈ shrunkenAngularSimplex d ε}
proof:
:= by
  apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.isInducing.isCompact_preimage'
    (isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex hε)
  intro u hu
  exact ⟨⟨u, shrunkenAngularSimplex_subset_domain hε hu⟩, rfl⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isCompact_preimage_heightDifferenceMap
statement:
theorem isCompact_preimage_heightDifferenceMap (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    {K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    IsCompact (heightDifferenceMap hsize ⁻¹' K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hnorm⟩ := hK.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  let ε := heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / (1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R)
  have hε : 0 < ε := heightDifferenceBoundaryMargin_pos d R hR.le
  apply (isCompact_shrunkenAngularSimplex_subtype hε).of_isClosed_subset
    (hK.isClosed.preimage (continuous_heightDifferenceMap hsize))
  intro u hu cut
  exact parameterGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le hsize u.val u.property R hR.le
    (hnorm (heightDifferenceMap hsize u) hu) cut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isProperMap_heightDifferenceMap
statement:
theorem isProperMap_heightDifferenceMap (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    IsProperMap (heightDifferenceMap hsize)
proof:
:= by
  apply isProperMap_iff_isCompact_preimage.mpr
  exact ⟨continuous_heightDifferenceMap hsize,
    fun _ hK => isCompact_preimage_heightDifferenceMap hsize hK⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isCoveringMap_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper
statement:
theorem isCoveringMap_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper
    {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [T2Space E] [T2Space X] {f : E → X}
    (hloc : IsLocalHomeomorph f) (hproper : IsProperMap f) :
    IsCoveringMap f
proof:
:= by
  apply isCoveringMap_iff_isCoveringMapOn_univ.mpr
  apply hproper.isClosedMap.isCoveringMapOn_of_isLocalHomeomorphOn
  · intro x _
    have hdisc : IsDiscrete (f ⁻¹' {x}) :=
      IsDiscrete.of_openPartialHomeomorph f Set.Subset.rfl fun e _ ↦ by
        obtain ⟨φ, heφ, hφ⟩ := hloc e
        exact ⟨φ, heφ, hφ.symm⟩
    exact (hproper.isCompact_preimage isCompact_singleton).finite hdisc
  · intro e _
    obtain ⟨φ, heφ, hφ⟩ := hloc e
    exact ⟨φ, heφ, hφ⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isHomeomorph_of_surjective_covering
statement:
theorem isHomeomorph_of_surjective_covering
    {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PreconnectedSpace E] [Nonempty X]
    [SimplyConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {f : E → X} (hcover : IsCoveringMap f) (hsurj : Surjective f) :
    IsHomeomorph f
proof:
:= by
  let x₀ : X := Classical.arbitrary X
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := hsurj x₀
  let fid : C(X, X) := ContinuousMap.id X
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ :=
    hcover.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts fid x₀ e₀ (by simpa [fid] using he₀)
  obtain ⟨hs₀, hfs⟩ := hs
  have hsf : (s : X → E) ∘ f = id := by
    refine hcover.eq_of_comp_eq
      (s.continuous.comp hcover.continuous) continuous_id ?_ e₀ ?_
    · funext e
      have hright := congrFun hfs (f e)
      simpa [fid, Function.comp_def] using hright
    · simpa [he₀] using hs₀
  rw [isHomeomorph_iff_exists_inverse]
  refine ⟨hcover.continuous, s, ?_, ?_, s.continuous⟩
  · intro e
    exact congrFun hsf e
  · intro x
    have hright := congrFun hfs x
    simpa [fid, Function.comp_def] using hright

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.euclideanTarget_isHomeomorph_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper
statement:
theorem euclideanTarget_isHomeomorph_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper
    {E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [T2Space E]
    [PreconnectedSpace E] [Nonempty E] {d : ℕ} {f : E → Fin d → ℝ}
    (hloc : IsLocalHomeomorph f) (hproper : IsProperMap f) :
    IsHomeomorph f
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : IsCoveringMap f := isCoveringMap_of_localHomeomorph_of_proper hloc hproper
  have hrangeOpen : IsOpen (Set.range f) := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using hloc.isOpenMap Set.univ isOpen_univ
  have hrangeClosed : IsClosed (Set.range f) := hproper.isClosed_range
  have hrangeNonempty : (Set.range f).Nonempty :=
    ⟨f (Classical.arbitrary E), Classical.arbitrary E, rfl⟩
  have hrange : Set.range f = Set.univ :=
    IsClopen.eq_univ ⟨hrangeClosed, hrangeOpen⟩ hrangeNonempty
  exact isHomeomorph_of_surjective_covering hcover (Set.range_eq_univ.mp hrange)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineCardinal_shift
statement:
lemma sineCardinal_shift (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    sineCardinal (shiftedAngles θ a) j (t + a) = sineCardinal θ j t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedAngles sineCardinal
  simp only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_shift
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_shift (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant (shiftedAngles θ a) c (t + a) = sineInterpolant θ c t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  simp only [sineCardinal_shift]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolantDerivative_shift
statement:
lemma sineInterpolantDerivative_shift (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolantDerivative (shiftedAngles θ a) c (t + a) =
      sineInterpolantDerivative θ c t
proof:
:= by
  have hl := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant (shiftedAngles θ a) c (t + a)).comp t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const a)
  have hr := hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ c t
  have heq : (fun u => sineInterpolant (shiftedAngles θ a) c (u + a)) =
      sineInterpolant θ c := funext (sineInterpolant_shift θ c a)
  simp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, mul_one] at hl
  rw [heq] at hl
  exact hl.unique hr

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant_shift
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant_shift (θ c : Fin n → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant (shiftedAngles θ a) c) (t + a) =
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_sineInterpolant, deriv_sineInterpolant, sineInterpolantDerivative_shift]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineWronskian_shift
statement:
lemma sineWronskian_shift (θ d c : Fin n → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian (shiftedAngles θ a) d c (t + a) = sineWronskian θ d c t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineWronskian
  rw [sineInterpolant_shift, sineInterpolant_shift,
    deriv_sineInterpolant_shift, deriv_sineInterpolant_shift]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.dense_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero
statement:
lemma dense_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero (r : ℝ) :
    Dense {a : ℝ | Real.cos ((r + a) / 2) ≠ 0}
proof:
:=
  dense_cos_half_ne_zero.preimage (isOpenMap_add_left r)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isOpen_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero
statement:
lemma isOpen_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero (r : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {a : ℝ | Real.cos ((r + a) / 2) ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  exact isOpen_ne_fun
    (Real.continuous_cos.comp ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).div_const 2))
    continuous_const

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, ∀ i, Real.cos ((r i + a) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let chart : Fin m → Set ℝ := fun i => {a | Real.cos ((r i + a) / 2) ≠ 0}
  have hdense : Dense (⋂ i, chart i) := by
    rw [← Set.sInter_range]
    apply (Set.finite_range chart).dense_sInter
    · rintro s ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact isOpen_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero (r i)
    · rintro s ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact dense_shifted_cos_half_ne_zero (r i)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hdense.nonempty
  exact ⟨a, fun i => Set.mem_iInter.mp ha i⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero_roots_and_point
statement:
lemma exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero_roots_and_point {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, Real.cos ((t + a) / 2) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i, Real.cos ((r i + a) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_shift_cos_half_ne_zero (Fin.cons t r)
  exact ⟨a, by simpa using ha 0, fun i => by simpa using ha i.succ⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.shifted_tan_half_injective
statement:
lemma shifted_tan_half_injective {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective r) (hbound : ∀ i, r i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (a : ℝ) (hcos : ∀ i, Real.cos ((r i + a) / 2) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => Real.tan ((r i + a) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j htan
  have hexp := circle_exp_two_mul_eq_of_tan_eq
    ((r i + a) / 2) ((r j + a) / 2) (hcos i) (hcos j) htan
  have hi : 2 * ((r i + a) / 2) = r i + a := by ring
  have hj : 2 * ((r j + a) / 2) = r j + a := by ring
  rw [hi, hj, Circle.exp_add, Circle.exp_add] at hexp
  apply hinj
  exact Circle.exp_injOn_Ico (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (by simp)
    (hbound i) (hbound j) (mul_right_cancel hexp)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.StrictIntervalPeak.isLocalMax
statement:
lemma StrictIntervalPeak.isLocalMax {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b peak : ℝ}
    (hpeak : StrictIntervalPeak f a b peak) : IsLocalMax f peak
proof:
:=
  hpeak.isMaxOn.isLocalMax (Icc_mem_nhds hpeak.mem_Ioo.1 hpeak.mem_Ioo.2)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.StrictIntervalPeak.lt_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hpeak.isMaxOn hx)
  intro heq
  exact hne ((hpeak.eq_iff x hx).mp heq)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.StrictIntervalPeak.second_deriv_neg
proof:
:=
  second_deriv_neg_of_localMax hpeak.isLocalMax
    (hcont.continuousAt (Icc_mem_nhds hpeak.mem_Ioo.1 hpeak.mem_Ioo.2))
    hpeak.hasDerivAt_zero.deriv hne

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.strict_interval_peak_of_unique_critical
statement:
theorem strict_interval_peak_of_unique_critical {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b peak level : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b))
    (ha : f a = level) (hb : f b = level)
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f x = 0 → x = peak)
    (hovershoot : ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, level < f x) :
    StrictIntervalPeak f a b peak ∧ level < f peak
proof:
:= by
  have hinterior (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hxlevel : level < f x) :
      x ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by
    have hxa : x ≠ a := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, ha] at hxlevel
      exact (lt_irrefl _) hxlevel
    have hxb : x ≠ b := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, hb] at hxlevel
      exact (lt_irrefl _) hxlevel
    exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hx.1 hxa.symm, lt_of_le_of_ne hx.2 hxb⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
    (show (Set.Icc a b).Nonempty from ⟨a, le_rfl, hab.le⟩) hcont
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxlevel⟩ := hovershoot
  have hmlevel : level < f m := hxlevel.trans_le (hmax (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx))
  have hminterior := hinterior m hm hmlevel
  have hmlocal := hmax.isLocalMax (Icc_mem_nhds hminterior.1 hminterior.2)
  have hmdiff := hdiff.differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hminterior.1 hminterior.2)
  have hmzero : deriv f m = 0 := hmlocal.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hmdiff.hasDerivAt
  have hmpeak := hunique m hminterior hmzero
  subst m
  refine ⟨⟨hminterior, ?_, hmax, ?_⟩, hmlevel⟩
  · simpa only [hmzero] using hmdiff.hasDerivAt
  · intro y hy
    constructor
    · intro hyeq
      have hylevel : level < f y := by rwa [hyeq]
      have hyinterior := hinterior y hy hylevel
      have hymax : IsMaxOn f (Set.Icc a b) y := by
        intro z hz
        rw [hyeq]
        exact hmax hz
      have hylocal := hymax.isLocalMax (Icc_mem_nhds hyinterior.1 hyinterior.2)
      have hydiff := hdiff.differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds hyinterior.1 hyinterior.2)
      exact hunique y hyinterior (hylocal.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hydiff.hasDerivAt)
    · rintro rfl
      rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.strict_gap_peak_of_unique_critical
statement:
theorem strict_gap_peak_of_unique_critical {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b peak : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b))
    (ha : f a = 1) (hb : f b = 1)
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f x = 0 → x = peak)
    (hovershoot : ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 1 < f x) :
    StrictIntervalPeak f a b peak ∧ 1 < f peak
proof:
:=
  strict_interval_peak_of_unique_critical hab hcont hdiff ha hb hunique hovershoot

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineFactor_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sineFactor_eval (a x : ℝ) :
    (sineFactor a).eval x = Real.cos a * x - Real.sin a
proof:
:= by
  simp [sineFactor]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineFactor_natDegree_le
statement: theorem sineFactor_natDegree_le (a : ℝ) : (sineFactor a).natDegree ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
  apply max_le
  · simpa only [pow_one] using
      (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le (Real.cos a) 1)
  · simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_mul_sineFactor_eval_tan
statement:
theorem cos_mul_sineFactor_eval_tan (a t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos t ≠ 0) :
    Real.cos t * (sineFactor a).eval (Real.tan t) = Real.sin (t - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineFactor_eval, Real.sin_sub, ← Real.tan_mul_cos ht]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineProductPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem sineProductPolynomial_natDegree_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (sineProductPolynomial s a).natDegree ≤ s.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineProductPolynomial
  calc
    (∏ i ∈ s, sineFactor (a i)).natDegree ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s, (sineFactor (a i)).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le s _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ s, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _hi => sineFactor_natDegree_le (a i)
    _ = s.card := by simp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cos_pow_mul_sineProductPolynomial_eval_tan
statement:
theorem cos_pow_mul_sineProductPolynomial_eval_tan {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.cos t ≠ 0) :
    Real.cos t ^ s.card * (sineProductPolynomial s a).eval (Real.tan t) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, Real.sin (t - a i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sineProductPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  rw [← Finset.prod_const, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  exact cos_mul_sineFactor_eval_tan (a i) t ht

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_tan_normalized
statement:
private theorem hasDerivAt_tan_normalized {t : ℝ} (ht : Real.cos t ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt Real.tan (1 + Real.tan t ^ 2) t
proof:
:= by
  apply (Real.hasDerivAt_tan ht).congr_deriv
  rw [one_div, ← Real.inv_one_add_tan_sq ht, inv_inv]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_cos_pow
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).pow p).congr_deriv
  cases p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ,
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [← Real.tan_mul_cos ht]
      ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_cosineWeighted
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_cosineWeighted (p : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : Real.cos t ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (cosineWeighted p P)
      (Real.cos t ^ p * (cayleyOperator p P).eval (Real.tan t)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly := (P.hasDerivAt (Real.tan t)).comp t (hasDerivAt_tan_normalized ht)
  have hprod := (hasDerivAt_cos_pow p ht).mul hpoly
  have hrate :
      (-(p : ℝ) * Real.tan t * Real.cos t ^ p) * P.eval (Real.tan t) +
          Real.cos t ^ p * (P.derivative.eval (Real.tan t) * (1 + Real.tan t ^ 2)) =
        Real.cos t ^ p * (cayleyOperator p P).eval (Real.tan t) := by
    rw [cayleyOperator_eval]
    ring
  unfold cosineWeighted
  convert! hprod.congr_deriv hrate using 1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.exists_node_or_gap
statement:
lemma CyclicAngles.exists_node_or_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    (∃ i, t = angles.angle i) ∨
      (∃ cut : Fin n, ∃ hcut : 0 < cut.val, t ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut) ∨
      t ∈ wrapGap angles
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => angles.angle i ≤ t)
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [angles.first_eq_zero]
    exact ht.1
  let i : Fin n := s.max' hs
  have himem : i ∈ s := Finset.max'_mem s hs
  have hi : angles.angle i ≤ t := (Finset.mem_filter.mp himem).2
  by_cases heq : t = angles.angle i
  · exact Or.inl ⟨i, heq⟩
  · have hilower : angles.angle i < t := lt_of_le_of_ne hi (Ne.symm heq)
    by_cases hnext : i.val + 1 < n
    · let cut : Fin n := ⟨i.val + 1, hnext⟩
      have hcut : 0 < cut.val := by dsimp [cut]; omega
      have hpred : gapPredecessor cut = i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [gapPredecessor, cut]
      have hupper : t < angles.angle cut := by
        by_contra h
        have hcutmem : cut ∈ s :=
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, not_lt.mp h⟩
        have hle : cut ≤ i := Finset.le_max' s cut hcutmem
        change i.val + 1 ≤ i.val at hle
        omega
      apply Or.inr
      apply Or.inl
      refine ⟨cut, hcut, ?_⟩
      change t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut)
      rw [hpred]
      exact ⟨hilower, hupper⟩
    · have hilast : i = lastNodeIndex hn := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hi_lt := i.isLt
        change i.val = n - 1
        omega
      apply Or.inr
      apply Or.inr
      change t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (2 * Real.pi)
      rw [hilast] at hilower
      exact ⟨hilower, ht.2⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootLocation_not_mem_anchor_interval
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootLocation_not_mem_anchor_interval (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) (hki : k ≠ i) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k t) :
    t ∉ Set.Ioc (angles.angle (gapPredecessor i)) (angles.angle i)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  unfold crossDifferenceRootLocation at ht
  split_ifs at ht with hmiddle
  · have hipred : i ≤ gapPredecessor k := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hmiddle.1
    have hile : angles.angle i ≤ angles.angle (gapPredecessor k) :=
      angles.strictMono.monotone hipred
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hmem.2) (hile.trans_lt ht.1)
  · have hkval : k.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hki (Fin.ext h)
    by_cases hki' : k < i
    · have hkpred : k ≤ gapPredecessor i := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hki'
      have hupper : t ≤ angles.angle (gapPredecessor i) := by
        rw [ht]
        exact angles.strictMono.monotone hkpred
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hupper) hmem.1
    · have hik : i < k := by change i.val < k.val; change ¬k.val < i.val at hki'; omega
      have hgreater : angles.angle i < t := by rw [ht]; exact angles.strictMono hik
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hmem.2) hgreater

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut_values
statement:
lemma crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut_values (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (gapPredecessor i)) = 0 ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (gapPredecessor i)) = 2 ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (angles.angle i) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : gapPredecessor i < i := by change i.val - 1 < i.val; omega
  constructor
  · exact crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j (gapPredecessor i)
      hij.le (Or.inl hpred)
  constructor
  · rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j (gapPredecessor i)
      hij.le (Or.inl hpred), gapCoefficient_at_predecessor i hi]
    norm_num
  · rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_inside angles i j i hij.le le_rfl hij,
      gapCoefficient_at_cut]
    norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut
statement:
theorem crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    0 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (gapPredecessor i)) *
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (angles.angle (gapPredecessor i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_ordered_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  have hP := crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero angles i j hij
  obtain ⟨hz, hsum, hsample⟩ := crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut_values angles i j hij hi
  have hpredbound : angles.angle (gapPredecessor i) ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨angles.nonneg _, angles.lt_two_pi _⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) hP
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _)
    (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
    (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hmono.injective hbound hroot
    _ hpredbound hz
  have hpred : gapPredecessor i < i := by change i.val - 1 < i.val; omega
  have hsign := sineInterpolant_deriv_mul_pos_of_next_sample angles.angle
    (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) hP root hmono.injective hbound hroot r
    (angles.angle i) ⟨angles.nonneg i, angles.lt_two_pi i⟩
    (by rw [hr]; exact angles.strictMono hpred) (by
      intro k
      rw [hr]
      exact crossDifferenceRootLocation_not_mem_anchor_interval angles i j
        (crossDifferenceRootIndex i k) (crossDifferenceRootIndex_ne_cut i k) (hloc k))
  rw [hr, hsample] at hsign
  rw [hsum, mul_comm]
  exact hsign

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gapCoefficient_zero_cut_at_last
statement:
lemma gapCoefficient_zero_cut_at_last (hn : 0 < n) :
    gapCoefficient (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (lastNodeIndex hn) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := wrapCoefficient_eq_phaseSign_mul_gapCoefficient hn (lastNodeIndex hn)
  rw [wrapCoefficient_at_last] at h
  have hsq : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  calc
    gapCoefficient (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (lastNodeIndex hn) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)) *
        gapCoefficient (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (lastNodeIndex hn) := by rw [hsq, one_mul]
    _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * gapCoefficient (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (lastNodeIndex hn)) := by
      ring
    _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) := by rw [← h, mul_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut_values
statement:
lemma crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut_values (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : i.val = 0) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) = 0 ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) = 2 * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (2 * Real.pi) =
        2 * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hieq : i = (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) := Fin.ext hi
  have hjlast : j ≤ lastNodeIndex hn := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt j.isLt
  constructor
  · exact crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j (lastNodeIndex hn)
      hij.le (Or.inr hjlast)
  constructor
  · rw [crossSumInterpolant_at_node_outside angles i j (lastNodeIndex hn)
      hij.le (Or.inr hjlast), hieq, gapCoefficient_zero_cut_at_last]
  · have hfirst : sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) 0 = 2 := by
      rw [← angles.first_eq_zero, ← hieq,
        crossDifferenceInterpolant_at_node_inside angles i j i hij.le le_rfl hij,
        gapCoefficient_at_cut]
      norm_num
    have h := sineInterpolant_add_two_pi angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) 0
    rw [zero_add, hfirst] at h
    rw [h, mul_comm]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_last
statement:
lemma crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_last (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j k : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : crossDifferenceRootLocation angles i j k t) :
    t ≤ angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)
proof:
:=
  (crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_angle angles i j k ht).trans
    (angles.strictMono.monotone (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt k.isLt))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut
statement:
theorem crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (hi : i.val = 0) :
    0 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) *
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_crossDifference_ordered_roots_with_locations angles i j hij
  have hP := crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero angles i j hij
  obtain ⟨hz, hsum, hsample⟩ := crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut_values angles i j hij hi
  have hlastbound : angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn) ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    ⟨angles.nonneg _, angles.lt_two_pi _⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) hP
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _)
    (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
    (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hmono.injective hbound hroot
    _ hlastbound hz
  have hdne : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
      (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact deriv_sineInterpolant_ne_zero_of_saturated_roots angles.angle
      (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) hP root hmono.injective hbound hroot r
  have hsample_ne : sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
      (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hsample]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
  have hnozero : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn)) (2 * Real.pi),
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht hzero
    by_cases hlt : t < 2 * Real.pi
    · have htbound : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        ⟨(angles.nonneg _).trans ht.1.le, hlt⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
        (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) hP
        (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _)
        (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
        (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hmono.injective hbound hroot t htbound hzero
      have hupper := crossDifferenceRootLocation_le_last angles i j
        (crossDifferenceRootIndex i k) (hloc k)
      rw [hk] at hupper
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hupper) ht.1
    · have heq : t = 2 * Real.pi := le_antisymm ht.2 (le_of_not_gt hlt)
      rw [heq] at hzero
      exact hsample_ne hzero
  have hsign := hasDerivAt_mul_sample_pos_of_zero_free_right
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (angles.lt_two_pi (lastNodeIndex hn))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)).continuousOn
    hz ((differentiable_sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
      (angles.angle (lastNodeIndex hn))).hasDerivAt) hdne hnozero
  rw [hsample] at hsign
  rw [hsum, mul_comm]
  exact hsign

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_is_root
statement:
theorem crossResidueAnchor_is_root (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)
      (angles.angle (crossResidueAnchorIndex hn i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · rw [crossResidueAnchorIndex, if_pos hi]
    exact (crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut_values angles i j hij hi).1
  · rw [crossResidueAnchorIndex, if_neg hi]
    exact (crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut_values angles i j hij (by omega)).1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_pos
statement:
theorem crossResidueAnchor_pos (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    0 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
        (angles.angle (crossResidueAnchorIndex hn i)) *
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
        (angles.angle (crossResidueAnchorIndex hn i))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · rw [crossResidueAnchorIndex, if_pos hi]
    exact crossResidueAnchor_zero_cut angles i j hij hi
  · rw [crossResidueAnchorIndex, if_neg hi]
    exact crossResidueAnchor_positive_cut angles i j hij (by omega)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_sum_ne_zero
statement:
lemma crossResidueAnchor_sum_ne_zero (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) :
    sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j)
      (angles.angle (crossResidueAnchorIndex hn i)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := crossResidueAnchor_pos angles i j hij
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at h
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossResidueAnchor_in_root_list
statement:
theorem crossResidueAnchor_in_root_list (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i < j) (root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective root) (hbound : ∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hroot : ∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (root k) = 0) :
    ∃ k, root k = angles.angle (crossResidueAnchorIndex hn i) ∧
      0 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossSumCoefficient i j) (root k) *
        deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) (root k)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := crossDifferencePolynomial_ne_zero angles i j hij
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := cayley_chart_root_mem_of_saturated_roots (n - 1)
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j))
    (interpolantPolynomial angles.angle (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) hP
    (interpolantPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _)
    (cos_pow_mul_interpolantPolynomial_eval_tan _ _)
    (interpolantPolynomial_coeff_top _ _) root hinj hbound hroot
    _ ⟨angles.nonneg _, angles.lt_two_pi _⟩ (crossResidueAnchor_is_root angles i j hij)
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  exact crossResidueAnchor_pos angles i j hij

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_crossDifferenceInterpolant
statement:
lemma deriv_crossDifferenceInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j)) t =
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i)) t -
        crossGapPhase i j * deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) t).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) t).const_mul (crossGapPhase i j))
  have heq : sineInterpolant θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) =
      (fun u => sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) u -
        crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) u) :=
    funext (crossDifferenceInterpolant_identity θ i j)
  change HasDerivAt (fun u => sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) u -
    crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) u)
    (sineInterpolantDerivative θ (gapCoefficient i) t -
      crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolantDerivative θ (gapCoefficient j) t) t at h
  rw [← heq] at h
  simpa only [deriv_sineInterpolant] using h.deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_crossSumInterpolant
statement:
lemma deriv_crossSumInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ (crossSumCoefficient i j)) t =
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i)) t +
        crossGapPhase i j * deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j)) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) t).add
    ((hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) t).const_mul (crossGapPhase i j))
  have heq : sineInterpolant θ (crossSumCoefficient i j) =
      (fun u => sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) u +
        crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) u) :=
    funext (crossSumInterpolant_identity θ i j)
  change HasDerivAt (fun u => sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) u +
    crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j) u)
    (sineInterpolantDerivative θ (gapCoefficient i) t +
      crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolantDerivative θ (gapCoefficient j) t) t at h
  rw [← heq] at h
  simpa only [deriv_sineInterpolant] using h.deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossWronskian_eq
statement:
lemma crossWronskian_eq (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (crossSumCoefficient i j) t =
      2 * crossGapPhase i j * sineWronskian θ (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineWronskian
  rw [crossDifferenceInterpolant_identity, crossSumInterpolant_identity,
    deriv_crossDifferenceInterpolant, deriv_crossSumInterpolant]
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossWronskian_neg_iff
statement:
lemma crossWronskian_neg_iff (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sineWronskian θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (crossSumCoefficient i j) t < 0 ↔
      crossGapPhase i j * sineWronskian θ (gapCoefficient i) (gapCoefficient j) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossWronskian_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGap_critical_derivative_orientation
statement:
lemma crossGap_critical_derivative_orientation (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hW : sineWronskian θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (crossSumCoefficient i j) t < 0)
    (hcritical : deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i)) t = 0) :
    crossGapPhase i j * sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i) t *
      deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j)) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (crossWronskian_neg_iff θ i j t).mp hW
  simpa only [sineWronskian, hcritical, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_assoc] using h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.crossGap_no_common_critical
statement:
lemma crossGap_no_common_critical (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hW : sineWronskian θ (crossDifferenceCoefficient i j) (crossSumCoefficient i j) t < 0)
    (hcritical : deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient i)) t = 0) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ (gapCoefficient j)) t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := crossGap_critical_derivative_orientation θ i j t hW hcritical
  rw [hzero, mul_zero] at h
  exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ)) h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_zero_between_opposite_values
statement:
private lemma exists_zero_between_opposite_values (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hopposite : f b = -f a) (hne : f a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo a b ∧ f t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
  · have hright : 0 < f b := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hneg, hright⟩
  · have hright : f b < 0 := by rw [hopposite]; linarith
    exact intermediate_value_Ioo' hab.le hf.continuousOn ⟨hright, hpos⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_other_gap
statement:
lemma exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_other_gap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (cut l : Fin n) (hl : 0 < l.val) (hlcut : l ≠ cut) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ ordinaryGap angles l hl ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : (gapPredecessor l).val + 1 = l.val := by
    change l.val - 1 + 1 = l.val
    omega
  have hlt : gapPredecessor l < l := by
    show l.val - 1 < l.val
    omega
  apply exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
    (angles.strictMono hlt)
  · rw [gapInterpolant_at_node, gapInterpolant_at_node]
    exact gapCoefficient_consecutive_flip cut (gapPredecessor l) l hpred hlcut
  · rw [gapInterpolant_at_node]
    rcases gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one cut (gapPredecessor l) with h | h <;>
      rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_wrapGap
statement:
lemma exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_wrapGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ wrapGap angles ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) 0 =
      gapCoefficient cut (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) := by
    rw [← angles.first_eq_zero, gapInterpolant_at_node]
  have htwo : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) (2 * Real.pi) =
      -gapCoefficient cut (lastNodeIndex hn) := by
    have h := sineInterpolant_add_two_pi angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) 0
    rw [zero_add, hzero, gapCoefficient_wrap_flip hn cut hcut] at h
    exact h
  apply exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
    (angles.lt_two_pi (lastNodeIndex hn))
  · rw [htwo, gapInterpolant_at_node]
  · rw [gapInterpolant_at_node]
    rcases gapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one cut (lastNodeIndex hn) with h | h <;>
      rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_wrapInterpolant_zero_on_ordinaryGap
statement:
lemma exists_wrapInterpolant_zero_on_ordinaryGap (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (l : Fin n) (hl : 0 < l.val) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ ordinaryGap angles l hl ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : (gapPredecessor l).val + 1 = l.val := by
    change l.val - 1 + 1 = l.val
    omega
  have hlt : gapPredecessor l < l := by
    show l.val - 1 < l.val
    omega
  apply exists_zero_between_opposite_values
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient)
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient)
    (angles.strictMono hlt)
  · rw [wrapInterpolant_at_node, wrapInterpolant_at_node]
    exact wrapCoefficient_consecutive_flip hn (gapPredecessor l) l hpred
  · rw [wrapInterpolant_at_node]
    rcases wrapCoefficient_eq_one_or_neg_one (gapPredecessor l) with h | h <;>
      rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGapRight_le_two_pi
statement:
private lemma cyclicGapRight_le_two_pi (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (j : Fin n) :
    cyclicGapRight angles j ≤ 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicGapRight
  split_ifs with hj
  · exact (angles.lt_two_pi _).le
  · exact le_rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicGapRight_le_angle
statement:
private lemma cyclicGapRight_le_angle (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    {j l : Fin n} (hjl : j < l) : cyclicGapRight angles j ≤ angles.angle l
proof:
:= by
  have hval : j.val < l.val := hjl
  have hj : j.val + 1 < n := by have := l.isLt; omega
  rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hj]
  exact angles.strictMono.monotone (show (⟨j.val + 1, hj⟩ : Fin n) ≤ l from hjl)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.ordered_roots_from_cyclic_gaps
statement:
private lemma ordered_roots_from_cyclic_gaps (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (index : Fin (n - 1) → Fin n) (hindex : StrictMono index)
    (hz : ∀ k, ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (index k))
      (cyclicGapRight angles (index k)) ∧ f t = 0) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (index k))
        (cyclicGapRight angles (index k))) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧ (∀ k, f (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (hz k)
  have hspec (k : Fin (n - 1)) : root k ∈
      Set.Ioo (angles.angle (index k)) (cyclicGapRight angles (index k)) ∧
      f (root k) = 0 := Classical.choose_spec (hz k)
  refine ⟨root, ?_, fun k => (hspec k).1, ?_, fun k => (hspec k).2⟩
  · intro k l hkl
    exact ((hspec k).1.2.trans_le (cyclicGapRight_le_angle angles (hindex hkl))).trans
      (hspec l).1.1
  · intro k
    exact ⟨(angles.nonneg (index k)).trans (hspec k).1.1.le,
      (hspec k).1.2.trans_le (cyclicGapRight_le_two_pi angles (index k))⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.otherGapIndex_strictMono
statement: private lemma otherGapIndex_strictMono (cut : Fin n) : StrictMono (otherGapIndex cut)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl
  change (if k.val < cut.val - 1 then k.val else k.val + 1) <
    (if l.val < cut.val - 1 then l.val else l.val + 1)
  have hval : k.val < l.val := hkl
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.otherGapIndex_next_ne_cut
statement:
private lemma otherGapIndex_next_ne_cut (cut : Fin n) (k : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (otherGapIndex cut k).val + 1 ≠ cut.val
proof:
:= by
  change (if k.val < cut.val - 1 then k.val else k.val + 1) + 1 ≠ cut.val
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations
    (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (otherGapIndex cut k))
        (cyclicGapRight angles (otherGapIndex cut k))) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply ordered_roots_from_cyclic_gaps angles
    (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
    (otherGapIndex cut) (otherGapIndex_strictMono cut)
  intro k
  let j : Fin n := otherGapIndex cut k
  by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < n
  · let l : Fin n := ⟨j.val + 1, hj⟩
    have hl : 0 < l.val := by dsimp only [l]; omega
    have hlcut : l ≠ cut := by
      intro heq
      have heqval := congrArg Fin.val heq
      exact otherGapIndex_next_ne_cut cut k heqval
    have hpred : gapPredecessor l = j := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [gapPredecessor, l]
      omega
    have hright : cyclicGapRight angles j = angles.angle l := by
      rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hj]
    have hz := exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_other_gap angles cut l hl hlcut
    unfold ordinaryGap at hz
    rw [hpred, ← hright] at hz
    exact hz
  · have hjlast : j = lastNodeIndex hn := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change j.val = n - 1
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    have hright : cyclicGapRight angles j = 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_neg hj]
    change ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle j) (cyclicGapRight angles j) ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) t = 0
    rw [hright, hjlast]
    exact exists_gapInterpolant_zero_on_wrapGap angles cut hcut

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations
statement:
theorem exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations
    (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ioo
        (angles.angle ⟨k.val, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩)
        (angles.angle ⟨k.val + 1, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩)) ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let index : Fin (n - 1) → Fin n := fun k => ⟨k.val, by have := k.isLt; omega⟩
  have hindex : StrictMono index := by
    intro k l hkl
    exact hkl
  have hz : ∀ k, ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (angles.angle (index k))
      (cyclicGapRight angles (index k)) ∧
      sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient t = 0 := by
    intro k
    have hj : (index k).val + 1 < n := by have := k.isLt; dsimp only [index]; omega
    let l : Fin n := ⟨(index k).val + 1, hj⟩
    have hl : 0 < l.val := by dsimp only [l]; omega
    have hpred : gapPredecessor l = index k := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [gapPredecessor, l]
      omega
    have hright : cyclicGapRight angles (index k) = angles.angle l := by
      rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hj]
    have hzero := exists_wrapInterpolant_zero_on_ordinaryGap angles l hl
    unfold ordinaryGap at hzero
    rw [hpred, ← hright] at hzero
    exact hzero
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hlocations, hbounds, hroots⟩ :=
    ordered_roots_from_cyclic_gaps angles
      (sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient) index hindex hz
  refine ⟨root, hmono, ?_, hbounds, hroots⟩
  intro k
  have hj : k.val + 1 < n := by have := k.isLt; omega
  simpa only [index, cyclicGapRight, Fin.val_mk, dif_pos hj] using hlocations k

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros
statement:
theorem exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, _hlocations, hbounds, hroots⟩ :=
    exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize cut hcut
  exact ⟨root, hmono, hbounds, hroots⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros
statement:
theorem exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ root : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ, StrictMono root ∧
      (∀ k, root k ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ k, sineInterpolant angles.angle wrapCoefficient (root k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, _hlocations, hbounds, hroots⟩ :=
    exists_wrapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize
  exact ⟨root, hmono, hbounds, hroots⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cardinal_one
statement: lemma cardinal_one (z : Fin 1 → ℂ) (j : Fin 1) (w : ℂ) : cardinal z j w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp [cardinal, hj]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lebesgueFunction_one
statement: lemma lebesgueFunction_one (z : Fin 1 → ℂ) (w : ℂ) : lebesgueFunction z w = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [lebesgueFunction, cardinal_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_one
statement: lemma amplification_one (nodes : NodeFamily 1) : amplification nodes = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := amplification_attained nodes
  rw [hw, lebesgueFunction_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_one
statement: lemma isMinimizer_one (nodes : NodeFamily 1) : IsMinimizer nodes
proof:
:= by
  intro other
  simp [amplification_one]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isRegularRotation_one
statement: lemma isRegularRotation_one (nodes : NodeFamily 1) : IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nodes.point 0, Equiv.refl _, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp [hi, regularPoint]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimizer_iff_regular_one
statement:
lemma minimizer_iff_regular_one (nodes : NodeFamily 1) :
    IsMinimizer nodes ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => isRegularRotation_one nodes, fun _ => isMinimizer_one nodes⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.target_one
statement:
lemma target_one :
    (∃ nodes : NodeFamily 1, IsMinimizer nodes) ∧
      ∀ nodes : NodeFamily 1, IsMinimizer nodes ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨regularNodes 1 (by decide), isMinimizer_one _⟩, minimizer_iff_regular_one⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff_regular
statement:
theorem heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff_regular (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :
    heightDifferenceMap hsize u = 0 ↔ u.val = regularAngularParameters d
proof:
:= by
  let r : angularParameterDomain d :=
    ⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩
  have hr : heightDifferenceMap hsize r = 0 :=
    parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences_regular_eq_zero hsize
  constructor
  · intro hu
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (heightDifferenceMap_injective hsize (hu.trans hr.symm))
  · intro hu
    have hur : u = r := Subtype.ext hu
    exact hur ▸ hr

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.equal_parameterOrderedHeights_iff_regular
statement:
theorem equal_parameterOrderedHeights_iff_regular (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :
    (∀ i, parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u.val = parameterOrderedHeight hsize 0 u.val) ↔
      u.val = regularAngularParameters d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff, heightDifferenceMap_eq_zero_iff_regular]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimum_angularParameterAmplification_iff_regular
statement:
theorem minimum_angularParameterAmplification_iff_regular (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : angularParameterDomain d) :
    (∀ v : angularParameterDomain d,
      angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize v) ↔
        u.val = regularAngularParameters d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    exact (equal_parameterOrderedHeights_iff_regular hsize u).mp
      (equal_parameterOrderedHeights_of_minimum hsize u hmin)
  · intro hu
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_minimum_angularParameterAmplification hsize
    have hmreg := (equal_parameterOrderedHeights_iff_regular hsize m).mp
      (equal_parameterOrderedHeights_of_minimum hsize m hm)
    have hum : u = m := Subtype.ext (hu.trans hmreg.symm)
    exact hum ▸ hm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAmplification_regular
statement:
lemma angularParameterAmplification_regular (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    angularParameterAmplification hsize
      ⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩ =
        amplification (regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
proof:
:= by
  change amplification _ = _
  rw [regularAngularParameters_toNodeFamily]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAmplification_ordered
statement:
lemma angularParameterAmplification_ordered (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 1)) :
    angularParameterAmplification hsize
      ⟨(orderedAngles nodes (Nat.succ_pos d)).interiorParameters,
        (orderedAngles nodes (Nat.succ_pos d)).interiorParameters_mem_domain⟩ =
          amplification nodes
proof:
:= by
  change angularAmplification _ = _
  rw [cyclicAnglesOfParameters_interiorParameters, angularAmplification_orderedAngles]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_regularNodes_of_two_le
statement:
theorem isMinimizer_regularNodes_of_two_le (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) :
    IsMinimizer (regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
proof:
:= by
  have hmin := (minimum_angularParameterAmplification_iff_regular hsize
    ⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩).mpr rfl
  intro other
  have h := hmin
    ⟨(orderedAngles other (Nat.succ_pos d)).interiorParameters,
      (orderedAngles other (Nat.succ_pos d)).interiorParameters_mem_domain⟩
  rwa [angularParameterAmplification_regular, angularParameterAmplification_ordered] at h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isRegularRotation_of_isMinimizer_of_two_le
statement:
theorem isRegularRotation_of_isMinimizer_of_two_le (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 1)) (hmin : IsMinimizer nodes) : IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  let angles := orderedAngles nodes (Nat.succ_pos d)
  let u : angularParameterDomain d :=
    ⟨angles.interiorParameters, angles.interiorParameters_mem_domain⟩
  have hu : ∀ v : angularParameterDomain d,
      angularParameterAmplification hsize u ≤ angularParameterAmplification hsize v := by
    intro v
    have hleft : angularParameterAmplification hsize u = amplification nodes :=
      angularParameterAmplification_ordered hsize nodes
    rw [hleft]
    exact hmin (cyclicAnglesOfParameters v.val v.property).toNodeFamily
  have hreg : angles.interiorParameters = regularAngularParameters d :=
    (minimum_angularParameterAmplification_iff_regular hsize u).mp hu
  exact (isRegularRotation_orderedAngles_iff nodes (Nat.succ_pos d)).mp
    (angles.isRegularRotation_of_parameters_eq_regular hreg)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_of_isRegularRotation_of_two_le
statement:
theorem isMinimizer_of_isRegularRotation_of_two_le (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (nodes : NodeFamily (d + 1)) (hreg : IsRegularRotation nodes) : IsMinimizer nodes
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rotation, permutation, hpoints⟩ := hreg
  have heq : nodes =
      ((regularNodes (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)).reindex permutation).rotate rotation :=
    NodeFamily.eq_of_points_eq _ _ hpoints
  rw [heq, isMinimizer_rotate_iff, isMinimizer_reindex_iff]
  exact isMinimizer_regularNodes_of_two_le hsize

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimizer_iff_regular
statement:
theorem minimizer_iff_regular (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    IsMinimizer nodes ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ d =>
    by_cases hd : d = 0
    · subst d
      exact minimizer_iff_regular_one nodes
    · have hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1 := by omega
      exact ⟨isRegularRotation_of_isMinimizer_of_two_le hsize nodes,
        isMinimizer_of_isRegularRotation_of_two_le hsize nodes⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isMinimizer_regularNodes
statement: theorem isMinimizer_regularNodes (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : IsMinimizer (regularNodes n hn)
proof:
:=
  (minimizer_iff_regular n hn _).mpr (regularNodes_isRegularRotation n hn)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.unitCircleInterpolation_target
statement: theorem unitCircleInterpolation_target : Target
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  exact ⟨⟨regularNodes n hn, isMinimizer_regularNodes n hn⟩, minimizer_iff_regular n hn⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.complex_minimizer_iff_regular
statement:
theorem complex_minimizer_iff_regular (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1) (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    IsComplexMinimizer z ↔ IsComplexRegularRotation z
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplexMinimizer_ofCoordinates_iff z hunit hinj,
    isComplexRegularRotation_ofCoordinates_iff z hunit hinj]
  exact minimizer_iff_regular n hn _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.complexAmplification_regular_le
statement:
theorem complexAmplification_regular_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1) (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    complexAmplification (regularNodes n hn).coordinates ≤ complexAmplification z
proof:
:=
  isMinimizer_regularNodes n hn (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isOpen_phaseNodes_injective
statement:
lemma isOpen_phaseNodes_injective :
    IsOpen {θ : Fin n → ℝ | Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)}
proof:
:= by
  have hcont (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => phaseNodes θ i) := by
    unfold phaseNodes
    fun_prop
  have heq : {θ : Fin n → ℝ | Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)} =
      ⋂ i : Fin n, ⋂ j : Fin n,
        {θ : Fin n → ℝ | i = j ∨ phaseNodes θ i ≠ phaseNodes θ j} := by
    ext θ
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro h i j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · exact Or.inl hij
      · exact Or.inr (fun he => hij (h he))
    · intro h i j he
      rcases h i j with hij | hij
      · exact hij
      · exact (hij he).elim
  rw [heq]
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro i
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · simp only [hij, true_or, Set.ofPred_true]
    exact isOpen_univ
  · simp only [hij, false_or]
    exact isOpen_ne_fun (hcont i) (hcont j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isOpen_joint_phaseNodes_injective
statement:
lemma isOpen_joint_phaseNodes_injective :
    IsOpen {x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ | Function.Injective (phaseNodes x.1)}
proof:
:=
  isOpen_phaseNodes_injective.preimage continuous_fst

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.eventually_phaseNodes_injective_update
statement:
lemma eventually_phaseNodes_injective_update (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ∀ᶠ u in nhds (θ j), Function.Injective (phaseNodes (Function.update θ j u))
proof:
:= by
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ η in nhds θ, Function.Injective (phaseNodes η) :=
    isOpen_phaseNodes_injective.eventually_mem hθ
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ 0 (Function.update θ j) := contDiff_update 0 θ j
  have hcont : Continuous (Function.update θ j) := hsmooth.continuous
  have htendsto : Filter.Tendsto (Function.update θ j) (nhds (θ j)) (nhds θ) := by
    have ht : ContinuousAt (Function.update θ j) (θ j) := hcont.continuousAt
    change Filter.Tendsto (Function.update θ j) (nhds (θ j))
      (nhds (Function.update θ j (θ j))) at ht
    simpa only [Function.update_eq_self] using ht
  exact htendsto.eventually hevent

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiff_sine_denominator
statement:
lemma contDiff_sine_denominator (m : ℕ∞ω) (j k : Fin n) :
    ContDiff ℝ m (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => Real.sin ((θ j - θ k) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  exact (((contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j).sub (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k)).div_const 2).sin

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sine_ratio_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sine_ratio_joint (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (j k : Fin n) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((x.2 - x.1 k) / 2) / Real.sin ((x.1 j - x.1 k) / 2)) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => x.1 k) :=
    (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).comp contDiff_fst
  have hnum : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((x.2 - x.1 k) / 2)) :=
    ((contDiff_snd.sub hk).div_const 2).sin
  have hden : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      Real.sin ((x.1 j - x.1 k) / 2)) :=
    (contDiff_sine_denominator m j k).comp contDiff_fst
  exact hnum.contDiffAt.div hden.contDiffAt (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ hjk)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineCardinal_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineCardinal_joint (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (j : Fin n) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => sineCardinal x.1 j x.2) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinal
  apply contDiffAt_prod
  intro k hk
  exact contDiffAt_sine_ratio_joint m θ t hθ j k (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => sineInterpolant x.1 c x.2) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j hj
  exact contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_sineCardinal_joint m θ t hθ j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineCardinalDerivative_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineCardinalDerivative_joint (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) (j : Fin n) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      sineCardinalDerivative x.1 j x.2) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinalDerivative
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro k hk
  apply ContDiffAt.mul
  · apply contDiffAt_prod
    intro l hl
    exact contDiffAt_sine_ratio_joint m θ t hθ j l
      (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).2).1.symm
  · have hkcoord : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => x.1 k) :=
      (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).comp contDiff_fst
    have hnum : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        Real.cos ((x.2 - x.1 k) / 2) / 2) :=
      (((contDiff_snd.sub hkcoord).div_const 2).cos).div_const 2
    have hden : ContDiff ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        Real.sin ((x.1 j - x.1 k) / 2)) :=
      (contDiff_sine_denominator m j k).comp contDiff_fst
    exact hnum.contDiffAt.div hden.contDiffAt
      (sine_denominator_ne_zero θ hθ (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1.symm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineInterpolantDerivative_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineInterpolantDerivative_joint (m : ℕ∞ω)
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      sineInterpolantDerivative x.1 c x.2) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolantDerivative
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro j hj
  exact contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_sineCardinalDerivative_joint m θ t hθ j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_deriv_sineInterpolant_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_deriv_sineInterpolant_joint (m : ℕ∞ω)
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      deriv (sineInterpolant x.1 c) x.2) (θ, t)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [deriv_sineInterpolant] using
    contDiffAt_sineInterpolantDerivative_joint m θ t c hθ

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffOn_sineInterpolant_joint
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint m x.1 x.2 c hx).contDiffWithinAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffOn_deriv_sineInterpolant_joint
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (contDiffAt_deriv_sineInterpolant_joint m x.1 x.2 c hx).contDiffWithinAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_parameters
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_parameters (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => (η, t)) θ :=
    contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const
  have hjoint := contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint m θ t c hθ
  have hcomp := hjoint.comp θ hmap
  exact hcomp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_update
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_update (m : ℕ∞ω) (θ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (t : ℝ)
    (hθ : Function.Injective (phaseNodes θ)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun u : ℝ => sineInterpolant (Function.update θ j u) c t) (θ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ContDiff ℝ m (Function.update θ j) := contDiff_update m θ j
  have hbase : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun η : Fin n → ℝ => sineInterpolant η c t)
      (Function.update θ j (θ j)) := by
    simpa only [Function.update_eq_self] using
      contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_parameters m θ c t hθ
  have hcomp := hbase.comp (θ j) hmap.contDiffAt
  exact hcomp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngles_smul_add
statement:
lemma angularParameterAngles_smul_add (u v : Fin d → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    angularParameterAngles (a • u + b • v) =
      a • angularParameterAngles u + b • angularParameterAngles v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;>
    simp only [angularParameterAngles_zero, angularParameterAngles_succ,
      Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.convex_angularParameterDomain
statement: theorem convex_angularParameterDomain (d : ℕ) : Convex ℝ (angularParameterDomain d)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv a b ha hb hab
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    rw [angularParameterAngles_smul_add]
    change a * angularParameterAngles u i + b * angularParameterAngles v i <
      a * angularParameterAngles u j + b * angularParameterAngles v j
    by_cases ha' : 0 < a
    · exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hu.1 hij) ha')
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv.1 hij).le hb)
    · have hb' : 0 < b := by linarith
      exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu.1 hij).le ha)
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hv.1 hij) hb')
  · intro i
    exact (convex_Iio (2 * Real.pi)) (hu.2 i) (hv.2 i) ha hb hab

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isPreconnected_angularParameterDomain
statement:
theorem isPreconnected_angularParameterDomain (d : ℕ) :
    IsPreconnected (angularParameterDomain d)
proof:
:=
  (convex_angularParameterDomain d).isPreconnected

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngles_regular
statement:
lemma angularParameterAngles_regular (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    angularParameterAngles (regularAngularParameters d) i =
      2 * Real.pi * ((i.val : ℝ) / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp only [angularParameterAngles_zero, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero]
  · rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.regularAngularParameters_mem_domain
statement:
theorem regularAngularParameters_mem_domain (d : ℕ) :
    regularAngularParameters d ∈ angularParameterDomain d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    rw [angularParameterAngles_regular, angularParameterAngles_regular]
    apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)
    exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right (Nat.cast_lt.mpr hij)
      (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos d))
  · intro i
    exact (regular_angle_mem_Ico (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d) i.succ).2

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterDomain_nonempty
statement: theorem angularParameterDomain_nonempty (d : ℕ) : (angularParameterDomain d).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨regularAngularParameters d, regularAngularParameters_mem_domain d⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isConnected_angularParameterDomain
statement: theorem isConnected_angularParameterDomain (d : ℕ) : IsConnected (angularParameterDomain d)
proof:
:=
  (convex_angularParameterDomain d).isConnected (angularParameterDomain_nonempty d)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.coordinates_ofCoordinates
statement:
@[simp] lemma NodeFamily.coordinates_ofCoordinates (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1) (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj).coordinates = z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.NodeFamily.ofCoordinates_coordinates
statement:
@[simp] lemma NodeFamily.ofCoordinates_coordinates (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    NodeFamily.ofCoordinates nodes.coordinates nodes.norm_coordinates
      nodes.coordinates_injective = nodes
proof:
:= by
  cases nodes
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.complexAmplification_eq_sSup_image
statement:
lemma complexAmplification_eq_sSup_image (z : Fin n → ℂ) :
    complexAmplification z = sSup (lebesgueFunction z '' {w : ℂ | ‖w‖ = 1})
proof:
:= by
  unfold complexAmplification
  congr 1
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(w : ℂ), Circle.norm_coe w, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(⟨w, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hw⟩ : Circle), rfl⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.complexAmplification_coordinates
statement:
lemma complexAmplification_coordinates (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    complexAmplification nodes.coordinates = amplification nodes
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.amplification_ofCoordinates
statement:
lemma amplification_ofCoordinates (z : Fin n → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1)
    (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    amplification (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj) = complexAmplification z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isComplexMinimizer_coordinates_iff
statement:
lemma isComplexMinimizer_coordinates_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    IsComplexMinimizer nodes.coordinates ↔ IsMinimizer nodes
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h other
    exact h other.coordinates other.norm_coordinates other.coordinates_injective
  · intro h other hunit hinj
    exact h (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates other hunit hinj)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isComplexMinimizer_ofCoordinates_iff
statement:
lemma isComplexMinimizer_ofCoordinates_iff (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1) (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    IsComplexMinimizer z ↔ IsMinimizer (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj)
proof:
:=
  by simpa only [NodeFamily.coordinates_ofCoordinates] using
    isComplexMinimizer_coordinates_iff (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isComplexRegularRotation_coordinates_iff
statement:
lemma isComplexRegularRotation_coordinates_iff (nodes : NodeFamily n) :
    IsComplexRegularRotation nodes.coordinates ↔ IsRegularRotation nodes
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rotation, hunit, permutation, h⟩
    let r : Circle := ⟨rotation, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hunit⟩
    refine ⟨r, permutation, ?_⟩
    intro i
    apply Circle.coe_injective
    exact h i
  · rintro ⟨rotation, permutation, h⟩
    refine ⟨(rotation : ℂ), Circle.norm_coe rotation, permutation, ?_⟩
    intro i
    exact congrArg (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ)) (h i)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isComplexRegularRotation_ofCoordinates_iff
statement:
lemma isComplexRegularRotation_ofCoordinates_iff (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hunit : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1) (hinj : Function.Injective z) :
    IsComplexRegularRotation z ↔ IsRegularRotation (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj)
proof:
:=
  by simpa only [NodeFamily.coordinates_ofCoordinates] using
    isComplexRegularRotation_coordinates_iff (NodeFamily.ofCoordinates z hunit hinj)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient_pos
statement:
lemma heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient_pos (d : ℕ) :
    0 < heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos d)
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using
      (show ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) from Nat.cast_le.mpr (by omega))
  have havg : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hn
  have havg_le : 2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
    simpa only [mul_one] using h
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 4) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using
      sin_quarter_gap_pos 0 (2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) havg
        (by simpa only [sub_zero] using havg_le)
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (pow_pos hsin _)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.finiteHeightDifferences_parameterOrderedHeightMap
statement:
lemma finiteHeightDifferences_parameterOrderedHeightMap (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    finiteHeightDifferences (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize u) =
      parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u
proof: := rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameter_gapHeight_difference_le_two_dim_norm
statement:
lemma parameter_gapHeight_difference_le_two_dim_norm (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (large small : Fin (d + 1)) :
    gapHeight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize large -
        gapHeight (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) hsize small ≤
      2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := physicalGapCut_surjective (Nat.succ_pos d) large
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := physicalGapCut_surjective (Nat.succ_pos d) small
  have h := height_sub_le_two_dim_mul_norm (parameterOrderedHeightMap hsize u) i j
  rw [finiteHeightDifferences_parameterOrderedHeightMap] at h
  change parameterOrderedHeight hsize i u - parameterOrderedHeight hsize j u ≤ _ at h
  simpa only [parameterOrderedHeight_of_mem_domain u hu, orderedHeight, hi, hj] using h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimumGapWidth_reciprocal_le_adjacent_height_norm
statement:
theorem minimumGapWidth_reciprocal_le_adjacent_height_norm (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) :
    heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d /
        minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) - 1 ≤
      2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖
proof:
:= by
  let angles := cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu
  have hmin : 0 < minimumGapWidth angles := minimumGapWidth_pos angles
  have hn : 0 < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos d)
  have havg : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hn
  have hcoeff : 2 * Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 4) ^ ((d + 1) - 1) =
      heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d := by
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient]
  by_cases hsmall : minimumGapWidth angles ≤ heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d
  · obtain ⟨large, hlarge⟩ := exists_gapWidth_ge_average angles
    obtain ⟨small, heq⟩ := exists_gapWidth_eq_minimum angles
    have hgap : gapWidth angles small ≤
        2 * Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 4) ^ ((d + 1) - 1) := by
      rw [heq, hcoeff]
      exact hsmall
    have h := gapHeight_difference_lower_bound angles hsize large small
      (2 * Real.pi / ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) havg hlarge hgap
    rw [hcoeff, heq] at h
    exact h.trans (parameter_gapHeight_difference_le_two_dim_norm hsize u hu large small)
  · have hdiv : heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / minimumGapWidth angles ≤ 1 :=
      (div_le_one hmin).mpr (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hsmall))
    have hnorm : 0 ≤ 2 * (d : ℝ) * ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg d)) (norm_nonneg _)
    exact (sub_nonpos.mpr hdiv).trans hnorm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.heightDifferenceBoundaryMargin_pos
statement:
lemma heightDifferenceBoundaryMargin_pos (d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 < heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / (1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R)
proof:
:= by
  exact div_pos (heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient_pos d) (by positivity)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.minimumGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le
statement:
theorem minimumGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hnorm : ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖ ≤ R) :
    heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / (1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R) ≤
      minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minimumGapWidth_reciprocal_le_adjacent_height_norm hsize u hu
  have hm := minimumGapWidth_pos (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu)
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (d : ℝ))
  have hquot : heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d /
      minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) ≤ 1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R := by
    linarith
  have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp hquot
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R)).mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.parameterGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le
statement:
theorem parameterGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hnorm : ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖ ≤ R) (cut : Fin (d + 1)) :
    heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / (1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R) ≤
      parameterGapWidth cut u
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterGapWidth_of_mem_domain u hu]
  exact (minimumGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le hsize u hu R hR hnorm).trans
    (minimumGapWidth_le (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) cut)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.lt_adjacent_height_norm_of_minimumGapWidth_lt
statement:
theorem lt_adjacent_height_norm_of_minimumGapWidth_lt (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1)
    (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hwidth : minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu) <
      heightDifferenceBoundaryCoefficient d / (1 + 2 * (d : ℝ) * R)) :
    R < ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hnorm : ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize u‖ ≤ R := le_of_not_gt h
  exact (not_le_of_gt hwidth)
    (minimumGapWidth_lower_of_adjacent_height_norm_le hsize u hu R hR hnorm)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.adjacent_height_norm_tendsto_atTop_of_minimumGapWidth_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem adjacent_height_norm_tendsto_atTop_of_minimumGapWidth_tendsto_zero
    {α : Type*} (hsize : 2 ≤ d + 1) (u : α → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ a, u a ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (l : Filter α)
    (hwidth : Filter.Tendsto (fun a => minimumGapWidth (cyclicAnglesOfParameters (u a) (hu a)))
      l (nhds (0 : ℝ))) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun a => ‖parameterAdjacentHeightDifferences hsize (u a)‖)
      l Filter.atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro R
  have hR : 0 ≤ max R 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hmargin := heightDifferenceBoundaryMargin_pos d (max R 0) hR
  have hevent := hwidth.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hmargin)
  filter_upwards [hevent] with a ha
  exact (le_max_left R 0).trans
    (lt_adjacent_height_norm_of_minimumGapWidth_lt hsize (u a) (hu a) (max R 0) hR ha).le

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (sineInterpolant θ c) (sineInterpolantDerivative θ c t) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant sineInterpolantDerivative
  convert! HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) =>
    (hasDerivAt_sineCardinal θ j t).const_mul (c j)) using 1

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.differentiable_sineInterpolant
statement:
lemma differentiable_sineInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (sineInterpolant θ c)
proof:
:=
  fun t => (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ c t).differentiableAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.deriv_sineInterpolant
statement:
lemma deriv_sineInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (sineInterpolant θ c) t = sineInterpolantDerivative θ c t
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ c t).deriv

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_sineInterpolant
statement:
lemma continuous_sineInterpolant (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Continuous (sineInterpolant θ c)
proof:
:=
  (differentiable_sineInterpolant θ c).continuous

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_sineCardinalDerivative
statement:
lemma continuous_sineCardinalDerivative (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    Continuous (sineCardinalDerivative θ j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineCardinalDerivative
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro k hk
  apply Continuous.mul
  · apply continuous_finsetProd
    intro l hl
    exact (Real.continuous_sin.comp
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const 2)).div_const _
  · exact ((Real.continuous_cos.comp
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const 2)).div_const 2).div_const _

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_sineInterpolantDerivative
statement:
lemma continuous_sineInterpolantDerivative (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Continuous (sineInterpolantDerivative θ c)
proof:
:= by
