  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro j hj
  exact continuous_const.mul (continuous_sineCardinalDerivative θ j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_add_two_pi
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_add_two_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant θ c (t + 2 * Real.pi) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * sineInterpolant θ c t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sineInterpolant
  simp_rw [sineCardinal_add_two_pi]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi
statement:
lemma sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolantDerivative θ c (t + 2 * Real.pi) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * sineInterpolantDerivative θ c t
proof:
:= by
  have hl := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ c (t + 2 * Real.pi)).comp t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (2 * Real.pi))
  have hr := (hasDerivAt_sineInterpolant θ c t).const_mul ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1))
  have heq : (fun u => sineInterpolant θ c (u + 2 * Real.pi)) =
      (fun u => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * sineInterpolant θ c u) :=
    funext (sineInterpolant_add_two_pi θ c)
  simp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, mul_one] at hl
  rw [heq] at hl
  exact hl.unique hr

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolant θ c (t + 2 * Real.pi) = 0 ↔ sineInterpolant θ c t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineInterpolant_add_two_pi, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0), false_or]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff
    (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    sineInterpolantDerivative θ c (t + 2 * Real.pi) = 0 ↔
      sineInterpolantDerivative θ c t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0), false_or]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterEmbedding_apply
statement:
lemma angularParameterEmbedding_apply (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    angularParameterEmbedding v = angularParameterAngles v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;>
    simp [angularParameterEmbedding, angularParameterAngles]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_angularParameterAngles
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_angularParameterAngles (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt angularParameterAngles angularParameterEmbedding u
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (angularParameterEmbedding : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) =
      angularParameterAngles := funext angularParameterEmbedding_apply
  rw [← heq]
  exact angularParameterEmbedding.hasFDerivAt

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiff_angularParameterAngles
statement:
lemma contDiff_angularParameterAngles (m : ℕ∞ω) :
    ContDiff ℝ m (angularParameterAngles : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (angularParameterEmbedding : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) =
      angularParameterAngles := funext angularParameterEmbedding_apply
  rw [← heq]
  exact angularParameterEmbedding.contDiff

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply
statement:
lemma angularInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply (u v : Fin d → ℝ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    angularInterpolantParameterDerivative u c t v =
      ∑ j : Fin d, v j *
        (-deriv (sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles u) c) (u j) *
          sineCardinal (angularParameterAngles u) j.succ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [angularInterpolantParameterDerivative, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    angularParameterEmbedding_apply, sineInterpolantParameterDerivative_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [angularParameterAngles_zero, angularParameterAngles_succ, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.hasFDerivAt_angularInterpolant_parameters
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_angularInterpolant_parameters (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (c : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin d → ℝ => sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles v) c t)
      (angularInterpolantParameterDerivative u c t) u
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu).phaseNodes_injective
  exact (hasFDerivAt_sineInterpolant_parameters (angularParameterAngles u) c t hθ
    (angularParameterAngle_mem_Ico u hu)).comp u (hasFDerivAt_angularParameterAngles u)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.contDiffAt_angularInterpolant_joint
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_angularInterpolant_joint (m : ℕ∞ω) (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (c : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin d → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      sineInterpolant (angularParameterAngles x.1) c x.2) (u, t)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu).phaseNodes_injective
  have hmap : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun x : (Fin d → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      (angularParameterAngles x.1, x.2)) (u, t) :=
    (((contDiff_angularParameterAngles m).contDiffAt.comp (u, t) contDiffAt_fst).prodMk
      contDiffAt_snd)
  have hcomp := (contDiffAt_sineInterpolant_joint m (angularParameterAngles u) t c hθ).comp
    (u, t) hmap
  exact hcomp

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.ordinary_gap_rolle
statement:
private lemma ordinary_gap_rolle (angles : CyclicAngles n hn) (cut : Fin n)
    (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    ∃ peak, peak ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut ∧
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) peak = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hab : angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) < angles.angle cut :=
    angles.strictMono (show gapPredecessor cut < cut from by
      change cut.val - 1 < cut.val
      omega)
  apply exists_deriv_eq_zero hab
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)).continuousOn
  rw [gapInterpolant_at_node, gapInterpolant_at_node,
    gapCoefficient_at_predecessor cut hcut, gapCoefficient_at_cut]

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.gap_derivative_polynomial_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply cayleyOperator_interpolant_ne_zero_of_ne angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
    (angles.angle cut) r
  rw [hr, gapInterpolant_at_node, gapCoefficient_at_cut]
  norm_num

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.ordinary_peak_from_enclosing_zeros
statement:
private lemma ordinary_peak_from_enclosing_zeros (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) {a b peak : ℝ}
    (ha : a < angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (hb : angles.angle cut < b)
    (haz : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) a = 0)
    (hbz : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) b = 0)
    (hpeak : peak ∈ ordinaryGap angles cut hcut)
    (hz : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) peak = 0)
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
      deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)) x = 0 → x = peak) :
    StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) peak ∧
      1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a < b := ha.trans (hpeak.1.trans (hpeak.2.trans hb))
  have hnode : angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) ∈ Set.Ioo a b :=
    ⟨ha, hpeak.1.trans (hpeak.2.trans hb)⟩
  have hnodeValue : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) = 1 := by
    rw [gapInterpolant_at_node, gapCoefficient_at_predecessor cut hcut]
  obtain ⟨houter, _⟩ := strict_interval_peak_of_unique_critical hab
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)).continuousOn
    (differentiable_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)).differentiableOn
    haz hbz hunique ⟨_, hnode, by rw [hnodeValue]; norm_num⟩
  have hsubset : Set.Icc (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) ⊆
      Set.Icc a b := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨ha.le.trans hx.1, hx.2.trans hb.le⟩
  have hinner : StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) peak :=
    ⟨hpeak, houter.hasDerivAt_zero, fun x hx => houter.isMaxOn (hsubset hx),
      fun x hx => houter.eq_iff x (hsubset hx)⟩
  have hgt : 1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) peak := by
    rw [← hnodeValue]
    exact houter.lt_of_ne (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hnode) (ne_of_lt hpeak.1)
  have hturn := ordinaryGap_mem_Ioo angles cut hcut hpeak
  have hnondegenerate := gapInterpolant_critical_non_degenerate angles hsize cut hcut
    peak ⟨hturn.1.le, hturn.2⟩ hz
  exact ⟨hinner, hgt, hinner.second_deriv_neg
    (continuous_sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)).continuousOn
    hnondegenerate⟩

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_two_le_cut
statement:
theorem exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_two_le_cut (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 2 ≤ cut.val) :
    ∃ peak, StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) peak ∧
      1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcutpos : 0 < cut.val := by omega
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize cut hcutpos
  let i : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨cut.val - 2, by have := cut.isLt; omega⟩
  have hinext : i.val + 1 < n - 1 := by dsimp [i]; have := cut.isLt; omega
  let j : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, hinext⟩
  have hipivot : i.val < cut.val - 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hival : (otherGapIndex cut i).val = i.val := by
    simp only [otherGapIndex, if_pos hipivot]
  have hrightIndex : (otherGapIndex cut i).val + 1 < n := by
    rw [hival]; dsimp [i]; have := cut.isLt; omega
  have hright : cyclicGapRight angles (otherGapIndex cut i) =
      angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) := by
    rw [cyclicGapRight, dif_pos hrightIndex]
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_mk, gapPredecessor]
    rw [hival]
    dsimp [i]
    omega
  have hjpivot : ¬j.val < cut.val - 1 := by dsimp [j, i]; omega
  have hjindex : otherGapIndex cut j = cut := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [otherGapIndex, Fin.val_mk, if_neg hjpivot]
    dsimp [j, i]
    omega
  have hleft : root i < angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) := by
    have h := (hloc i).2
    rwa [hright] at h
  have hrightRoot : angles.angle cut < root j := by
    have h := (hloc j).1
    rwa [hjindex] at h
  have hP := gap_derivative_polynomial_ne_zero angles cut (hroot ⟨0, hp⟩)
  obtain ⟨critical, _, _, _, _, hcritical⟩ :=
    sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing hsize angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      hP root hmono hbound hroot
  obtain ⟨peak, hpeak, hz⟩ := ordinary_gap_rolle angles cut hcutpos
  have hpeakArc : peak ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) i := by
    rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_pos hinext]
    exact ⟨hleft.trans hpeak.1, hpeak.2.trans hrightRoot⟩
  have heq := hcritical i peak hpeakArc hz
  refine ⟨peak, ordinary_peak_from_enclosing_zeros angles hsize cut hcutpos
    hleft hrightRoot (hroot i) (hroot j) hpeak hz ?_⟩
  intro x hx hxzero
  have hxarc : x ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) i := by
    rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_pos hinext]
    exact hx
  exact (hcritical i x hxarc hxzero).trans heq.symm

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_cut_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_cut_eq_one (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : cut.val = 1) :
    ∃ peak, StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) peak ∧
      1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcutpos : 0 < cut.val := by omega
  have hp : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
  let first : Fin (n - 1) := ⟨0, hp⟩
  let last : Fin (n - 1) := lastNodeIndex hp
  obtain ⟨root, hmono, hloc, hbound, hroot⟩ :=
    exists_gapInterpolant_ordered_cyclic_zeros_with_locations angles hsize cut hcutpos
  have hfirstIndex : otherGapIndex cut first = cut := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [otherGapIndex, first, Fin.val_mk, hcut, Nat.sub_self,
      Nat.not_lt_zero, if_false]
  have hfirstRoot : angles.angle cut < root first := by
    have h := (hloc first).1
    rwa [hfirstIndex] at h
  have hfirst_le_last : root first ≤ root last :=
    hmono.monotone (show first ≤ last from Nat.zero_le last.val)
  have hlast_final : ¬last.val + 1 < n - 1 := by
    dsimp only [last, lastNodeIndex]
    omega
  have hpredZero : angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) = 0 := by
    have hpred : gapPredecessor cut = ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [gapPredecessor, Fin.val_mk, hcut, Nat.sub_self]
    rw [hpred, angles.first_eq_zero]
  have hleft : root last - 2 * Real.pi < angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut) := by
    rw [hpredZero]
    linarith [(hbound last).2]
  have hleftRoot : sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      (root last - 2 * Real.pi) = 0 := by
    apply (sineInterpolant_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      (root last - 2 * Real.pi)).mp
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hroot last
  have hP := gap_derivative_polynomial_ne_zero angles cut (hroot first)
  obtain ⟨critical, _, _, _, _, hcritical⟩ :=
    sineInterpolant_cyclic_critical_interlacing hsize angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut)
      hP root hmono hbound hroot
  obtain ⟨peak, hpeak, hz⟩ := ordinary_gap_rolle angles cut hcutpos
  have hpeakpos : 0 < peak := by simpa only [hpredZero] using hpeak.1
  have hpeakArc : peak ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
    rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
    exact ⟨⟨hpeakpos.le, hpeak.2.trans (angles.lt_two_pi cut)⟩,
      Or.inr (hpeak.2.trans hfirstRoot)⟩
  have heq := hcritical last peak hpeakArc hz
  refine ⟨peak, ordinary_peak_from_enclosing_zeros angles hsize cut hcutpos
    hleft hfirstRoot hleftRoot (hroot first) hpeak hz ?_⟩
  intro x hx hxzero
  by_cases hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x
  · have hxarc : x ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
      rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
      exact ⟨⟨hxnonneg, hx.2.trans (hbound first).2⟩, Or.inr hx.2⟩
    exact (hcritical last x hxarc hxzero).trans heq.symm
  · have hxnegative : x < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hxnonneg
    have hxplus_gt_last : root last < x + 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [hx.1]
    have hxarc : x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ cyclicRootArc hp root (2 * Real.pi) last := by
      rw [cyclicRootArc, dif_neg hlast_final]
      exact ⟨⟨(hbound last).1.trans hxplus_gt_last.le, by linarith⟩,
        Or.inl hxplus_gt_last⟩
    have hxpluszero : deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
        (x + 2 * Real.pi) = 0 := by
      rw [deriv_sineInterpolant] at hxzero ⊢
      exact (sineInterpolantDerivative_add_two_pi_eq_zero_iff angles.angle
        (gapCoefficient cut) x).mpr hxzero
    have hxpluseq := (hcritical last _ hxarc hxpluszero).trans heq.symm
    have hpeak_lt_last : peak < root last :=
      (hpeak.2.trans hfirstRoot).trans_le hfirst_le_last
    exact False.elim (by linarith)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak
statement:
theorem exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak (angles : CyclicAngles n hn)
    (hsize : 2 ≤ n) (cut : Fin n) (hcut : 0 < cut.val) :
    ∃ peak, StrictIntervalPeak (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))
      (angles.angle (gapPredecessor cut)) (angles.angle cut) peak ∧
      1 < sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut) peak ∧
      deriv (deriv (sineInterpolant angles.angle (gapCoefficient cut))) peak < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfirst : cut.val = 1
  · exact exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_cut_eq_one angles hsize cut hfirst
  · exact exists_ordinaryGap_strict_peak_of_two_le_cut angles hsize cut (by omega)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngles_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma angularParameterAngles_zero (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    angularParameterAngles u 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngles_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma angularParameterAngles_succ (u : Fin d → ℝ) (i : Fin d) :
    angularParameterAngles u i.succ = u i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_angularParameterAngle
statement:
lemma continuous_angularParameterAngle (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    Continuous (fun u : Fin d → ℝ => angularParameterAngles u i)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simpa only [angularParameterAngles_zero] using
      (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Fin d → ℝ => (0 : ℝ)))
  · simpa only [angularParameterAngles_succ] using
      (continuous_apply j : Continuous (fun u : Fin d → ℝ => u j))

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.continuous_angularParameterAngles
statement:
lemma continuous_angularParameterAngles :
    Continuous (angularParameterAngles : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ)
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi continuous_angularParameterAngle

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.isOpen_angularParameterDomain
statement: theorem isOpen_angularParameterDomain (d : ℕ) : IsOpen (angularParameterDomain d)
proof:
:= by
  have horder : IsOpen {u : Fin d → ℝ | StrictMono (angularParameterAngles u)} := by
    have heq : {u : Fin d → ℝ | StrictMono (angularParameterAngles u)} =
        ⋂ i : Fin (d + 1), ⋂ j : Fin (d + 1),
          {u : Fin d → ℝ | i < j → angularParameterAngles u i < angularParameterAngles u j} := by
      ext u
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro i
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · simp only [hij, true_implies]
      exact isOpen_lt (continuous_angularParameterAngle i) (continuous_angularParameterAngle j)
    · simp only [hij, false_implies, Set.ofPred_true]
      exact isOpen_univ
  have hupper : IsOpen {u : Fin d → ℝ | ∀ i, u i < 2 * Real.pi} := by
    have heq : {u : Fin d → ℝ | ∀ i, u i < 2 * Real.pi} =
        ⋂ i : Fin d, {u : Fin d → ℝ | u i < 2 * Real.pi} := by
      ext u
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    rw [heq]
    exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun i => isOpen_lt (continuous_apply i) continuous_const)
  exact horder.inter hupper

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameter_pos
statement:
lemma angularParameter_pos (u : Fin d → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d)
    (i : Fin d) : 0 < u i
proof:
:= by
  have h := hu.1 (Fin.succ_pos i)
  simpa only [angularParameterAngles_zero, angularParameterAngles_succ] using h

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngle_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma angularParameterAngle_mem_Ico (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    angularParameterAngles u i ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp only [angularParameterAngles_zero, Set.mem_Ico, le_refl, true_and]
    positivity
  · simpa only [angularParameterAngles_succ, Set.mem_Ico] using
      And.intro (angularParameter_pos u hu j).le (hu.2 j)

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicAnglesOfParameters_angle
statement:
@[simp] lemma cyclicAnglesOfParameters_angle (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) :
    (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu).angle = angularParameterAngles u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_apply
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)) (i : Fin d) :
    angles.interiorParameters i = angles.angle i.succ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters
statement:
lemma angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)) :
    angularParameterAngles angles.interiorParameters = angles.angle
proof:
:= by
  change Fin.cons 0 (Fin.tail angles.angle) = angles.angle
  rw [← angles.first_eq_zero]
  exact Fin.cons_self_tail angles.angle

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_mem_domain
statement:
lemma CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_mem_domain
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)) :
    angles.interiorParameters ∈ angularParameterDomain d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters]
    exact angles.strictMono
  · intro i
    exact angles.lt_two_pi i.succ

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_ofParameters
statement:
@[simp] lemma CyclicAngles.interiorParameters_ofParameters (u : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hu : u ∈ angularParameterDomain d) :
    (cyclicAnglesOfParameters u hu).interiorParameters = u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UnitCircleInterpolation.cyclicAnglesOfParameters_interiorParameters
statement:
@[simp] lemma cyclicAnglesOfParameters_interiorParameters
    (angles : CyclicAngles (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d)) :
    cyclicAnglesOfParameters angles.interiorParameters angles.interiorParameters_mem_domain =
      angles
proof:
:= by
  have hangle := angularParameterAngles_interiorParameters angles
  cases angles
  unfold cyclicAnglesOfParameters
  congr 1
